AccessGate.description: Request-access flow for admin-approved apps: request → pending → approved (collect key) | denied.

props.name: adapter
props.description: Functions that send, poll and cancel the access request against your backend.

props.name: defaultRecord
props.description: Initial record when `record` is not controlled.

props.name: defaultScopes
props.description: Scope ids ticked initially.

props.name: onCollected
props.description: Called once the user has collected the approved access (for example after copying the credential).

props.name: onRecordChange
props.description: Called with the record whenever the request changes state.

props.name: otherWays
props.description: Escape hatch shown under the form, e.g. "Sign in with kunji instead".

props.name: pollInterval
props.description: Poll interval while pending. Default 5000ms.

props.name: purposePlaceholder
props.description: Placeholder of the purpose field.
props.default: "e.g. running the benchmark suite against the new model"

props.name: record
props.description: Controlled access request record (status and details); drives which step is shown.

props.name: resourceName
props.description: What is being requested, e.g. "GPU access".

props.name: scopes
props.description: Scopes the user can ask for in the form.

props.name: signedInAs
props.description: Who is signed in.

AccessRequestQueue.description: Pending pairing requests with approve / deny, plus approved users with confirm-to-revoke.

props.name: requests
props.description: Pending pairing requests awaiting approval or denial.

props.name: approved
props.description: Users already approved; listed with a confirm-to-revoke action.

props.name: emptyHint
props.description: Text shown when there are no pending requests.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Text shown when there are no pending requests; defaults to a hint about pairing codes.

props.name: now
props.description: Reference time for relative stamps (tests / SSR).

props.name: onApprove
props.description: Called with the request id when the user approves it; may return a promise.

props.name: onDeny
props.description: Called with the request id when the user denies it; may return a promise.

props.name: onRevoke
props.description: Called with the approved user's id after the user confirms revoking access; may return a promise.

Accordion.description: Vertically stacked set of collapsible sections.

props.name: icon
props.description: Trigger indicator: rotating chevron or plus that morphs into minus.

props.name: keepMounted
props.description: Keep every panel in the tree while closed (hidden), so form state and iframes survive; panels can override it.

props.name: variant
props.description:
default: divided list · bordered: separate bordered cards · ghost: no chrome ·
surface: one bordered panel with divided rows · separated: separate soft filled blocks

props.name: keepMounted
props.description: Keep this panel in the tree while closed; overrides the `Accordion` setting.

AccordionTrigger.description: Clickable header that toggles its section.

props.name: icon
props.description: Override the indicator for this trigger, or `false` to hide it.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Icon shown before the title.

AccountPanel.description: Signed-in summary: avatar, name, role, app launch links, and sign out / sign out everywhere.

props.name: name
props.description: Account holder's name, shown as the heading and used for the avatar fallback.

props.name: apps
props.description: Apps signed in on this account, listed in the panel.

props.name: avatarSrc
props.description: Avatar image URL; initials are shown when unset.

props.name: handle
props.description: Handle or email under the name.

props.name: onSignOut
props.description: Called when the user signs out of this session; the button is hidden when unset.

props.name: onSignOutEverywhere
props.description: Ends every session (with a confirm dialog).

props.name: role
props.description: Role badge, e.g. "Admin".

props.name: markOnly
props.description: Render only the geometric mark.

props.name: size
props.description: Height-driven size of the lockup.

props.name: events
props.description: Security events, newest first, each with a kind, time and optional details.

props.name: compact
props.description: Tighter row spacing, used inside drawers.

props.name: density
props.description: Row spacing; `compact` is used inside drawers.

props.name: empty
props.description: Content shown when there is nothing to list.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when there are no events. Default "No activity yet".

props.name: groupByDay
props.description: Group under day headings. Default true.

props.name: now
props.description: Reference time for relative labels; set it in tests and SSR for stable output.

props.name: onEventClick
props.description: Click handler; without it, rows expand inline to show details.

AdaptiveTabs.description: Inline pill tabs on wide screens that become a `BottomTabBar` on phones — same items.

props.name: items
props.description: Tabs to show, in order; each has a `value`, a `label` and an `icon`.

props.name: bottomBarProps
props.description: Extra props for the bottom bar (position, glass, primaryAction…).

props.name: breakpoint
props.description: Width from which the inline pills replace the bottom bar. Default "md".

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially selected tab value when uncontrolled.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for both navigations.

props.name: mode
props.description: Force one presentation instead of switching by width.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the value of the tab the user picked.

props.name: query
props.description: Measure the viewport (default) or the nearest wrapper (`container`, uses CSS container queries).

props.name: renderLink
props.description: Renders each tab link in place of the default `<a>`, e.g. to use your router's Link.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected tab value. Use with `onValueChange`.

AgentAvatar.description: Procedural agent avatar drawn as pure SVG from `{ shape, color, face, seed }`.

props.name: spec
props.description: What to draw: shape, colour, face and seed, plus an optional uploaded image.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Pass "" to hide from assistive tech. Default "Agent avatar".

props.name: size
props.description: Pixel size. Default 40.

AgentAvatarBuilder.description: Procedural agent avatar editor: shape, color, face, seeded generation and image upload, with a live preview.

props.name: colors
props.description: Swatches. Default `agentAvatarColors`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial avatar spec when `value` is not controlled.

props.name: onUpload
props.description: Turn an uploaded file into a URL. Default reads it as a data URL.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new spec on every change.

props.name: previewSize
props.description: Preview size in px. Default 96.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled avatar spec (shape, colour, glyph or uploaded image).

AgentBrowserPane.description: Agent-driven browser surface: address bar, lease banner, loading bar and an app-provided viewport.

props.name: agentActivity
props.description: What the agent is doing right now, e.g. "Clicking “Sign in”".

props.name: agentName
props.description: Name used in the control banner ("<name> is driving"). Default "The agent".

props.name: canGoBack
props.description: Enables the back button.

props.name: canGoForward
props.description: Enables the forward button.

props.name: children
props.description: The viewport (iframe, screenshot, canvas…) supplied by the app.

props.name: controller
props.description: Who holds the control lease.

props.name: defaultController
props.description: Initial controlling party (`agent` or `user`) when `controller` is not controlled.

props.name: footer
props.description: Rendered under the viewport, e.g. a `BrowserConsole`.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows the page as loading: the reload button becomes Stop and the progress bar appears.

props.name: onBack
props.description: Called when the user presses Back.

props.name: onControllerChange
props.description: Called with the new controller when the user takes over or hands control back.

props.name: onForward
props.description: Called when the user presses Forward.

props.name: onNavigate
props.description: Called with the normalized URL when the user submits the address bar.

props.name: onReload
props.description: Called when the user presses Reload.

props.name: onStop
props.description: Called when the user presses Stop while `loading`.

props.name: pageTitle
props.description: Page title, shown as a tooltip on the URL field.

props.name: progress
props.description: 0–100. Indeterminate while `loading` and unset.

props.name: security
props.description: Override the inferred security indicator.

props.name: toolbarExtra
props.description: Extra toolbar content after the URL field.

props.name: url
props.description: Current URL. Display state only: the pane never loads it.

props.name: viewportClassName
props.description: Extra classes for the viewport that wraps `children`.

AgentJobForm.description: Create or edit a scheduled agent job: prompt or script, schedule, model, profile, skills, toolsets, repeat limit and delivery.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial draft (uncontrolled). Missing fields get defaults.

props.name: deliveryPlatforms
props.description: Delivery targets to offer; defaults to the built-in platforms.

props.name: deliveryStatus
props.description: Delivery state per platform, shown beside the delivery targets.

props.name: models
props.description: Model options (or replace the select with `modelSlot`).

props.name: modelSlot
props.description: Replaces the model select, for a custom model picker.

props.name: now
props.description: Reference time for the schedule preview.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Called when the user presses Cancel; the button is hidden when unset.

props.name: onConfigureChannels
props.description: Called when the user presses Configure channels next to the delivery targets; the link is hidden when unset.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called with the valid job draft; may return a promise, and the submit button shows a spinner until it settles.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the next draft on every edit.

props.name: profiles
props.description: Profile options for the profile select; the select is hidden when empty or unset.

props.name: skills
props.description: Skills the user can attach to the job, as names or option objects.

props.name: submitLabel
props.description: Label of the submit button.

props.name: timeZone
props.description: IANA time zone for the schedule preview (for example `Europe/Berlin`); the viewer's zone when unset.

props.name: toolsets
props.description: Toolsets the user can enable for the job, as names or option objects.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled draft. Pair with `onValueChange`.

AgentMessageNotice.description: Transcript row for an agent-to-agent message ("Messaged Researcher: …" / "Message from Planner") with an expandable payload.

props.name: agent
props.description: The other agent.

props.name: direction
props.description: `outgoing` for a message this agent sent, `incoming` for one it received.

props.name: payload
props.description: Full message body, revealed on expand.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Initial expanded state of the payload when `expanded` is not controlled.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Controlled expanded state of the payload.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the user expands or collapses the payload.

AgentProcessCard.description: One agent session: logo, title, status pill, "agent · project · running 48 min", memory and the processes it started.

props.name: accent
props.description: Default violet.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Lets the process list collapse behind the "Started · N" toggle.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Initial expanded state when `expanded` is not controlled.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Controlled expanded state of the process list (with `collapsible`).

props.name: loading
props.description:
Waiting for data: with no `session` the whole card is a placeholder; with a session whose `processes` are not
known yet the header is real and the process rows are placeholders (no Quit button).

props.name: loadingRows
props.description: Placeholder process rows while loading. Default 3.

props.name: now
props.description: Reference time for durations. Default: the clock, refreshed every 30 s.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the user expands or collapses the process list.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Makes the title a button.

props.name: onQuit
props.description: Called after the "Quit Session…" confirmation. May return a promise (the dialog waits).

props.name: onStopProcess
props.description: Adds a stop button to each process row.

props.name: session
props.description: The session. May be left out while `loading` (the whole card is a placeholder).

Running agent sessions and the processes each one started, separated by rules; "Quit Session…" confirms first.
A session that starts waiting for the user is announced once (politely); durations never sit in a live region.

props.name: sessions
props.description: Sessions to list, one card each.

props.name: accent
props.description: Default violet.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Lets the process list collapse behind the "Started · N" toggle.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Initially expanded session ids when `expanded` is not controlled.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when there are no sessions.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Ids of the sessions whose process list is open (with `collapsible`). Default: all.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the list. Default "Agent sessions".

props.name: loading
props.description: Waiting for sessions: with none yet, `loadingRows` placeholder sessions stand in; sessions without `processes` show placeholder rows.

props.name: loadingRows
props.description: Placeholder sessions while loading with none. Default 3.

props.name: now
props.description: Reference time for durations. Default: the clock, refreshed every 30 s.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Called with the expanded session ids when the user expands or collapses a card.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Makes the title a button.

props.name: onQuit
props.description: Called after the "Quit Session…" confirmation. May return a promise (the dialog waits).

props.name: onStopProcess
props.description: Adds a stop button to each process row.

AgentRoom.description: Multi-agent group chat: speaker-attributed transcript, round / turn indicator, hold state, mentions and typing indicators.

props.name: messages
props.description: Transcript messages, oldest first.

props.name: actions
props.description: Header actions.

props.name: composer

props.name: currentSpeakerId

props.name: title

props.name: turnOrder

props.name: available

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial members when `value` is not controlled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the members in the new order when the user adds, removes or reorders one.

props.name: value
props.description: Members in turn order.

AgentRoster.description: Pill that opens a popover panel listing subagents and background tasks. The ref goes to the pill.

props.name: agents
props.description: Agents to list, one row each.

props.name: align
props.description: Alignment of the popover against the pill.

props.name: children
props.description: Extra rows (e.g. `BackgroundTaskRow`s) rendered under the agents.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when `open` is not controlled.

props.name: emptyState

props.name: onStop

props.name: side

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when there are no agents. Default "No agents running".

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Content shown when there is nothing to list.

props.name: now
props.description: Reference time for elapsed labels; the rows tick on their own when omitted.

props.name: onOpenTranscript
props.description: Called with the agent id when the user opens an agent's transcript.

props.name: onStop
props.description: Called with the agent id when the user stops a running agent.

AgentRosterPill.description: Compact "3 agents" trigger with an aggregate status dot.

props.name: agent

props.name: now
props.description: Reference time; the row ticks on its own when omitted.

props.name: onOpenTranscript

props.name: onStop
props.description: Called with the agent id when the user stops a running agent; the button is hidden when unset.

AgentSessionList.description: Sessions sidebar for agent apps: groups, search, status filter, multi-select, bulk actions and keyboard navigation.

props.name: sessions
props.description: Sessions to list, each with title, status, time and optional group.

props.name: activeId
props.description: Id of the session that is open; `null` or unset marks none.

props.name: defaultCheckboxMode
props.description: Start with selection checkboxes visible.

props.name: defaultLocation
props.description: Initial location tab when `location` is not controlled.

props.name: defaultQuery
props.description: Initial search text when `query` is not controlled.

props.name: defaultSelectedIds
props.description: Initially checked ids when `selectedIds` is not controlled.

props.name: defaultStatusFilter
props.description: Initial status filters when `statusFilter` is not controlled.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when there is nothing to list. Default "No sessions match".

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Content shown when there is nothing to list.

props.name: groups
props.description: Named groups that sessions can belong to; sessions are listed under their group.

props.name: location
props.description: Controlled location tab: `local` or `remote`.

props.name: now
props.description: Reference time for relative timestamps.

props.name: onActiveChange
props.description: Called with the session id when the user opens a session.

props.name: onArchive
props.description: Called with the ids of the chosen sessions when the user archives them.

props.name: onCreateGroup
props.description: Called when the user presses New group; the button is hidden when unset.

props.name: onDelete
props.description: Called with the ids of the chosen sessions after the user confirms deleting them.

props.name: onLocationChange
props.description: Called with the location when the user switches tab.

props.name: onMarkUnread
props.description: Called with the ids of the chosen sessions when the user marks them unread.

props.name: onMoveToGroup
props.description: Called with the session ids and the target group id (`null` for ungrouped) when the user moves sessions.

props.name: onNewSession
props.description:
Called when the user starts a new session, with the group id when started from a group; the button is hidden when

props.name: onQueryChange

props.name: onRenameGroup

props.name: onRenameSession

props.name: onSelectedIdsChange
props.description: Called with the checked ids when the selection changes.

props.name: onStatusFilterChange

props.name: query
props.description: Controlled search text.

props.name: selectedIds
props.description: Controlled ids of the checked sessions (checkbox mode).

props.name: showLocationTabs
props.description: Show the local / remote switch. Default true.

props.name: statusFilter
props.description: Controlled status filters (`waiting`, `running`, `unread`, `failed`); empty shows all sessions.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading. Default "Sessions".

AgentStatusDot.description: Session status dot (a `StatusDot` preset): running and waiting pulse, elsewhere is a hollow ring.

props.name: status
props.description:
Session status (`running`, `waiting`, `idle`, `unread`, `failed` or `elsewhere`); sets the dot colour and the
default accessible label.

props.name: decorative
props.description: Hide from assistive tech when the status is announced elsewhere.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label override.

props.name: size
props.description: Dot size.

AgentStatusLine.description:
Live agent activity above the composer: what the agent is doing (thinking, running a tool, waiting for
permission or an answer) with elapsed time and token count. Renders nothing when idle.

For infrastructure phases (cold start, queue, retry/rate-limit countdown, offline) use `StatusStrip`,
which sits in the same slot. Live region: `role="status"` (polite); the ticking clock, token count and
rotating verbs are hidden from screen readers so only state changes are announced.

props.name: state
props.description:
What the agent is doing: `idle`, `thinking`, `running`, `permission` or `question`; sets the icon, tone and
default label.

props.name: elapsed
props.description: Controlled elapsed seconds (disables the internal clock).

props.name: hint
props.description: Right-side hint, e.g. <Kbd>Esc</Kbd> to interrupt.

props.name: icon
props.description: Replaces the per-state icon.

props.name: label
props.description:
Overrides the default label. With `verbs`, the visible text rotates and this label is what
screen readers get instead (default "Thinking…").

props.name: layout
props.description:
`bar` (default): full-width row, stats after the label and the hint pushed right.
`inline`: compact inline loader with "(3s · 1.2k tokens · hint)" after the label.

props.name: showElapsed
props.description: Show the elapsed time. Default true.

props.name: startedAt
props.description: When the current state began (Date, epoch ms or ISO string). Defaults to when `state` / `tool` last changed.

props.name: tokenCount
props.description: Tokens used so far, shown as "1.2k tokens".

props.name: tokens
props.description: Tokens used so far, shown as "1.2k tokens".

props.name: tokensPrefix
props.description: Text before the token count, e.g. "↓" for streamed output tokens.

props.name: tool
props.description: Tool name for the "running" state.

props.name: verbInterval
props.description: Ms between verbs. Default 3000. Rotation pauses with reduced motion.

props.name: verbOrder
props.description: Rotation order for `verbs`. Default "random" (never repeats the current verb).

props.name: verbs
props.description: Words rotated as the visible label while `state` is "thinking" ("Pondering…", "Brewing…").

AlbumCard.description: Square album art with a hover play FAB, title and subtitle.

props.name: trailingIcon

AnimatedList.description: See `AnimatedListInner`: the generic cast keeps `ref` and the item type together.

props.name: getKey
props.description: A stable key per item (an id, not the index).

props.name: items
props.description: Items to render, in order; items added or removed animate in and out.

props.name: renderItem
props.type: (item: T, state: PresenceState, index: number) => React.ReactNode
props.description: The content of one row. `state` is `"enter"`, `"idle"` or `"exit"` (an exiting row is a copy of its last render).

props.name: as
props.description: The list element: `ul` and `ol` wrap each row in an `li`. Default `ul`.

props.name: collapse
props.description:
Let the neighbours close the gap as a removed row collapses (a `0fr` track, no measuring): `true` or `"height"` for
a column, `"width"` for a wrapping row of chips. Default true. Put spacing inside the rows (padding or margin on the
content), not as a `gap` between them, or the gap jumps when the row finally unmounts.

props.name: exitDuration
props.description: Milliseconds a removed row stays while it leaves. Default 200, the speed of `animate-fade-out` and the collapse.

props.name: flip
props.description:
Slide the siblings to their new place when rows are inserted, removed or reordered (`useFlip`; `true` or its
options). With `collapse` the gap of a leaving row closes by itself, so it adds inserts and reorders; with
`collapse={false}` the rows below slide up when a leaving row finally unmounts. Off under reduced motion. Default false.

props.name: initial
props.description: Animate the rows of the first render too. Default false.

props.name: itemClassName
props.description: Class names for every row wrapper.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Rows added in one update enter one after the other (`--sutra-stagger`). Default true.

AnimatedNumber.description:
A number whose digits roll to their new values, in tabular figures. Each digit is a column of 0 to 9 slid with a CSS
transition, so the first render shows the value without motion and reduced motion shows changes at once. Screen
readers get the formatted value once as text (the columns are hidden from them, and from copy and paste); add
`aria-live="polite"` to announce changes. Numbers only: format other values yourself.

props.name: value
props.description: Number to display; changes tween from the previous value.

props.name: animate
props.description: Roll the digits when `value` changes. `false` renders plain formatted text. Default true.

props.name: duration
props.description: Milliseconds for a digit to roll. Defaults to the fill speed token (`--sutra-duration-fill`).

props.name: format
props.description: `Intl.NumberFormat` options (currency, percent, compact, fraction digits …).

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale. Pass one explicitly when the server and the browser must agree (SSR). Defaults to the runtime locale.

AssistantOrb.description:
The voice assistant's face: one of several looks (`variant`: a glass orb, a waveform, or an ink look such as the Sutra
string or the mala) that shows what the assistant is doing (idle, listening, thinking, speaking, error, muted) and follows
a live `level`. Colours come from the theme (primary and chart hues, one ink in the paper style).

props.name: label
props.description:
Accessible name. By default it says what the state is ("Assistant is listening"). Pass your own to name the assistant, or
`""` to make the orb decorative (`aria-hidden`) when text beside it already says what is going on. The name is not a live
region: announce state changes in a status text of your own.

props.name: level
props.description:
The live amplitude, 0 to 1: the microphone while listening, the audio output while speaking. It is smoothed inside (fast
attack, slow release) and written to a CSS variable, so feeding it every frame does not render the orb's parts again.
States that do not follow the level (idle, error, muted) ignore it. Default 0.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freezes the animation where it is: no frame loop, ambient motion held. The state and size still apply. Default false.

props.name: size
props.description:
Size in px (a number) or any CSS length. For the round looks (orb, mala, ink, rings, graph, halftone) it is the width and
height. For the bars (waveform, string) it is the height; the width is three times that, and `className="w-full"`
stretches it (the canvas follows its box). A numeric size under 48 gives `string` a square box, drawn as the compact
form (the logo); any `string` box under 1.8:1 draws that form. Default 128 (round looks) or 64 (bars).

props.name: state
props.description:
What the assistant is doing: `idle` (breathing, muted colour), `listening` (swells with `level`, ripples on loud input),
`thinking` (faster swirl, an orbiting arc, a travelling pulse in the waveform), `speaking` (a rhythmic pulse and expanding
rings), `error` or `muted`. Each has its own shape as well as its own motion, so the state reads under reduced motion.
Default "idle".

props.name: variant
props.description:
The look. `orb` is a radial glass orb of blurred colour layers; `waveform` is a canvas of layered sine waves. The ink
looks are drawn on a canvas in flat ink (one ink in the paper style, the primary and chart hues in colour): `mala`
(beads on a closed thread, the Sutra bead at the top), `string` (the Sutra bead on a vibrating thread: a 3:1 bar, the
square logo below 48 px), `ink` (a drop of ink), `rings` (thick thread loops), `graph` (dots on a turning sphere
joined around a hub) and `halftone` (a sphere of whole dots around a centre dot). `assistantOrbVariants` lists them in
picker order and `assistantOrbVariantLabels` names them. Default "orb".

Carousel.description:
A snap carousel: native CSS scroll-snap strip (swipe, trackpad and wheel just work), previous and next buttons, dots,
Arrow / Home / End keys on the strip, and the slide in view as `value` (found with an IntersectionObserver, so a free
scroll updates it). It follows the ARIA carousel pattern: `aria-roledescription="carousel"` and "slide" with "n of N"
names, and a status line that announces the slide unless it is rotating. `autoplay` pauses while the pointer or focus is inside, has a visible
pause button (WCAG 2.2.2) and stays off under reduced motion until the user starts it. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: align
props.description: Where a slide stops in the strip. Default "start".

props.name: arrows
props.description: Previous and next buttons. Default true.

props.name: autoplay
props.description: Advance by itself: `true` every 5 s or a number of ms. It pauses on hover and focus and has a visible pause button; off under reduced motion until the user presses play.

props.name: children
props.description: The slides, one child each (a fragment's children count one by one).

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially visible slide index when uncontrolled.

props.name: dots
props.description: One dot per slide. Default true.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when there are no slides. Default "Nothing to show".

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the carousel.

props.name: labels
props.description: Overrides for the accessible texts (strip name, previous, next, play, pause, dot names).

props.name: loading
props.description: Placeholder slide and `aria-busy` while the slides are on their way.

props.name: loop
props.description: The arrows go round (rewinding to the other end) instead of stopping. Default false.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new slide index after a swipe, a button press or a dot press.

props.name: progress
props.description: A bar that fills over the autoplay interval (a CSS transition, hidden under reduced motion). Default false.

props.name: slideClassName
props.description: Classes for each slide: its width (`basis-4/5` to show the next slide peeking). Default `basis-full`.

props.name: trackClassName
props.description: Classes for the strip that holds the slides.

props.name: value
props.description: Index of the slide in view.

CheckBurst.description:
A tiny celebratory pop for completing a task or reaching a streak: a ring of particles flies out of the centre and fades
(Web Animations on `translate`, `scale` and `opacity`, no keyframes in the stylesheet), and the content swells. Pure
decoration: the layer is `aria-hidden` and never carries information, so say the result in text (a live region, the
checked state). Under `prefers-reduced-motion` nothing plays. It draws past its own box, so keep it out of an
`overflow-hidden` ancestor. Drive it with `active`, `burstKey` or `apiRef.burst()`.

props.name: active
props.description: A burst plays when this goes from false to true (never on mount).

props.name: apiRef
props.description: Imperative handle (`burst()`).

props.name: burstKey
props.description: A burst plays whenever this value changes (a streak count).

props.name: children
props.description: What the burst belongs to (a checkbox, a streak flame). It swells with the burst unless `pop` is false. Optional: with no children the burst fills its positioned parent.

props.name: count
props.description: Number of particles, 0 to 24. Default 10.

props.name: duration
props.description: Milliseconds. Default 500.

props.name: onBurst
props.description: Called when a burst is asked for, also where reduced motion keeps it from showing.

props.name: onBurstEnd
props.description: Called when the particles are gone.

props.name: particleSize
props.description: Particle size in px (a dash is 1.8 times as long). Default 5.

props.name: pop
props.description: Swell the children with the burst. Default true.

props.name: radius
props.description: How far the particles fly, in px from the centre. Default 28.

props.name: shape
props.description: Particle shape of the burst: `dots`, `dashes` or `mixed`.

props.name: tone
props.description: `"multi"` cycles brand, success, warning and info; a tone paints them all in one colour. Default "multi".

Collapse.description:
Height-auto open and close for a section, filter row or wizard step. The track goes from `0fr` to `1fr`, so the real
content height animates with no measuring and no JS animation; closed content is `inert` (not focusable, out of the
accessibility tree). Reduced motion ends the transition at once. It is controlled only: drive `open` yourself or use
`Collapsible`.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the content is shown.

props.name: children
props.description: Content that is revealed and hidden by the `open` prop.

props.name: contentClassName
props.description: Class names for the clipping wrapper around the children (put padding on a child inside, not here, or the closed state keeps it).

props.name: fade
props.description: Fade the content in and out while the height changes (default true).

props.name: unmountOnExit
props.description: Remove the children from the tree once the close transition has ended (and mount them again on open).

props.description: Disables the trigger so the panel cannot be toggled.

props.name: keepMounted
props.description: Keep the content in the tree while closed (the default removes it once the close animation ends).

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the panel opens or closes.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Use with `onOpenChange`.

props.name: variant
props.description: default: bare · surface: bordered card · ghost: soft hover and open background.

CollapsibleContent.description: Animated panel of a `Collapsible`. Padding goes on the inner box so the closed height is 0.

props.name: keepMounted
props.description: Override the root's `keepMounted` for this panel.

CollapsibleTrigger.description: Button that toggles its `Collapsible`; sets `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render the child (your own button) and only add the ARIA wiring and click handling.

props.name: icon
props.description: Turning chevron after the label, or `false` for none (ignored with `asChild`).

Combobox.description: Searchable select built on Popover + cmdk, with multi-select chips and creatable options.

props.name: options
props.description: Options to choose from; each has a `value`, a `label` and optional description, icon, group and disabled flag.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: Id(s) of the element(s) that describe the trigger (hint, error text).

props.name: aria-invalid
props.description: Overrides the invalid state announced to assistive technology; normally set `invalid` instead.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the trigger when there is no visible label.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Id(s) of the element(s) that label the trigger.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the trigger button.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Show a clear button while something is selected; Delete also clears (Backspace too, when single).

props.name: clearLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the clear button. Default "Clear".

props.name: confirmBackspace
props.description:
Multiple only: Backspace on the focused field first marks the last chip (announced politely) and a second press
removes it, so a held key cannot empty the field. Default false: Backspace removes the last chip at once.

props.name: contentClassName
props.description: Classes for the popover list.

props.name: creatable
props.description: Offer "Create …" when the query matches no option.

props.name: createLabel
props.description: Builds the "Create …" row label from the current query; the default reads `Create "query"`.

props.name: defaultInputValue
props.description: Initial search text when uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially selected value when uncontrolled.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the trigger so the list cannot be opened.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when the query matches nothing. Default "No results".

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Legacy name of `emptyState`.

props.name: filter
props.description:
How options are matched against the search text. Omit for the built-in fuzzy match. `false` shows `options` exactly
as given (server-side search: pass the results for the current `inputValue`). A function keeps the options it accepts.

props.name: id
props.description: `id` of the trigger, so a `<label htmlFor>` or `Field` can point at it.

props.name: inputValue
props.description: The search text, to control it (for async search). Cleared to "" when the list closes.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the combobox invalid: error border and `aria-invalid`. Inherited from a surrounding `Field` when omitted.

props.name: loading
props.description: Options are being fetched: shows a loading row (or a spinner beside the search text while options are on screen).

props.name: loadingState
props.description: Text of the loading row. Default "Loading…".

props.name: maxChips
props.description: Max chips shown in the trigger before collapsing into "+N" (multiple only).

props.name: multiple
props.description: Single-select mode (the default); `value` and `onValueChange` then work with one string.

props.name: onCreate
props.description:
Called with the query when the user picks "Create …". The new value is selected
automatically: return a different string (e.g. a generated id) to select that instead.

props.name: onInputValueChange
props.description: Called as the search text changes. Debounce the fetch on your side (see `useDebouncedValue`).

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the list opens or closes (selection, Escape, outside click).

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the option `value` the user picked (or the created value).

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state of the list. Use with `onOpenChange`.

props.name: openOnFocus
props.description: Open the list when the field gets keyboard focus (pointer clicks keep their normal toggle).

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Trigger text while nothing is selected.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the combobox required. Inherited from a surrounding `Field` when omitted.

props.name: searchable
props.description: Hide the search input.

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.description: Placeholder of the search input inside the list.

props.name: size
props.description: Control height and text size; match the neighbouring inputs.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected value (an option `value`); an empty string means nothing selected.

props.name: variant
props.description: `outline` (default) is the bordered box; `filled` is a tinted surface with a hidden border.

Command.description: Command palette root (cmdk). Handles filtering and keyboard navigation.

CommandDialog.description: Top-anchored command palette in a modal dialog.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the palette panel.

props.name: commandProps
props.description: Props passed to the inner `Command` (e.g. `filter`, `shouldFilter`, `loop`).

props.name: description
props.description: Accessible description (visually hidden).

props.name: showFooter
props.description: Render the keyboard hints footer. Default true.

props.name: title
props.description: Accessible title (visually hidden).

CommandEmpty.description: Shown when no items match (beside the list, in a live region, so the list never has to be an empty listbox).

CommandFooter.description: Keyboard hints bar: ↑↓ navigate, ↵ select, esc close.

CommandInput.description: Search field with a leading icon.

props.name: loading
props.description: Replace the search icon with a spinner.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Content rendered at the right of the input (e.g. an esc hint).

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.description: Classes for the wrapper around the input and its icon.

props.name: description
props.description: Secondary line under the label.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon shown at the start of the item.

props.name: shortcut
props.description:
Shortcut hint. A keys spec ("mod+n", "g t") renders platform-aware Kbd chips; an array renders
one Kbd per entry (e.g. ["⌘", "N"]); any other node (or a glyph string like "⌘N") renders as text.

CommandList.description:
Scrollable results list; animates its height as results change. While no item matches, the (then option-less)
listbox is hidden and the `CommandEmpty` message shows in a polite live region beside it, because a listbox without
options is invalid ARIA.

CommandPaletteFromRegistry.description: Command palette listing every registered shortcut as a runnable command.

props.name: children
props.description: Extra items rendered above the registry groups.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the palette panel.

props.name: commandProps
props.description: Props passed to the inner `Command` (e.g. `filter`, `shouldFilter`, `loop`).

props.name: description
props.description: Accessible description (visually hidden).

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when nothing matches. Default "No commands found".

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Legacy name of `emptyState`.

props.name: keys
props.description: Shortcut that toggles the palette. Default "mod+k"; `null` disables.

props.name: onRun
props.description: Called after a command runs.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder of the search input.

props.name: showFooter
props.description: Render the keyboard hints footer. Default true.

props.name: title
props.description: Accessible title (visually hidden).

CommentComposer.description: Comment input: Markdown text, ⌘/Ctrl+Enter to send, Escape to cancel.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called with the trimmed text when the user submits (button or Enter); the field is then cleared.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focuses the field on mount.

props.name: compact
props.description: Legacy form of `density="compact"`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial draft text when uncontrolled.

props.name: density
props.description: `compact` hides the buttons until the field is focused or has text. Default `normal`.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label of the field. Default "Comment".

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Called when the user cancels (Cancel button or Escape); setting it shows the Cancel button.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the draft text as it changes.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder of the text field.

props.name: quote
props.description: Excerpt shown above the field.

props.name: submitLabel
props.description: Text of the submit button.

props.name: value
props.description: Draft text (controlled).

CommentsPanel.description: Side panel of comment threads anchored to quoted excerpts, with Open / Resolved / All filters and a selection composer.

props.name: threads
props.description: Threads to list, in display order.

props.name: actions
props.description: Header actions (e.g. a close button).

props.name: activeThreadId
props.description: Id of the highlighted thread (e.g. the one whose anchor holds the cursor).

props.name: currentUserId
props.description: Id of the current user; their comments get edit and delete actions.

props.name: defaultFilter
props.description: Initial filter when uncontrolled.

props.name: filter
props.description: Controlled filter: open threads, resolved threads or all. Use with `onFilterChange`.

props.name: now
props.description: Reference time for relative timestamps ("5m ago"); pass it to keep renders deterministic.

props.name: onCreateThread
props.description: Creates a thread anchored to the selection.

props.name: onDelete
props.description: Called with the thread id and comment id when a comment is deleted.

props.name: onEdit
props.type: (threadId: string, commentId: string, body: string) => void
props.description: Called with the thread id, comment id and new text when a comment is edited.

props.name: onFilterChange
props.description: Called with the new filter when the user switches tabs.

props.name: onFocusAnchor
props.description: Called with the thread when the user asks to jump to its anchor in the document.

props.name: onReact
props.type: (threadId: string, commentId: string, emoji: string) => void
props.description: Enables reactions.

props.name: onReply
props.description: Called with the thread id and the reply text when a reply is submitted.

props.name: onResolve
props.description: Called with the thread id and the new resolved state when a thread is resolved or reopened.

props.name: reactionOptions
props.description: Emoji offered in the reaction picker (needs `onReact`).

props.name: role
props.description: What the current user may do: `owner` and `editor` resolve any thread, `commenter` resolves their own and replies, `viewer` can only read.

props.name: selection
props.description: Current editor selection; enables "Comment on selection".

props.name: title
props.description: Panel heading.

CommentThread.description: A comment thread: quoted anchor, comments (Markdown), reactions, reply box and resolve / reopen.

props.name: thread
props.description: The thread to render: its comments, resolved state and optional anchor quote.

props.name: active
props.description: Highlight (e.g. the thread whose anchor holds the cursor).

props.name: currentUserId
props.description: Id of the current user; their comments get edit and delete actions.

props.name: now
props.description: Reference time for relative timestamps.

props.name: onDelete
props.description: Called with the thread id and comment id when a comment is deleted.

props.name: onEdit
props.type: (threadId: string, commentId: string, body: string) => void
props.description: Called with the thread id, comment id and new text when a comment is edited.

props.name: onFocusAnchor
props.description: Called with the thread when the user asks to jump to its anchor in the document.

props.name: onReact
props.type: (threadId: string, commentId: string, emoji: string) => void
props.description: Enables reactions.

props.name: onReply
props.description: Called with the thread id and the reply text when a reply is submitted.

props.name: onResolve
props.description: Called with the thread id and the new resolved state when a thread is resolved or reopened.

props.name: reactionOptions
props.description: Emoji offered in the reaction picker (needs `onReact`).

props.name: role
props.description: What the current user may do: `owner` and `editor` resolve any thread, `commenter` resolves their own and replies, `viewer` can only read.

ComparisonTable.description: Product-vs-alternatives matrix with check / cross / partial marks and numbered footnotes.

props.name: products
props.description: Columns of the table; each has an `id`, a `name` and an optional `highlight` for your own product.

props.name: rows
props.description: Feature rows; each has a `feature` and `values` keyed by product id (`yes`, `no`, `partial` or text).

props.name: caption
props.description: Visually hidden caption that names the table for assistive technology.

props.name: footnotes
props.description: Footnotes listed under the table; rows reference them by id.

ComposerToolbar.description:
Composer footer layout: add context, mode and effort on the left; model, voice and send on the right; narrow widths collapse extras into an overflow popover.
This is the slot-based, agent-specific layout; `PromptInputToolbar` (prompt-input) is the plain flex row for a basic `PromptInput`.
Use `ComposerToolbar` when you need the named slots or overflow collapse, `PromptInputToolbar` otherwise.

props.name: addContext
props.description: Add-context control (always visible).

props.name: collapse
props.description: Move collapsible slots into an overflow popover: "auto" measures the toolbar width. Default "auto".

props.name: collapseBelow
props.description: Width in px below which "auto" collapses. Default 440.

props.name: effort
props.description: Effort slot (collapses).

props.name: meta
props.description: Right-hand meta such as a context meter (collapses).

props.name: mode
props.description: Mode switcher slot (collapses).

props.name: model
props.description: Model pill (always visible).

props.name: overflowLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the overflow button. Default "More options".

props.name: submit
props.description: Send / stop button (always visible).

props.name: tools
props.description: Extra left-hand tools (collapse).

props.name: voice
props.description: Voice button (always visible).

ConfirmDialog.description: Ready-made confirmation dialog with async-aware confirm.

props.name: title
props.description: Dialog heading; also its accessible name.

props.name: cancelLabel
props.description: Text of the cancel button.

props.name: children
props.description: Extra content between the header and the footer.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the dialog panel.

props.name: confirmLabel
props.description: Text of the confirm button.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting text under the title; also the accessible description.

props.name: icon
props.description: Featured icon shown above the title (tone-coloured).

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Called when the cancel button is clicked; the dialog closes either way.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: May return a promise; the confirm button shows a spinner until it settles. Throw to keep the dialog open.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the dialog opens or closes (confirm, cancel, Escape; closing is blocked while a confirm is pending).

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Use with `onOpenChange`.

props.name: tone
props.description: `destructive` turns the icon and confirm button red. Default `neutral`. `default` is a deprecated alias of `neutral`.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Element that opens the dialog (wrapped with `asChild`).

ConflictResolver.description: Side-by-side "Yours / Theirs" dialog for resolving a sync conflict.

props.name: theirs
props.description: The other version of the content, with its source and update time.

props.name: yours
props.description: Your local version of the content, with its source and update time.

props.name: className
props.description: Class name for the dialog content.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when `open` is not controlled.

props.name: description
props.description: Helper text under the heading.
props.default: "This item was edited on two devices before they synced. Choose which version to keep."

props.name: now
props.description: Reference time for relative update labels; set it in tests and SSR for stable output.

props.name: onKeepMine
props.description: Called when the user keeps your version.

props.name: onKeepTheirs
props.description: Called when the user keeps the other version.

props.name: onMerge
props.description: Shows a "Merge both" action.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the dialog opens or closes.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state of the dialog.

props.name: title
props.description: Dialog heading.

ConnectedAppList.description: Connected apps and agents with a detail drawer (scopes, holder key, push per device, activity) and revoke.

props.name: apps
props.description: Connected apps, one row each; pressing a row opens its detail with scopes and devices.

props.name: definitions
props.description: Extra or overriding scope definitions, merged over the built-in set, for the scope labels in the detail.

props.name: empty
props.description: Content shown when there is nothing to list.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when there are no apps. Default "No connected apps".

props.name: now
props.description: Reference time for relative labels; set it in tests and SSR for stable output.

props.name: onPushChange
props.type: (app: ConnectedApp, deviceId: string, enabled: boolean) => void
props.description: Called with the app, the device id and the new state when the user flips a device's push switch.

props.name: onRevoke
props.description: May return a promise; the confirm dialog waits for it.

ConnectedAppRow.description: One connected app/agent: icon, granted scope count, last activity and expiry.

props.name: app
props.description: The connected app to show (name, scopes, last used, devices).

props.name: now
props.description: Reference time for relative labels; set it in tests and SSR for stable output.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Called with the app when the row is pressed to open its detail.

ConnectionMethodChooser.description: Hosted vs local radio cards with pros and cons.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially selected way (`hosted` or `local`) when `value` is not controlled.

props.name: info
props.description: Override copy per way.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the group invalid: error styling on the items and `aria-invalid`. Inherited from a surrounding `Field` when omitted.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the way the user selects.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected way: `hosted` or `local`.

props.name: ways
props.description: Ways offered. Default both.

ConnectionRegistry.description: Saved remote gateways list with an editor, connection test, default and remove.

props.name: connections
props.description: Controlled list of saved connections.

props.name: createId
props.description: Id generator for new entries.

props.name: defaultConnections
props.description: Initial connections when `connections` is not controlled.

props.name: onConnectionsChange
props.description: Called with the full list after the user adds, edits, removes or defaults a connection.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Called with the connection when the user removes it.

props.name: onSave
props.description: Called with the connection and whether it is new when the user saves the editor.

props.name: onSetDefault
props.description: Called with the connection when the user makes it the default.

props.name: onTest
props.description: Runs a connection check for the editor's current values.

ConnectionState.description: Full-panel host states: unresponsive / disconnected (reconnect link + spinner) and load error (retry).

props.name: state
props.description: Why the connection is shown: `unresponsive`, `disconnected` or `error`; picks the default title and description.

props.name: description
props.description: Replaces the default description of the state.

props.name: details
props.description: Error details shown in a mono block (error state).

props.name: fullPanel
props.description: Fill the parent panel and center the content. Default true.

props.name: onReconnect
props.description: Called when the user presses Reconnect; the link is hidden when unset.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Called when the user presses Retry in the error state; the button is hidden when unset.

props.name: reconnecting
props.description: Shows a spinner in place of the reconnect link.

props.name: title
props.description: Replaces the default title of the state.

ConnectorAccounts.description: Multiple accounts per connector: inline alias rename, status, repair, folded retired accounts and add.

props.name: accounts
props.description: Accounts linked to the connector, each with alias, status and identity.

props.name: connectorName
props.description: Connector name used in the heading ("Slack accounts"); the heading reads "Accounts" when unset.

props.name: onAdd
props.description: Called when the user presses Add account; the button is hidden when unset.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Called with the account id when the user presses Remove on a non-retired account.

props.name: onRename
props.description: Rename an account. Throw to show an error.

props.name: onRepair
props.description: Called with the account id when the user presses Repair on an expired or errored account.

ConnectorDirectory.description: Catalog of connectors: category picker and a grid of cards with ways and install/connect.

props.name: entries
props.description: Connectors to list, each with name, description, category and install state.

props.name: categories
props.description: Category order; derived from entries when omitted.

props.name: category
props.description: Controlled category filter; `null` shows every category.

props.name: defaultCategory
props.description: Initial category filter when `category` is not controlled.

props.name: onCategoryChange
props.description: Called with the category (or `null` for all) when the user picks a filter.

props.name: onInstall
props.description:
Called when the user installs a connector that is not installed yet; may return a promise to keep the button
busy.

props.name: onManage
props.description: Called when the user presses Manage on an installed connector.

props.name: search
props.description: Filter by name/description.

ConsentScreen.description: Authorization/approval screen: who is asking, what they want, and an expiring Approve.

props.name: app
props.description: The app asking for access (name, logo, publisher, verification).

props.name: scopes
props.description: Requested scopes: id strings (`read:orders`) or objects with constraints.

props.name: approveLabel
props.description: Label of the approve button. Default "Approve".

props.name: credentialLabel
props.description: Label above the credential list. Default "Choose a credential to present".

props.name: credentialRequired
props.description: Require a credential choice before Approve. Default true when credentials are given.

props.name: credentials
props.description: Credentials the user can present (radio list; none preselected).

props.name: defaultOptionalGranted
props.description: Optional scope ids granted at first; none by default.

props.name: defaultShareProfile
props.description: Initial state of the share-profile switch. Default false.

props.name: definitions
props.description: Extra or overriding scope definitions (label, description, icon, risk), merged over the built-in set.

props.name: denyLabel
props.description: Label of the deny button. Default "Deny".

props.name: expiresAt
props.description: When the request expires (ms or Date).

props.name: heldScopes
props.description: Scope ids the app already holds; tagged "Already granted".

props.name: onApprove
props.description: May return a promise; buttons show progress until it settles.

props.name: onDeny
props.description: Called when the user denies the request; may return a promise, and the buttons show progress until it settles.

props.name: onExpire
props.description: Called once when the request reaches `expiresAt`.

props.name: optionalScopes
props.description: Scope ids the user may decline. Default-deny: none are pre-granted unless in `defaultOptionalGranted`.

props.name: profile
props.description: Offer to share this profile (off by default).

props.name: scopeLabels
props.description: Untrusted app-supplied labels by scope id, used only when no definition matches.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading of the screen; defaults to a sentence naming the app.

Container.description: Centres content and caps its width (`size`), with responsive horizontal padding. Extra props are spread to the root.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as the child element (e.g. `<main>` or `<section>`) instead of a `<div>`, keeping the container styles.

props.name: size
props.description: Maximum content width: `sm` 48rem to `xl` 90rem, or `full` for no limit.

ContainerList.description: Docker containers grouped by Compose project: state, ports, a limit warning, CPU and memory per container.

props.name: containers
props.description: Containers to list, grouped by Compose project; each with a name, state, ports, CPU and memory.

props.name: accent
props.description: Categorical colour for icons, port badges and CPU bars. Default "cyan".

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Initially expanded group names when `expanded` is not controlled.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when `containers` is empty.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Expanded Compose groups (by name). Uncontrolled default: every group expanded.

props.name: formatBytes
props.description: Memory text. Default decimal units ("312 MB").

props.name: groupDescription
props.description: Group subtitle lead. Default "Started together by Docker Compose".

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the list. Default "Containers".

props.name: limitWarnAt
props.description: Warn when memory reaches this share of the container's limit. Default 0.8.

props.name: loading
props.description: Data is on its way. With no containers yet the list shows placeholder rows; with containers the root is only marked busy.

props.name: loadingRows
props.description: Placeholder container rows (under one placeholder group header) while loading. Default 3.

props.name: now
props.description: Reference time for "Up 5 hours" (pass it for deterministic output). Default: the live clock, refreshed every 30 seconds.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Called with the expanded group names when the user expands or collapses a group.

props.name: onStop
props.description: Stops a container (after confirmation). May return a promise; the dialog waits for it.

ContainerSummary.description: Container overview: total memory with lowest/peak, a per-container breakdown and CPU, limit, network and port tiles.

props.name: containers
props.description: Containers to summarise: totals, the breakdown by container and the one closest to its limit.

props.name: accent
props.description: Categorical colour for the tiles. Default "cyan".

props.name: breakdownLimit
props.description: Rows in the "By Container" breakdown before the rest fold into "Other". Default 6.

props.name: formatBytes
props.description: Memory text formatter. Default decimal units ("312 MB").

props.name: history
props.description: Recent total-memory readings (bytes) for the Lowest / Peak rows.

props.name: limitWarnAt
props.description: Tint the "Closest to Its Limit" bar as a warning from this share. Default 0.8.

props.name: loading
props.description: Data is on its way. With no containers yet the total, breakdown and tiles show placeholders; with containers the root is only marked busy.

props.name: maxPorts
props.description: Published ports shown before "+N". Default 4.

props.name: runtimeName
props.description: Where the containers run, for the heading ("4 containers in Docker"). Default "Docker".

props.name: label
props.description: Text or content shown inside the line. `children` works too.

props.name: labelPosition
props.description: Where the label sits along the line.

props.name: variant
props.description: Line style.

ContextBanner.description: Banner with an icon, message, name pill, action and optional expandable command output (a compact `InlineAlert`).

props.name: action
props.description: Call-to-action button with a label, click handler and optional loading state.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Whether `output` starts revealed.

props.name: icon
props.description: Replaces the default icon of the variant.

props.name: name
props.description: Name rendered as a mono pill after the message (worktree, branch…).

props.name: nameIcon
props.description: Icon inside the name pill.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called when the user dismisses the banner; the close button is hidden when unset.

props.name: output
props.description: Command output revealed by a "Show output" toggle.

props.name: outputLabel
props.description: Label of the toggle that reveals `output`.

props.name: variant

DeviceBatteryList.description:
Bluetooth device batteries: a summary card (connected count, lowest battery, away devices, settings link)
over a table of devices by kind, with nested rows for separately charged parts.

Dialog.description:
Modal dialog root.

Dialog vs Sheet vs Drawer: `Dialog` is a centred modal (a bottom sheet on phones) for a focused task or decision;
`Sheet` slides in from an edge for navigation, detail or filter panels; `Drawer` (`./drawer`) is a touch-first
bottom sheet with drag-to-dismiss and snap points. Use `AlertDialog` / `ConfirmDialog` for interrupting confirmations.

DialogContent.description: Dialog panel: centered modal on desktop, bottom sheet on mobile.

props.name: overlayClassName
props.description: Classes for the dimmed backdrop behind the dialog.

props.name: showClose
props.description: Show the top-right close button. Default true.

props.name: size
props.description: Dialog max width from `sm` to `xl`; `full` fills the viewport minus a margin. Below the `sm` breakpoint dialogs are always full width.

DialogFooter.description: Action row; stacks full-width on mobile.

props.name: bordered
props.description: Separate the footer with a top border and subtle background.

DialogHeader.description: Title block with optional featured icon.

props.description: Alignment of the icon, title and description.

props.name: icon
props.description: Featured icon shown above the title.

props.name: tone
props.description: Colour of the featured `icon` badge.

DialogProvider.description:
Mount once near the root to enable `useDialogs()`: promise-based `confirm`, `prompt` and `choose`
built on `ConfirmDialog` and `Dialog`. One dialog shows at a time; later calls wait in a queue.

props.name: children
props.description: The app subtree that can call `useDialogs()`.

DictionaryCard.description: Dictionary entry: word, phonetic, frequency and senses grouped by part of speech with examples.

props.name: phonetic
props.description: Pronunciation text shown under the word (for example IPA).

DirectionProvider.description:
Tells Sutra and its Radix primitives which way the text runs. Put one at the app root (no `dir`: it follows `<html dir>`
live) or wrap a subtree with a `dir` to force it; read it with `useDirection`.

props.name: children
props.description: The subtree that reads the direction.

props.name: dir
props.description:
Force the direction of this subtree. It renders a `display: contents` element carrying `dir`, so logical utilities,
`rtl:` variants and Radix keyboard handling all follow it, and nests (a chart can force `ltr` inside an RTL page).
Omit it to follow the document (`<html dir>`) and render no element.

DividedGrid.description:
One bordered, rounded box whose cells are separated by hairlines instead of being separate cards: a tool grid, a feature
list, a set of options. Works for any number of cells: the box clips the last column's and row's lines, so a short last row
leaves no stray divider.

props.name: children
props.description: `DividedGridItem`s. Anything else is wrapped in a cell as it is.

props.name: columns
props.description: Columns at the widest size: 1 → 2 → `columns` as the space grows. Default 3.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown instead of the cells when there are none (and nothing is loading).

props.name: items
props.description: Data-driven alternative to `children`; both can be mixed (items first).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the list.

props.name: loading
props.description: Data is on its way: with no cells, placeholder cells stand in; with cells, the root is marked busy.

props.name: loadingCells
props.description: Placeholder cells shown while loading with no cells. Default: two rows.

props.name: numbered
props.description: Show "01", "02" … in each cell.

props.name: query
props.description: What `columns` measures: the viewport (default) or the grid's own width (CSS container queries, cells stay at least about 200px wide), for grids beside a sidebar.

props.name: renderLink
props.description: Router link renderer for cells with an `href`.

props.description: Up to three lines; longer text is clamped.

props.description: Disables the cell: dimmed and not interactive.

props.name: href
props.description: Makes the cell a link. Unsafe URLs (`javascript:`) are ignored and the cell stays static.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon shown in a small tile above the title (decorative: the title names the cell).

props.name: meta
props.description: Small muted line at the bottom of the cell ("12 MB limit").

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called when the cell is clicked (after `onClick`, unless that prevented the default). Alone it makes the cell a button; with `href` it runs before the link opens.

props.name: rel
props.description: Link `rel` when `href` is set.

props.description: Link `target` when `href` is set.

props.description: Link target of the logo.

props.name: links
props.description: Links in the header, after the logo.
props.default: [ { label: "Guides", href: "#guides" }, { label: "Components", href: "#components" }, { label: "Blocks", href: "#blocks" }, { label: "API", href: "#api" }, ]

props.name: logo
props.description: Brand mark in the top-left; the default is the Sutra logo.

props.name: onSearchSelect
props.description: Called with the item the user picked in the search palette.

props.name: onThemeChange
props.description: Called with the new mode when the theme button is clicked.

props.name: onVersionChange
props.description: Called with the version the user picked.

props.name: renderLink
props.description: Renders every link in place of the default `<a>`, e.g. to use your router's Link.

props.name: searchItems
props.description: Items listed in the search palette; each has a `value`, a `label` and an optional section and href.

props.name: sticky
props.description: Pins the header to the top of the page.

props.name: theme
props.description: Current color mode. When uncontrolled the header toggles the `dark` class on <html>.

props.name: version
props.description: Controlled selected version. Use with `onVersionChange`.

props.name: versions
props.description: Documentation versions offered in the version select; omit to hide it.

DocsSidebar.description: Documentation navigation with filterable collapsible sections (or a TreeView).

props.name: active
props.description: Legacy name of `value`.

props.name: defaultActive
props.description: Legacy name of `defaultValue`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially active link id when uncontrolled. Default "installation".

props.name: mode
props.description: `sections`: collapsible groups of links. `tree`: a keyboard-navigable TreeView.

props.name: onNavigate
props.description: Legacy name of `onValueChange`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the id of the link the user navigates to.

props.name: searchable
props.description: Show a filter field at the top.

props.name: sections
props.description: Documentation sections; each has an `id`, a `label` and `links`.

props.name: value
props.description: Currently active link id.

DocumentOutline.description: Heading tree of a document: indented by level, active highlight, click to jump, optional filter.

props.name: headings
props.description: Headings in document order, each with a level, text and id.

props.name: activeId
props.description: `id` (or `line-<n>`) of the current heading.

props.name: emptyHint
props.description: Content shown when there is nothing to list.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when there are no headings.

props.name: filterable
props.description: Show a filter box. Default: when there are more than 8 headings.

props.name: maxLevel
props.description: Deepest level listed. Default 6.

props.name: onNavigate
props.description: Called with the heading when the user presses an entry.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading shown above the list. Default "Outline"; `null` hides it.

DonutChart.description: Donut (ring) chart with segments, center label, toggleable legend and tooltip.

props.name: data
props.description: Rows to plot; each has the `index` key (name) and the `valueKey` field (number).

props.name: index
props.description: Key of the segment name.

props.name: animate
props.description:
Eases the hover dimming and the colour of the segments over 500 ms; off under reduced motion. There is no
entrance animation, and a segment changes its shape (data or the hidden set) at once.

props.name: centerLabel
props.description: Small caption under the center value.

props.name: centerValue
props.description: Center value. Defaults to the formatted total. Pass null to hide.

props.name: colorFor
props.description: Returns a colour for a segment (a token name or CSS colour), or `undefined` to use the palette colour.

props.name: colors
props.description: Colors in segment order (defaults to the chart palette).

props.name: defaultHiddenSeries
props.description: Initially hidden segment names when uncontrolled.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Content shown instead of the ring when there is no data.

props.name: hiddenSeries
props.description: Controlled list of hidden segment names (toggled from the legend). Use with `onHiddenSeriesChange`.

props.name: iconFor
props.description: Icon per segment (an app icon) shown in the legend rows. Setting it switches the legend to a `BreakdownList`.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the chart.

props.name: legend
props.description: Legend placement: below the ring, to its right, or `false` to hide it.

props.name: legendInteractive
props.description: Let legend entries toggle segments. Default true.

props.name: legendValues
props.description:
Show values in the legend: it becomes a `BreakdownList` (one row per segment, value right-aligned).
`true` / `"value"`: the formatted value; `"percent"`: the share of the visible total; `"both"`: value and percent.
Default false (the compact chip legend).

props.name: loading
props.description: Data is on its way: with no data, a placeholder ring (and legend) of the same size; with data, the root is marked busy.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale for the default number formatting. Pass one explicitly when the server and the browser must agree (SSR). Defaults to the runtime locale.

props.name: onHiddenSeriesChange
props.description: Called with the hidden segment names when a legend entry is toggled.

props.name: padAngle
props.description: Gap between segments in degrees. Default 1.5.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter in px. Default 200.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Ring thickness in px. Default size × 0.14.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Shows a tooltip with the name, value and share on hover or focus.

props.name: valueFormatter
props.description: Formats values in the tooltip, legend and centre. Default is the localized number.

props.name: valueKey
props.description: Key of the segment value. Default "value".

DownloadBadge.description: Weights cache state on `Badge`: downloading 42% (with bar), cached, partial, failed, not downloaded.

props.name: status
props.description: Download state (`downloading`, `cached`, `partial`, `failed` or `missing`); sets the badge text, icon and tone.

props.name: progress
props.description: 0–100 for downloading / partial.

props.name: size
props.description: Size text, e.g. "54 GB".

Drawer.description:
Bottom sheet with drag-to-dismiss, optional snap points, scroll lock and focus return (Radix Dialog).

Dialog vs Sheet vs Drawer: `Dialog` is a centred modal for a focused task or decision; `Sheet` is a panel
that slides in from any edge (side navigation, detail or filter panels); `Drawer` is a touch-first bottom sheet
with a grabber, drag-to-dismiss and snap points. Drawer's Header, Title, Description, Body and Footer are the
Sheet parts with drawer spacing.

props.name: children
props.description: The drawer parts: a `DrawerTrigger` and a `DrawerContent`.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultSnapPoint
props.description: Initially active snap point when uncontrolled; one of `snapPoints`.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Allow closing by drag, Escape and scrim click. Default true.

props.name: modal
props.description: Modal (scroll lock, focus trap, inert page). Default true.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the drawer opens or closes (drag, Escape, scrim click, a close button).

props.name: onSnapPointChange
props.description: Called with the snap point the sheet settled on after a drag.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Use with `onOpenChange`.

props.name: snapPoint
props.description: Active snap point (one of `snapPoints`).

props.name: snapPoints
props.description: Heights as fractions of the viewport, e.g. `[0.5, 1]`. Omit for a content-sized sheet.

DrawerBody.description: Scrollable content area. A drag never starts here while it is scrolled down. `SheetBody` with drawer spacing.

DrawerClose.description: Closes the drawer when clicked (works even when `dismissible={false}`).

DrawerContent.description: The sheet panel: grabber, drag-to-dismiss (80px or a fast flick), rubber-band upward, snap points.

props.name: overlayClassName
props.description: Classes for the dimmed backdrop behind the sheet.

props.name: showClose
props.description: Show a close button at the top end (top-right in left-to-right). Default false.

props.name: showHandle
props.description: Show the grabber handle. Default true.

DrawerFooter.description: Action row pinned to the bottom of the sheet. `SheetFooter` with a top border and drawer spacing.

DrawerHeader.description: Pinned header (does not scroll with the body); drag it to move the sheet. `SheetHeader` with drawer spacing.

DrawerTrigger.description: Element that opens the drawer (same as `SheetTrigger`).

DropdownMenu.description: Dropdown menu root: Radix `DropdownMenu.Root` with the reading direction filled in.

DropdownMenuCheckboxItem.description: Toggleable item with a check indicator.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Shortcut hint shown at the end of the row (display only: it does not bind the keys).
