DropdownMenuItem.description: Actionable menu row with optional icon, description and shortcut.

props.name: description
props.description: Secondary line under the label.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon shown at the start of the row.

props.name: inset
props.description: Indents the row to line up with rows that have an icon.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Shortcut hint shown at the end of the row (display only: it does not bind the keys).

props.name: tone
props.description: `destructive` colours the row red for dangerous actions. Default `neutral`.

props.name: variant
props.description: Legacy name of `tone`.

props.name: inset
props.description: Indents the label to line up with rows that have an icon.

DropdownMenuShortcut.description: Keyboard shortcut hint aligned to the right of an item.

DropdownMenuSubTrigger.description: Item that opens a nested sub-menu.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon shown at the start of the row.

props.name: inset
props.description: Indents the row to line up with rows that have an icon.

Dropzone.description: Drag-and-drop file area that also opens the file picker on click, Enter or Space.

props.name: accept
props.description: Accepted types, as for `<input accept>`: extensions (".pdf") and/or MIME types ("image/*"), comma separated. Others are rejected.

props.name: compact
props.description: Legacy form of `density="compact"`.

props.name: currentCount
props.description: Files already selected elsewhere, counted against `maxFiles`.

props.name: density
props.description: `compact` is a single-row layout for tight spaces. Default `normal`.

props.name: directory
props.description:
Upload whole folders: clicking opens a folder picker (`webkitdirectory`) and dropped folders are
walked recursively. Every file is validated on its own and carries its `relativePath`
(see `getFileRelativePath`). Where the browser can't pick folders, clicking falls back to the file
picker and the hint says why.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables dropping and picking.

props.name: hint
props.description: Defaults to a description of `accept` / `maxSize`.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon above the title. Defaults to an upload icon.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: Ref to the hidden `<input type="file">`, e.g. to open the picker from your own button.

props.name: maxFiles
props.description: Most files accepted per drop or pick (counted with `currentCount`); extra files are rejected.

props.name: maxSize
props.description: Largest accepted file in bytes; larger files are rejected.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Accept more than one file per drop or pick.

props.name: name
props.description: Name for the underlying file input. With it, the accepted files stay on the input so a native form post sends them.

props.name: onDrop
props.description: Called with accepted files and rejections after a drop or pick.

props.name: title
props.description: Headline of the drop target. Defaults to a prompt to drop or choose files.

EditorStatusBar.description: Editor footer: save status and presence on the left; counts, reading time, cursor and mode on the right.

props.name: characters
props.description: Explicit character count (overrides `text`).

props.name: cursor
props.description: 1-based cursor position.

props.name: mode
props.description: Mode chip, e.g. "Live" or "Offline".

props.name: modeTone
props.description: Colour of the mode chip: `live`, `offline`, `neutral` or `warning`.

props.name: presence
props.description: Left, after the status: e.g. `PresenceAvatars` or `TypingIndicator`.

props.name: selectionLength
props.description: Selection length, shown as "(N selected)" after the cursor.

props.name: showCharacters
props.description: Shows the character count. Default true.

props.name: showPages
props.description: Shows the estimated page count. Default true.

props.name: showReadingTime
props.description: Shows the estimated reading time. Default true.

props.name: showWords
props.description: Shows the word count. Default true.

props.name: statsOptions
props.description: Options for counting words and reading time (reading speeds, CJK handling).

props.name: status
props.description: Left: usually a `SaveStatus`.

props.name: text
props.description: Document text; word/character counts, reading time and pages are derived from it.

props.name: words
props.description: Explicit word count (overrides `text`).

EditorToolbar.description:
Formatting toolbar (`role="toolbar"`) with roving tabindex (arrow keys, Home/End) and
overflow collapsing into a "More" menu when the container is too narrow.

props.name: end
props.description: Content pinned to the end that never collapses (e.g. an AI button).

props.name: moreLabel
props.description: Label of the overflow button. Default "More tools".

props.name: overflow
props.description: Collapse items that don't fit into a "More" menu. Default true.

props.name: size
props.description: Control size of the tools. Default "sm".

EditorToolbarButton.description: Toolbar tool: icon button with a tooltip (label + shortcut keys) and optional pressed state.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name, tooltip text and overflow-menu label.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon of the button.

props.name: pressed
props.description: Toggle state (sets `aria-pressed`).

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Keys spec for the tooltip ("mod+b").

props.name: showLabel
props.description: Show the label next to the icon.

props.name: tooltipSide
props.description: Tooltip side. Default "bottom".

EditorToolbarMenu.description: Dropdown tool (e.g. Insert ▸ Math, Mermaid, Callout) whose items carry icon, description and shortcut.

props.name: items
props.description: Menu entries, each with a label, optional icon, shortcut and handler.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name and menu label of the trigger.

props.name: align
props.description: Alignment of the menu against the trigger.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the trigger.

props.name: contentClassName
props.description: Extra classes for the menu content.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the trigger.

props.name: footer
props.description: Extra content under the items (e.g. a hint).

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon of the trigger.

props.name: showLabel
props.description: Show the label text (default true); icon-only otherwise.

EditToolBody.description: File edit body: path (link / button) and a compact DiffCard.

props.name: path
props.description: Path of the edited file, shown in the diff header.

props.name: acceptLabel
props.description: Text of the accept button.

props.name: collapsedLines
props.description: Visible lines before the preview is capped. Default 12.

props.name: context
props.description: Unchanged lines kept around each change. Default 3.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Initial expanded state when uncontrolled.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Controlled expanded state of the preview. Use with `onExpandedChange`.

props.name: fileStatus
props.description: new-file / deleted-file presentation. Inferred from empty old/new values when omitted.

props.name: headerExtra
props.description: Extra header content (right side, before the stat).

props.name: newValue
props.description: Changed file content ("after").

props.name: oldValue
props.description: Original file content ("before").

props.name: onAccept
props.description: Called when the accept button is clicked; setting it shows the button.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Called when the preview is expanded or collapsed.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: When set, "Click to expand" calls this (e.g. open a full diff editor) instead of expanding inline.

props.name: onPathClick
props.description: Makes the path a button (e.g. open the file).

props.name: onReject
props.description: Called when the reject button is clicked; setting it shows the button.

props.name: pathHref
props.description: Makes the path a link.

props.name: rejectLabel
props.description: Text of the reject button.

EffortGlyph.description: Ascending bars glyph: `level + 1` of `count` bars filled.

props.name: level
props.description: 0-based filled level.

props.name: count
props.description: Total levels (bars). Default 4.

props.name: size
props.description: Glyph width and height in px.

EffortSlider.description: Discrete effort-level control: click or drag the bars, ← → keys, compact pill variant.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially selected level id when `value` is not controlled.

props.name: density
props.description: `"normal"` (default) shows a labelled track with a legend; `"compact"` is a small pill for the composer.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the slider.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name and visible caption. Default "Effort".

props.name: levels
props.description: Levels from lowest to highest, each with an id and label; defaults to the built-in set.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the level id when the user moves the slider.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Tooltip text; `null` hides it.
props.default: "Click or drag to set effort level"

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled id of the selected effort level.

props.name: variant
props.description: `compact` renders a small pill for the composer.

EmbedConsent.description: Privacy gate shown in place of a third-party embed until the user agrees to load it.

props.name: domain
props.description: Domain the embed loads from, shown in the notice (e.g. "youtube.com").

props.name: provider
props.description: Provider display name, e.g. "YouTube".

props.name: allowAlwaysLabel
props.description: Label of the "Always allow" menu action. Defaults to "Always allow {provider}".

props.name: children
props.description: The embed, rendered only after consent.

props.name: consented
props.description: Controlled consent for this embed.

props.name: defaultConsented
props.description: Initial consent when `consented` is not controlled.

props.name: description
props.description: Overrides the default "This will load content from … and may set cookies."

props.name: icon
props.description: Provider icon shown in the notice.

props.name: loadLabel
props.description: Label of the button that loads the embed. Default "Load".

props.name: onAllowAlways
props.description:
Fired with the consent key (`providerId`) when the user picks "Always allow". For providers whose
server is user-controlled (e.g. Mastodon) RichEmbed passes an origin-scoped key, `"<id>:<origin>"`.

props.name: onConsent
props.description: Fired when the user clicks Load (or Always allow).

props.name: preview
props.description: Local preview shown inside the gate (no network).

props.name: providerId
props.description: Stable id used for remembered consent. Defaults to the lower-cased provider name.

EmbedConsentProvider.description: Remembers which embed providers the user has "always allowed". Persistence is left to the app.

props.name: allowed
props.description: Allowed provider ids (controlled). Persist them in your app (e.g. settings).

props.name: children
props.description: App subtree whose `EmbedConsent` and `RichEmbed` gates read the shared list.

props.name: defaultAllowed
props.description: Initially allowed provider ids when `allowed` is not controlled.

props.name: onAllowedChange
props.description: Called with the full allowed list when the user picks "Always allow" on an embed.

props.name: markOnly
props.description: Render only the geometric mark.

props.name: size
props.description: Height-driven size of the lockup.

EmojiGlyph.description: An emoji as text that reads as ink on paper in the paper style: the hand-drawn art when there is one, otherwise the glyph filtered to one ink.

props.name: emoji
props.description: The emoji character. It stays in the DOM as text, so copy and paste and search still work.

props.name: ink
props.description:
`true` draws it as ink in every style, `false` keeps the colour glyph in the paper style; unset follows the style (ink in the paper style, colour otherwise).
An emoji with hand-drawn art (`hasInkEmoji`) shows the drawing, any other is filtered to one ink.

props.name: inkMotion
props.description:
Plays the drawing's motion once when the nearest interactive parent (the chip, the picker cell) is hovered or focused.
Reduced motion keeps it still; `outline` never moves.

props.name: inkPlayKey
props.description: Plays the drawing's motion once whenever it changes to a truthy value (also on mount), e.g. when a reaction is added.

props.name: inkVariant
props.description: Which ink drawing shows when the ink does: `solid` (filled, features cut out), `tint` (solid plus a tint for secondary parts) or `outline`.

EmojiPicker.description: A compact emoji picker with categories, keyword search and recently used emoji.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focuses the search field on mount.

props.name: bare
props.description: Drop the card surface (background, border, radius, shadow), e.g. when inside a popover.

props.name: categories
props.description: Categories to show, in order, instead of the full set.

props.name: columns
props.description: Number of grid columns.

props.name: defaultRecent
props.description: Initial recently used emoji when uncontrolled.

props.name: ink
props.description: Draw the emoji as ink: `true` in every style, `false` keeps the colour glyphs in the paper style; unset follows the style (ink in the paper style).

props.name: inkMotion
props.description: Plays an ink emoji's motion once when its cell is hovered or focused. Reduced motion keeps them still.

props.name: inkVariant
props.description: Which drawing the ink emoji show: `solid` (filled, features cut out), `tint` (solid plus a tint) or `outline` (monoline).

props.name: maxRecent
props.description: Maximum number of recent emoji kept.

props.name: onRecentChange
props.description: Called with the new recent list after a pick.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called with the picked emoji and its dictionary entry.

props.name: quickPicks
props.description: Emoji shown as a quick-pick row above the search field.

props.name: recent
props.description: Recently used emoji (controlled).

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.description: Placeholder of the search field.

EmojiReaction.description: A reaction pill showing an emoji and its count; highlighted when the user has reacted.

props.name: emoji
props.description: The emoji shown on the chip.

props.name: count
props.description: How many people reacted; shown beside the emoji, hidden at 0.

props.name: defaultReacted
props.description: Initial reacted state when uncontrolled.

props.name: ink
props.description:
Draw the emoji as ink: `true` in every style, `false` keeps the colour glyph in the paper style; unset follows the style
(ink in the paper style). Every emoji of the built-in set uses the hand-drawn `InkEmoji` art, any emoji outside it is filtered to one ink.

props.name: inkMotion
props.description: Moves the ink drawing: it plays once on hover and focus, and with the pop when the reaction is added. Reduced motion keeps it still.

props.name: inkVariant
props.description:
Which drawing shows when the emoji is drawn as ink: `solid` (filled, features cut out), `tint` (solid plus a tint for the
secondary parts) or `outline` (monoline).

props.name: onToggle
props.description: Called with the new reacted state when the chip is toggled.

props.name: playKey
props.description: Pops the emoji (and plays its ink motion) whenever it changes to a truthy value; `EmojiReactionBar` sets it for a reaction added from the picker.

props.name: reacted
props.description: Whether the current user has reacted (controlled).

props.name: size
props.description: Chip height and text size.

EmojiReactionBar.description: A row of reaction pills with an add-reaction button that opens an emoji picker.

props.name: addLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the add-reaction button.

props.name: defaultReactions
props.description: Initial reactions when uncontrolled.

props.name: ink
props.description: Draw the reactions and the picker as ink: `true` in every style, `false` keeps the colour glyphs in the paper style; unset follows the style (ink in the paper style).

props.name: inkMotion
props.description: Moves the ink emoji: once on hover and focus, and with the pop when a reaction is added (also from the picker). Reduced motion keeps them still.

props.name: inkVariant
props.description: Which drawing the ink emoji show in the chips and the picker: `solid` (filled, features cut out), `tint` (solid plus a tint) or `outline`.

props.name: onReact
props.description: Fired whenever the current user adds or removes a reaction.

props.name: onReactionsChange
props.description: Called with the full reaction list after the user adds or removes one.

props.name: presets
props.description: Quick picks shown at the top of the picker.

props.name: reactions
props.description: Reactions (controlled).

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Hide the add-reaction button.

props.name: size
props.description: Chip height and text size.

EmptyState.description:
Placeholder for an empty list, search or first-run screen.
`variant="welcome"` is the large greeting at the start of a conversation or workspace (see `ChatEmptyState`).

sizes.sm: root: gap-2 px-4 py-6 title: text-sm desc: text-xs icon: md art:
sizes.md: root: gap-3 px-6 py-10 title: text-base desc: text-sm icon: lg art:
sizes.lg: root: gap-4 px-8 py-14 title: text-lg desc: text-sm icon: xl art:

props.name: actions
props.description: Buttons or links under the text.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting text under the title.

props.name: icon
props.description:
Icon shown in a ringed featured circle (default: inbox). Ignored when `illustration` is set.
In the `welcome` variant it sits in a card tile and has no default.

props.name: illustration
props.description: An `EmptyStateIllustration` variant name, or any custom node.

props.name: size
props.description: Spacing and type scale of the empty state.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading. Optional only for the `welcome` variant.

props.name: variant
props.description: `dashed` draws a dashed bordered drop-area style box; `welcome` is the large first-run greeting (`ChatEmptyState`).

EmptyStateIllustration.description: Simple line illustrations for empty, error and success states.

props.name: size
props.description: Width in pixels (height follows the 4:3 ratio).

props.name: title
props.description: Accessible name; when set the illustration is exposed as an image, otherwise it is decorative.

props.name: variant
props.description: Which scene to draw: `search`, `inbox`, `files`, `error`, `success` or `cloud`.

EnsembleBuilder.description: Mixture-of-agents preset: reference models, an aggregator and rounds, with a recursion guard.

props.name: providers
props.description: Providers whose models can join the ensemble.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial configuration when `value` is not controlled.

props.name: isEnsemble
props.description: Extra check for models that resolve to an ensemble (models with `ensemble: true` are always rejected).

props.name: maxReferences
props.description: Maximum number of reference models that can be added.

props.name: maxRounds
props.description: Upper bound of the rounds stepper.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new configuration when the user changes any part of it.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled configuration: `references`, `aggregator` and `rounds`.

EntityChip.description: Inline reference to an item in any Sutra app, tinted with the app's accent.

props.name: id
props.description: Id of the referenced item.

props.name: title
props.description: Display name of the referenced item.

props.name: type
props.description: What the chip refers to: an app (notes, tasks and so on), `person` or `tag`; picks the icon and colour.

props.name: date
props.description: Date of the item (due or created), shown in the hover card.

props.name: hideIcon
props.description: Hide the app icon.

props.name: href
props.description: Link target; the chip renders as plain text when unset.

props.name: preview
props.description: Hover card content (e.g. a preview of the note or task).

props.name: size
props.description: Chip size.

props.name: status
props.description: Status text of the item (for example "In progress"), shown in the hover card.

EpisodeCard.description: Landscape 16:9 episode card with episode number, runtime, description, progress and actions.

props.name: title
props.description: Title of the film or show; shown under the poster and in the accessible name.

props.name: actions
props.description: Quiet icon actions revealed on hover (always visible on touch).

props.name: busy
props.description: Blocking overlay, e.g. `{ label: "Moving…", progress: 42 }`.

props.name: description
props.description: Short synopsis under the title.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the main action and dims the poster.

props.name: disabledReason
props.description: Why the poster cannot be played; shown as a tooltip and read with the title.

props.name: episode
props.description: Episode number, shown in the meta line and the default accessible name.

props.name: href
props.description: Makes the poster a link to this address instead of a button.

props.name: image
props.description: Poster image URL.

props.name: imageAlt
props.description: Alt text of the poster; decorative (empty) by default, since the title is shown beside it.

props.name: meta
props.description: Extra meta after the year, e.g. "2h 14m" or "8 episodes".

props.name: onPlay
props.description: Primary action (the whole poster is the hit target).

props.name: orientation
props.description: Thumbnail beside the text instead of above it.

props.name: playLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the poster's main action. Default "Play {title}".

props.name: progress
props.description: Watch progress 0–100 (strip along the bottom).

props.name: runtime
props.description: Seconds, or a preformatted string.

props.name: season
props.description: Season number, shown in the meta line.

props.name: status
props.description: One status badge, top-left.

ExpandableContent.description: Height-capped container with a bottom fade and Show more / Show less.

props.name: collapsedHeight
props.description: Height (px) of the collapsed view. Default 160.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Initial expanded state when `expanded` is not controlled.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Controlled expanded state.

props.name: fadeClassName
props.description: Classes for the gradient (match the surface, e.g. "from-card"). Default "from-background".

props.name: lessLabel
props.description: Label of the button that collapses the content.

props.name: moreLabel
props.description: Label of the button that expands the content.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the user expands or collapses the content.

ExpandCard.description:
A card that grows into its dialog: the card is the button that opens a `MorphDialog` and also the origin it flies out of and
back into. While the dialog is open the card is hidden (it comes back as the panel lands on it). The card is a native button
with `aria-haspopup="dialog"`; its content may use blocks. Controlled with `open` / `defaultOpen` / `onOpenChange`.

props.name: children
props.description: The collapsed card face. It is shown again at the top of the expanded panel (unless `repeatFace` is false), so keep it start-aligned.

props.name: detail
props.description: What the expanded panel shows below the face. A function gets `close`.

props.name: title
props.description: Accessible name of the expanded dialog (the visible title is in the face).

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Start open (uncontrolled).

props.name: description
props.description: Accessible description of the dialog.

props.name: onMorphEnd
props.description: Runs when the open or close flight has finished.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Asked to open or close: a press on the card, Escape, the close button or the scrim.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the dialog is open (controlled).

props.name: panelClassName
props.description: Classes of the expanded panel.

props.name: repeatFace
props.description: Draw the face again at the top of the panel, which is what makes the morph read as one object. The copy is hidden from assistive technology and inert, so the detail must carry what the face says. Default true.

props.name: showClose
props.description: The close button at the top end of the panel. Default true.

props.name: size
props.description: Width of the panel: sm, md or lg. Default "md".

props.name: variant
props.description: `"dialog"` is centred, `"sheet"` docks to the bottom edge, `"auto"` is a sheet below the `sm` breakpoint. Default "auto".

ExtensionDetailPage.description: Extension detail: breadcrumbs, hero, copyable install command, facts sidebar, capabilities, security note, screenshots, README and more from the author.

props.name: extension
props.description: The extension to describe: name, author, tier, versions, capabilities, readme and links.

props.name: breadcrumbs
props.description: Breadcrumb trail above the header; each crumb has a `label` and an optional `href`.

props.name: moreFromAuthor
props.description: Other extensions by the same author.

props.name: onOpenExtension
props.description: Called with the extension when a card in "More from author" is opened.

props.name: onOpenScreenshot
props.description: Called with the screenshot index; wire it to a Lightbox.

props.name: renderLink
props.description: Renders breadcrumb links in place of the default `<a>`, e.g. to use your router's Link.

props.name: shaHref
props.description: Link for the short sha (relative path or anchor); rendered as text when omitted.

ExtensionInstallDialog.description: Install a plugin from the catalog or a git URL: source verification warning, advanced details, progress log and result.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when `open` is not controlled.

props.name: error
props.description: Failure message shown when `status` is `error`.

props.name: log
props.description: Installer output lines streamed into the log view while installing.

props.name: mode
props.description: "catalog" installs a known entry; "git" asks for a URL.

props.name: name
props.description: Name of the extension being installed (catalog mode).

props.name: onDone
props.description: Called by "Done" after success.

props.name: onInstall
props.description: Called with the source (catalog id or git URL) when the user confirms the install.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the dialog opens or closes.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state of the dialog.

props.name: permissions
props.description: Permissions or capabilities requested.

props.name: sha
props.description: Commit sha / digest.

props.name: source
props.description: Source URL (prefill for git mode).

props.name: status
props.description:
Progress of the install (`idle`, `installing`, `success`, `error`); the dialog shows the log and the Done button
once it leaves `idle`.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Element that opens the dialog when pressed.

props.name: verified
props.description: Source is a verified publisher.

FadeText.description: Truncates text with a soft gradient fade instead of an ellipsis; the fade only appears when the text overflows.

props.name: fade
props.description: Width (single line) or height (multi-line) of the fade, CSS length. Default "2.5rem".

props.name: lines
props.description: Clamp to this many lines (fades the last line). Default 1.

props.name: showTitle
props.description: Native tooltip with the full text when truncated (string children only). Default true.

FallbackChainEditor.description: Ordered primary + fallback models: reorder, add through the picker, remove.

props.name: providers
props.description: Providers whose models can be added to the chain.

props.name: caption
props.description: Helper text above the chain.
props.default: "Tried in order when a model fails or is rate-limited."

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial chain when `value` is not controlled.

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum chain length.

props.name: onSetupProvider
props.description: Called from an unconfigured provider's "Set up" call to action in the add-model picker.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new chain when the user adds, removes or reorders a model.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled chain: model references in the order they are tried.

FanControl.description:
Fan speeds with a per-fan Automatic / Fixed switch and, when Fixed, a target slider (step 100, "2,400 rpm").
Shows a note that fans return to automatic when the app quits, and a safety message when the target is below
what the system needs. Data in, events out.

props.name: fans
props.description: Fans to list, each with a name, current rpm, target rpm and mode.

props.name: accent
props.description: Default "orange".

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns every control off (e.g. the privileged helper is not installed).

props.name: disabledReason
props.description: Why the controls are off, with any action ("Install Helper…"); shown above the fans when `disabled`.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when `fans` is empty. Default "No controllable fans".

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the list. Default "Fans".

props.name: loading
props.description: Data is on its way. With no fans yet placeholder fan cards are shown (no mode switch or slider); with fans the root is only marked busy.

props.name: loadingRows
props.description: Placeholder fans while loading. Default 2.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale used to format numbers.

props.name: note
props.description: Note under a fixed fan's slider. Default "Returns to automatic when the app quits"; `false` hides it.
props.default: "Returns to automatic when the app quits"

props.name: onModeChange
props.description: Called with the fan id and the mode (automatic or fixed) when the user switches a fan's mode.

props.name: onTargetChange
props.description: Fires while the target slider moves.

props.name: onTargetCommit
props.description: Fires once when the slider is released or a key press ends; write the fan speed here.

props.name: step
props.description: Slider step in rpm. Default 100.

FanMenu.description: A hub button that fans out circular action discs along an arc (e.g. voice modes). Keyboard accessible as a menu.

props.name: icon
props.description: Hub button icon.

props.name: items
props.description: Actions that fan out from the hub button; each has an `id`, a `label` and an `icon`.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the hub button.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled.

props.name: direction
props.description: Direction the fan opens towards. Default "up".

props.name: discSize
props.description: Disc diameter, px. Default 44.

props.name: hubSize
props.description: Hub diameter, px. Default 48.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the menu opens or closes.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Fired with the selected item id (after the item's own `onSelect`).

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Use with `onOpenChange`.

props.name: radius
props.description: Distance from the hub centre to each disc, px. Default 76.

props.name: showLabels
props.description: Show item labels as tooltips next to the discs. Default true.

props.name: spread
props.description: Total arc covered by the discs, degrees. Default 120.

Favicon.description: Site icon for a domain: explicit `src`, provider-resolved URL, or a local monogram.

props.name: domain
props.description: Domain of the site, e.g. "github.com"; it feeds the resolver and the monogram fallback.

props.name: shape
props.description: Outline of the icon.

props.name: src
props.description: Explicit icon URL; overrides the provider.

FaviconProvider.description:
Opt in to remote favicons. Without a provider, Sutra makes no network
requests and renders a local monogram tile instead.

props.name: children
props.description: The subtree whose `Favicon` components use this resolver.

props.name: resolve
props.description: Maps a domain to an icon URL, or returns `undefined` to fall back to the monogram.

FeaturedIcon.description: An icon presented in a tinted tile, with soft, solid, ring-halo and glass styles.

props.name: color
props.description: Legacy name of `tone`.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon component to render inside the tile. Alternatively pass the icon as children.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label; decorative when omitted.

props.name: shape
props.description: Tile outline: round or square.

props.name: size
props.description: Tile size from `xs` to `xl`.

props.name: tone
props.description: Semantic colour. Default `primary`.

props.name: variant
props.description: Look: `soft` (tinted tile), `solid`, `outline-ring` or `glass`.

FeatureGrid.description: Icon + title + description cards in a 2–4 column grid, with an optional section header.

props.name: features
props.description: Features to list; each has a `title`, a `description` and an `icon`.

props.name: columns
props.description: Number of columns on large screens (fewer on small ones).

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting text under the heading.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Small label above the title.

props.name: title
props.description: Section heading.

FeedbackDialog.description: Collect a star rating, a category and a written message; shows a thank-you state.

props.name: categories
props.description: Feedback categories offered in the select; each has a `value` and a `label`.
props.default: [ { value: "idea", label: "Idea" }, { value: "bug", label: "Bug" }, { value: "praise", label: "Praise" }, { value: "other", label: "Other" }, ]

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the dialog panel.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the dialog opens or closes.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called with the rating, category, message and contact choice when the form is submitted. A returned promise shows a spinner; throw to show the error message.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Use with `onOpenChange`.

props.name: title
props.description: Dialog heading.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Element that opens the dialog (rendered with `asChild`).

Field.description: Groups a label, control, description and error, and wires their ids together.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the control.

props.name: id
props.description: Id applied to the control. Generated when omitted.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the control invalid; the control and the error text pick it up.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Places the label above the control (`vertical`) or beside it (`horizontal`).

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the control required; the label shows the required indicator.

FieldContent.description: Stacks label, description and error next to a control in a horizontal field.

FieldContext.description: Carries the `Field` state (id, invalid, disabled, required, description ids) to the control and its label.

FieldError.description: Validation message, announced to assistive tech. Renders nothing when empty.

props.name: errors
props.description: Error objects or strings (e.g. from a form library). Used when no children are given.

props.name: hideIcon
props.description: Hide the leading icon.

FieldGroup.description: Vertical stack of fields with consistent spacing.

FieldHint.description: Small secondary hint, typically placed under the control.

props.name: icon
props.description: Show a leading info icon, or pass a custom icon.

FieldLabel.description: Label bound to the field's control.

props.name: hint
props.description: Muted helper shown after the label text, e.g. "(optional)".

props.name: required
props.description: Appends a red asterisk (hidden from assistive technology); set `required` on the control itself for validation.

props.name: variant
props.description: `legend` renders a section title, `label` matches a field label.

Fieldset.description: Native fieldset for grouping related fields under a legend.

FileFormatIcon.description: A document icon with a folded corner and a colored file-extension label.

props.name: ext
props.description: Extension or filename (e.g. `"pdf"` or `"Q3 report.pdf"`).

props.name: color
props.description: Override the format color.

props.name: label
props.description: Override the label text (defaults to the uppercased extension; the long ones `numbers`, `sketch`, `sqlite` and `svelte` use a short form, other extensions are cut at five letters).

props.name: mono
props.description:
Ink on paper: one ink for every format (the label band, or the sheet in `solid`, in the foreground colour with paper-coloured
text) instead of the format colour. Unset follows the style: the paper style draws it mono, the others coloured; `true` forces mono
and `false` keeps the format colour in the paper style.

props.name: size
props.description: Size token or height in pixels.

props.name: title
props.description: Accessible name; when set the icon is exposed as an image, otherwise it is decorative.

props.name: variant
props.description: `default` white sheet with a colored label, `solid` colored sheet, `minimal` outline with colored text.

FilePreviewCard.description: Thumbnail tile for a file: image preview or format icon, name and size. Click to open a viewer.

props.name: file
props.description: The file to preview: its name, type, size and an optional thumbnail URL.

props.name: meta
props.description: Extra line under the name (defaults to the formatted size).

FileUpload.description: Compound file uploader root: owns file state, validation and the hidden input.

props.name: accept
props.description: Accepted types, as for `<input accept>`: extensions (".pdf") and/or MIME types ("image/*"), comma separated.

props.name: defaultFiles
props.description: Initial list of files when uncontrolled.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables dropping and picking files.

props.name: files
props.description: Controlled list of files.

props.name: maxFiles
props.description: Most files accepted in total; extra files are rejected.

props.name: maxSize
props.description: Largest accepted file in bytes; larger files are rejected.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Accepts more than one file.

props.name: name
props.description: Name of the hidden file input, for native form submission.

props.name: onFilesAdded
props.description: Called with newly added files only — a good place to start uploads.

props.name: onFilesChange
props.description: Called with the full file list after files are added, removed or updated.

props.name: onFilesRejected
props.description: Called with the files that failed validation (type, size or count) and the reasons.

props.name: showErrors
props.description: Render validation errors under the children.

FileUploadDropzone.description: `Dropzone` wired to the surrounding `FileUpload` state and limits.

props.name: compact
props.description: Legacy form of `density="compact"`.

props.name: density
props.description: `compact` is a single-row layout for tight spaces. Default `normal`.

props.name: directory
props.description:
Upload whole folders: clicking opens a folder picker (`webkitdirectory`) and dropped folders are
walked recursively. Every file is validated on its own and carries its `relativePath`
(see `getFileRelativePath`). Where the browser can't pick folders, clicking falls back to the file
picker and the hint says why.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables dropping and picking.

props.name: hint
props.description: Defaults to a description of `accept` / `maxSize`.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon above the title. Defaults to an upload icon.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: Ref to the hidden `<input type="file">`, e.g. to open the picker from your own button.

props.name: name
props.description: Name for the underlying file input. With it, the accepted files stay on the input so a native form post sends them.

props.name: title
props.description: Headline of the drop target. Defaults to a prompt to drop or choose files.

FileUploadItem.description: A single file row: type badge, name, size, progress and status.

props.name: file
props.description: The file to show: its name, size, upload `status`, `progress` and any error.

props.name: hideRemove
props.description: Hide the remove button.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Overrides the default remove behaviour (removing from `FileUpload` state).

FileUploadList.description: List of selected files. Renders a `FileUploadItem` per file when no children are given.

FileUploadTrigger.description: Button that opens the file picker (or, with `directory`, a folder picker).

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as the child element (e.g. a link) while keeping button styles.

props.name: directory
props.description:
Open a folder picker instead of the file picker: every file inside is validated on its own and keeps
its `relativePath` (see `getFileRelativePath`). Where the browser can't pick folders the button stays
focusable but inert (`aria-disabled`) and describes why; set `hideWhenUnsupported` to drop it instead.
Pair it with a plain trigger for "Upload files" / "Upload folder".

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretches the button to the width of its container.

props.name: hideWhenUnsupported
props.description: With `directory`, render nothing where folder picking is unsupported (instead of an inert button).

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Icon before the label.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner and disables the button.

props.name: size
props.description: Button height and padding; `icon-*` sizes are square.

props.name: spinnerProps
props.description: Overrides for the loading spinner (variant, size, `label`, colour via `className`); it inherits the button text colour by default.

props.name: trailingIcon
props.description: Icon after the label.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style: `primary` (filled), `secondary` (bordered), `tertiary` (muted fill), `soft`, `ghost`, `outline`, `destructive`, `destructive-soft`, `inverse` or `link`.

FileViewer.description:
Previews a file by type (image, PDF, video, audio, text/code/markdown/JSON) in a modal or inline. Apps can add their
own renderers, browse several `files`, put actions in the header and show a side panel.

props.name: actions
props.description: App actions in the header (share, rename, delete …), before the built-in download and close actions.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the viewer root.

props.name: defaultIndex
props.description: Initial position in `files` (uncontrolled). Default 0.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultPanelOpen
props.description: Default true.

props.name: download
props.description: Show the header download action. Default true when the file has a URL.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when `files` is empty and nothing is loading.

props.name: file
props.description: The file to show. In a gallery, pass `files` instead.

props.name: files
props.description: Files to browse with previous/next buttons, ←/→ and an optional thumbnail strip. Takes precedence over `file`.

props.name: index
props.description: Position in `files` (controlled).

props.name: inline
props.description: Render in place instead of in a modal.

props.name: kind
props.description: Override the detected renderer.

props.name: loading
props.description: Waiting for the file (or its URL). Shows skeletons until there is something to show.

props.name: loadText
props.description: Load text content (default: `file.blob`, then `fetch(file.url)`).

props.name: loop
props.description: Wrap from the last file to the first and back. Default false.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Close action for inline viewers (modal viewers close via `onOpenChange`).

props.name: onDownload
props.description: Called when the download button is clicked; setting it shows the button.

props.name: onIndexChange
props.description: Called with the new index and the file when the user browses to another file.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the modal viewer opens or closes.

props.name: onPanelOpenChange
props.description: Called when the side panel opens or closes.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state of the modal viewer. Use with `onOpenChange`.

props.name: openInNewTab
props.description: Show the "open in new tab" action. Default true when the file has a URL.

props.name: panel
props.description: Side panel (details, metadata, comments). Sits beside the content on wide viewers and below it on narrow ones.

props.name: panelLabel
props.description: Name of the side panel and its header toggle. Default "Details".

props.name: panelOpen
props.description: Controlled open state of the details side panel. Use with `onPanelOpenChange`.

props.name: renderers
props.description: App renderers, tried in order before the built-in kinds.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Line under the title (default: the formatted size).

props.name: text
props.description: Text content for text/code/markdown/json files (single `file` only; in a gallery set each file's `text`).

props.name: thumbnails
props.description: Show a thumbnail strip under the content when browsing several files. Default false.

props.name: title
props.description: Header title (default: the file name). Also the dialog's accessible name.

FilterBar.description: Toolbar row for lists and tables: search, filter chips and actions.

FilterBarActive.description: Row of applied filter tokens. Pass `filters` or `FilterBarToken` children.

props.name: filters
props.description: Active filters to show as removable tokens, each with a `label` and a remove handler.

props.name: removeLabel
props.description:
Accessible name of the remove buttons of `filters`: a string for all of them, or a function of the filter, e.g.
`(f) => "Remove " + f.id`. A filter's own `removeLabel` wins.

FilterBarChip.description: Dashed "+ Filter" button that opens a multi-select checklist.

props.name: label
props.description: Filter name shown on the chip (e.g. "Status").

props.name: options
props.description: Choices in the popover; each is a string or `{ value, label }`.

props.name: align
props.description: Alignment of the popover against the chip.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially selected values when uncontrolled.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon shown before the label.

props.name: maxDisplay
props.description: How many selected values to list before collapsing to "N selected".

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the selected values after every change.

props.name: searchable
props.description: Show a search input inside the popover. Defaults to true when there are more than 7 options.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected values. Use with `onValueChange`.

FilterBarClear.description: "Clear all" text button for resetting filters.

FilterBarSearch.description: Compact search input with a clear button.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial search text when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the search text as it changes.

props.name: size
props.description: Field height and text size.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled search text. Use with `onValueChange`.

props.name: label
props.description: Token text, e.g. "Status: Open".

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Called when the remove button is clicked; setting it shows the button.

props.name: removeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the remove button.

FilterPill.deprecated: Use `FilterBarChip` (the dashed "+ Filter" button; it is not a pill).

props.name: label
props.description: Filter name shown on the chip (e.g. "Status").

props.name: options
props.description: Choices in the popover; each is a string or `{ value, label }`.

props.name: align
props.description: Alignment of the popover against the chip.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially selected values when uncontrolled.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon shown before the label.

props.name: maxDisplay
props.description: How many selected values to list before collapsing to "N selected".

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the selected values after every change.

props.name: searchable
props.description: Show a search input inside the popover. Defaults to true when there are more than 7 options.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected values. Use with `onValueChange`.

FloatingActionButton.description: Floating primary action, optionally expanding into a speed-dial menu.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name; also the visible text when `extended`.

props.name: actions
props.description: Speed-dial actions that fan out on click.

props.name: containerClassName
props.description: Classes for the positioned wrapper (`className` styles the button).

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state of the speed dial when uncontrolled.

props.name: extended
props.description: Show the label next to the icon.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon inside the button; the only content unless `extended`.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the speed dial opens or closes.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state of the speed dial. Use with `onOpenChange`.

props.name: position
props.description: Corner or edge of the container the button sits in.

props.name: shape
props.description: Outline: fully round, or rounded square.

props.name: size
props.description: Button size: 48, 56 or 64 px (`sm`, `md`, `lg`).

props.name: strategy
props.description: `fixed` to the viewport (default), `absolute` within a relative parent, or `static` inline.

props.name: variant
props.description: Fill style: `primary`, `secondary` (outlined) or `inverse`.

FloatingPanes.description: Layer of draggable, resizable floating windows kept inside their container.

props.name: onPanesChange
props.description: Called with the full window list after a window moves, resizes, closes or is brought to the front.

props.name: panes
props.description: Windows; the last one is in front.

props.name: renderPane
props.description: Renders the content of a window from its pane id.

props.name: minHeight
props.description: Smallest window height in px.

props.name: minWidth
props.description: Smallest window width in px.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called with the pane id when the window's close button is clicked.

props.name: onDock
props.description: Show a "dock" button that hands the pane back to the layout.

props.name: paneIcon
props.description: Icon shown before the window title.

props.name: paneLabel
props.description: Plain-text name for labels (defaults to a string title or the id).

props.name: paneTitle
props.description: Window title from the pane id; defaults to a string title or the id.

FocusViewItem.description: Renders its children unless focus view hides this kind of row.

props.name: kind
props.description:
Kind of transcript item (`user`, `assistant`, `tool` or `system`); the item is hidden when its kind is in
`hiddenKinds`.

props.name: children
props.description: Content to hide while the focus view hides this kind.

FocusViewProvider.description: Shares the focus-view state between a `FocusViewToggle` and transcript rows.

props.name: children
props.description: Transcript subtree whose `FocusViewItem`s and `FocusViewToggle` share the state.

props.name: defaultFocused
props.description: Initial focus state when `focused` is not controlled.

props.name: focused
props.description: Controlled focus state: true hides the kinds in `hiddenKinds`.

props.name: hiddenKinds
props.description: Kinds hidden while focused. Default `["tool"]`.

props.name: onFocusedChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the user toggles focus view.

FocusViewToggle.description: Toggle that hides tool calls and keeps only user/assistant rows (reads `FocusViewProvider`).

props.name: defaultPressed
props.description: Initial state when used outside a `FocusViewProvider` and `pressed` is not controlled.

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: Hides the visible label; `label` stays as the accessible name.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label. Default "Focus". Set `iconOnly` to hide it.

props.name: onPressedChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the toggle is pressed.

props.name: pressed
props.description: Used only outside a `FocusViewProvider`.

ForgotPasswordCard.description: Request a password reset link; shows a confirmation once sent.

props.name: backHref
props.description: Link target of the "Back to sign in" link.

props.name: defaultEmail
props.description: Initial value of the email field.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting text under the heading; each card has its own default.
props.default: "No worries. Enter your email and we'll send you reset instructions."

props.name: error
props.description: Error message shown above the form; also marks the form invalid.

props.name: footer
props.description: Replace the default footer (e.g. "Don't have an account? Sign up"). Pass `null` to hide it.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Element of the card title (`1` is an `h1`). Use `2` or lower when the card sits inside a page that has its own `h1`.

props.name: loading
props.description: Disables the form and shows a spinner on the submit button.

props.name: logo
props.description: Show the Sutra mark above the title, or pass a custom logo. Default: true for `card`.

props.name: onSentChange
props.description: Called when the card switches between the form and the success state.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called with the email when the form is submitted. A returned promise shows a spinner; throw to show the error message.

props.name: renderLink
props.description: Router link renderer for the footer and inline links.

props.name: sent
props.description: Controls the success state ("check your inbox"). Use with `onSentChange`.

props.name: title
props.description: Card heading; each card has its own default.

props.name: variant
props.description: `card` renders a bordered surface; `plain` renders only the content (for full-page layouts).

Frame.description: A titled tray around a panel of rows: `FrameHeader` (title, description, action), `FramePanel`, `FrameFooter`.

props.name: variant
props.description: Container look: `default` (tray with a raised panel), `band` (one card with header and footer bands), `inset` (soft tray, roomy panel) or `plain` (no tray).

FrameAction.description: A control on the right of the header (a button, a link, a menu).

FrameDescription.description: A line of explanation under or beside the title.

FrameFooter.description: The bottom of a frame: a count, a hint or an action.

FrameHeader.description: The top of a frame: title and description on the left, an action on the right; wraps when narrow.

FramePanel.description: The raised surface that holds the rows. Rows are its direct children; a list of `Item`s works as is.

props.name: divided
props.description: Draw hairlines between the rows. Default true.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when there are no children (and not loading).

props.name: loading
props.description: Show placeholder rows while the rows are not known yet.

props.name: loadingRows
props.description: Number of placeholder rows. Default 3.

props.name: as
props.description: The heading element. Default `h3`.

FrequencyMeter.description: Three-bar "how common is this word" indicator.

props.name: level
props.description: 0 (rare) … 3 (very common).

FunnelChart.description: Funnel chart: stage names and values at the left, the narrowing shape at the right, keyboard and tooltip readouts.

props.name: data
props.description: One row per stage, in funnel order (the chart does not sort).

props.name: animate
props.description: CSS transitions on data changes (disabled under prefers-reduced-motion). Default true.

props.name: color
props.description: One color for every stage; stages shade from full strength at the top to lighter at the bottom. Default the first chart color.

props.name: colorFor
props.description: Returns a colour for a step (a token name or CSS colour), or `undefined` to use the palette colour.

props.name: colors
props.description: A color per stage instead (no shading).

props.name: connected
props.description: Stages join with sloping sides (default) or are separate centered bars (`false`).

props.name: conversion
props.description:
The conversion rate shown beside each stage (after the first): `"previous"` is the share of the stage before
(default), `"first"` the share of the top stage, `false` hides rates. The tooltip and the table always list both.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Content shown instead of the funnel when there is no data.

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in px. Default 44px per stage (at least 120).

props.name: index
props.description: Key of the stage name. Default "label".

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Defaults to a description built from the stages.

props.name: loading
props.description: Data is on its way: with no data, a placeholder funnel of the same size; with data, the root is marked busy.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale for the default number formatting. Pass one explicitly when the server and the browser must agree (SSR). Defaults to the runtime locale.

props.name: onActiveIndexChange
props.description: Called with the hovered step index (or `null` when the pointer leaves); use it to sync other views.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Shows a tooltip with the step value and the drop-off from the previous step.

props.name: valueFormatter
props.description: Formats the step values in the tooltip and labels. Default is the localized number.

props.name: valueKey
props.description: Key of the stage value. Default "value".

GatewayStatusPopover.description: Status-bar gateway indicator with a popover of uptime, version, controls and a live log tail.

props.name: state
props.description:
Run state of the gateway (`running`, `starting`, `stopping`, `stopped` or `error`); sets the dot, label and the
actions offered.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the trigger button.

props.name: contentClassName
props.description: Extra classes for the popover content.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when `open` is not controlled.

props.name: error
props.description: Error detail shown when state is "error".

props.name: host
props.description: Host or address the gateway listens on, shown in the popover.

props.name: logLines
props.description: Recent log lines rendered in the tail panel.

props.name: logSlot
props.description: Custom log tail content (e.g. a streaming LogViewer); replaces `logLines`.

props.name: name
props.description: Gateway display name. Default "Gateway".

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the popover opens or closes.

props.name: onRestart
props.description: Called when the user presses Restart; the button is hidden when unset.

props.name: onStart
props.description: Called when the user presses Start on a stopped gateway; the button is hidden when unset.

props.name: onStop
props.description: Called when the user presses Stop; the button is hidden when unset.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state of the popover.

props.name: uptime
props.description: Seconds (formatted) or a preformatted string.

props.name: version
props.description: Gateway version, shown in the popover.

Gauge.description: Radial arc gauge with threshold coloring (role="meter").

sizes.sm: box: stroke: value: text-sm label: text-2xs
sizes.md: box: stroke: value: text-xl label: text-xs
sizes.lg: box: stroke: value: text-display-xs label: text-sm

props.name: value
props.description: Current reading in `min` to `max` units; `null` shows an empty "no data" gauge.

props.name: accent
props.description:
Categorical arc colour (a sensor or metric colour). Colour order: `colorStops`, then the warning/danger threshold
colours, then `tone`/`color`, then `accent`, then primary. Sets `--sutra-accent` on the root.

props.name: ariaValueText
props.description: Screen-reader value text override (default is the formatted value with its unit).

props.name: children
props.description: Extra content under the value (replaces the label slot).

props.name: color
props.description: Legacy name of `tone`.

props.name: colorStops
props.description: Custom colors by absolute value (overrides thresholds).

props.name: endAngle
props.description: Arc end in degrees. Default 135 (270° sweep).

props.name: glow
props.description: Soft colored glow around the value arc.

props.name: label
props.description: Caption under the value (also the accessible name).

props.name: loading
props.description: Waiting for the first reading: with `value` null, the track stays empty and a placeholder stands in for the number.

props.name: max
props.description: Default 100.

props.name: min
props.description: Value at the start of the arc.

props.name: size
props.description: Gauge diameter: `sm`, `md` or `lg`.

props.name: startAngle
props.description: Arc start in degrees (0 = top, clockwise). Default -135.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Stroke width override in px.

props.name: thresholds
props.description: Percent thresholds, same semantics as Meter.

props.name: tone
props.description: Base tone below thresholds. Default `primary`.

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit shown beside the value (e.g. "°C"). Without it the value is shown as given.

props.name: valueFormatter
props.description: Formats the number in the middle. Default is the rounded value.

GeoMarkerLayer.description:
HTML overlay of marker buttons positioned over a map drawing: focusable, labelled, `aria-pressed` for the
selected one, optional clustering into count bubbles and a hover/focus tooltip. Shared by WorldMap and the globe.

props.name: height
props.description: Height in px of the drawing the layer sits on, used to keep tooltips inside.

props.name: markers
props.description: Markers to place, each with an id, a point and optional label, value, colour and avatar.

props.name: project
props.description: Screen position of a point, or `null` to hide the marker (clipped, or on a globe's far side).

props.name: width
props.description: Size of the drawing the layer sits on, used to keep tooltips inside.

props.name: activeId
props.description: A marker to show as active from outside (tooltip and ring), e.g. while a list row for it has focus.

props.name: cluster
props.description: Merge nearby markers into count bubbles. The selected marker always stays on its own.

props.name: compact
props.description:
Smaller markers (about 70%) and a wider default cluster radius, for small maps where avatars would crowd.
Default: on when `width` is under 480 px.

props.name: defaultSelectedId
props.description: Initially selected marker id when `selectedId` is not controlled.

props.name: markerOpacity
props.description: Opacity per marker, 0–1 (the globe fades markers near its edge). Markers at 0 are not rendered.

props.name: onClusterSelect
props.description: Called when a cluster bubble is activated.

props.name: onSelectedIdChange
props.type: (id: string | null, marker: GeoMarker | undefined) => void
props.description: Called with the new selection (`null` when the selected marker is activated again).

props.name: selectedId
props.description: Controlled id of the selected marker; `null` selects none.

props.name: sizeRange
props.description: Diameter range in px for `value`-scaled markers. Default `[8, 28]`.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Show a tooltip for the hovered or focused marker. Default true.

GitStatusLetter.description: Colored status letter with a screen-reader label.

props.name: status
props.description: Default `modified`.

Globe.description:
Interactive 3D globe (orthographic, bundled outlines): drag with momentum, wheel/pinch/keyboard zoom, auto-rotation,
fly-to, and the same choropleth, markers, clustering, arcs, country selection and screen-reader tables as WorldMap.

props.name: apiRef
props.description: Imperative handle (`flyTo`, `reset`, `zoomIn`, `zoomOut`, `getView`); `ref` stays on the root element.

props.name: arcs
props.description: Great-circle arcs between two points, for example traffic or replication links.

props.name: autoRotate
props.description:
Spin slowly: `true` for 8°/s or a speed in degrees per second (negative turns westward). Pauses while the user
drags, zooms, hovers or focuses a marker, or has one selected, and resumes after `autoRotateDelay`. Starts off
under reduced motion (the play control can still start it) and stops while off-screen or in a hidden tab.

props.name: autoRotateDelay
props.description: Ms of quiet before auto-rotation resumes. Default 2500.

props.name: cluster
props.description: Merge nearby markers into count bubbles (`{ radius }` in px, default 36; 48 for compact markers).

props.name: color
props.description: Colour token or any CSS colour for the choropleth. Default `primary`.

props.name: compactMarkers
props.description: Smaller markers and a wider cluster radius. Default: on when the drawing is narrower than 480 px.

props.name: controls
props.description: Show the play/pause, zoom and reset buttons. Default false.

props.name: controlsClassName
props.description: Classes for the control bar (bottom-end by default).

props.name: data
props.description: Choropleth values by country.

props.name: dataTable
props.description:
Render the visually hidden screen-reader tables (countries, markers, arcs). Default true. Set false when the page
already lists the same data accessibly next to the map (as LiveVisitorsMap, SignInMap and RegionStatusMap do).

props.name: defaultRotation
props.description: Starting rotation. Defaults to centring `focus`, else the selected marker, else Europe and Africa.

props.name: defaultSelectedCountry
props.description: Initially selected country (alpha-2 code) when `selectedCountry` is not controlled.

props.name: defaultSelectedMarkerId
props.description: Initially selected marker id when `selectedMarkerId` is not controlled.

props.name: defaultWidth
props.description: Width used before the container is measured (and in jsdom). Default 480.

props.name: defaultZoom
props.description: Initial zoom multiplier when `zoom` is not controlled. Default 1.

props.name: domain
props.description: Value range for `quantize`. Defaults to the data's min and max.

props.name: flyToSelection
props.description: Fly to a marker when it is selected. Default true.

props.name: focus
props.description: A point to turn to: the globe flies there whenever this changes (and starts there).

props.name: graticule
props.description: Draw 10° graticule lines.

props.name: height
props.description: Height in px. Default: the measured width (a square).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name; defaults to a summary ("World map: 12 countries with data, 16 markers"). `aria-label` also works.

props.name: legend
props.description: Show the stepped scale legend under the map.

props.name: loading
props.description: Data is on its way: with nothing to show yet, a pulsing silhouette stands in; otherwise the map is marked busy.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for country names. Default English.

props.name: markers
props.description: Points to plot on the map, each with an id, a location and optional label, value and colour.

props.name: markerSizeRange
props.description: Diameter range in px for `value`-scaled markers. Default `[8, 28]`.

props.name: maxZoom
props.description: Default 6.

props.name: minZoom
props.description: Default 1.

props.name: noDataColor
props.description: Fill for countries without data. Default `var(--muted)`.

props.name: onAutoRotateChange
props.description: Called when the play control starts or stops auto-rotation.

props.name: onClusterSelect
props.description: Called with the members and the cluster when the user activates a cluster bubble.

props.name: onCountrySelect
props.type: (code: string | null, country: WorldMapCountry | undefined) => void
props.description: Called with the clicked country, or `null` when the selected one is clicked again.

props.name: onMarkerSelect
props.type: (id: string | null, marker: GeoMarker | undefined) => void
props.description: Called with the marker id (or `null`) and the marker when the user selects or clears a marker.

props.name: onRotationChange
props.description:
Called when the globe comes to rest after a drag, momentum, fly-to, zoom or key press, and when auto-rotation
pauses; not on every frame, so a parent that stores the value doesn't re-render 60 times a second.

props.name: onZoomChange
props.description: Called with the resting zoom (see `onRotationChange`).

props.name: padding
props.description: Space between the globe and the edge in px. Default 8.

props.name: rotation
props.description:
Rotation `[λ, φ, γ]` in degrees (`rotationToCenter(point)` builds one). The globe jumps to it whenever it changes;
drags and animations move the globe on their own and report the resting rotation to `onRotationChange`.

props.name: scale
props.description: Bucketing: `quantize` (equal ranges, default) or `quantile` (equal counts).

props.name: selectedCountry
props.description: Highlighted country (alpha-2 code). Clicking a country selects it when this, `defaultSelectedCountry` or `onCountrySelect` is set.

props.name: selectedMarkerId
props.description: Controlled id of the selected marker; `null` selects none.

props.name: shading
props.description: Light and edge shading plus a faint atmosphere glow. Default true.

props.name: steps
props.description: Number of colour buckets. Default 5.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Hover tooltips for countries and markers. Default true.

props.name: valueFormatter
props.description: Formats a country value for the tooltip, legend and table.

props.name: valueLabel
props.description: Name of the value in the tooltip, legend and table. Default "Value".

props.name: wheelZoom
props.description: Zoom with the mouse wheel or trackpad pinch. Default true.

props.name: zoom
props.description: Zoom as a scale multiplier (1 = the whole globe fits). Same jump-and-report contract as `rotation`.

GlyphSpinner.description: Text-glyph spinner (braille dots, arcs, …): a preset of `<Spinner variant="glyph">`. Holds a static frame under reduced motion.

props.name: frames
props.description: Custom frames (overrides `variant`).

props.name: interval
props.description: Milliseconds per frame. Default 80.

props.name: label
props.description: Screen reader label. Default "Loading".

props.name: paused
props.description: Pause on the current frame.

props.name: size
props.description: Glyph size as on `Spinner`: `xs` to `xl` sets the font size. Leave it out to inherit the parent's font size.

props.name: variant
props.description: Which glyph animation to play (a key of the spinner glyph frame sets).

GoalStatusRow.description: "⊙ Goal · 3/20 turns · title" with a turn-budget bar and pause / clear.

props.name: maxTurns
props.description: Turn budget.

props.name: title
props.description: Goal text, truncated to one line.

props.name: turns
props.description: Turns used so far, shown against `maxTurns`.

props.name: actions
props.description: Buttons on the right.

props.name: dismissLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the dismiss button.

props.name: onClear
props.description: Called when the user clears the goal; the button is hidden when unset.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Shows a dismiss button. Inside a `StatusStack` the row is also removed from the stack.

props.name: onPause
props.description: Called when the user presses Pause; the button is hidden when unset.

props.name: onResume
props.description: Called when the user presses Resume on a paused goal; the button is hidden when unset.

props.name: paused
props.description: Shows the goal as paused (neutral tone) and swaps Pause for Resume.

props.name: priority
props.description: Higher rows sort first inside a `StatusStack`. Default 0.

props.name: tone
props.description: Colour of the row and its progress bar (a `Tone`); the specialised rows pick one from their state when omitted.

GpuCard.description: One GPU: model, VRAM bar, utilization, temperature gauge and process count.

props.name: index
props.description: Zero-based GPU index, shown as "GPU 0".

props.name: memoryTotal
props.description: VRAM total, GB.

props.name: memoryUsed
props.description: VRAM used, GB.

props.name: footer
props.description: Extra content at the bottom of the card.

props.name: model
props.description: GPU model name, shown beside the index.

props.name: power
props.description: Power draw W.

props.name: powerLimit
props.description: Power cap in W; shown after the draw, for example "120 / 300 W".

props.name: processes
props.description: Running processes on this GPU.

props.name: temperature
props.description: Temperature °C.

props.name: temperatureThresholds
props.description: Temperature thresholds in °C. Default warn 75, danger 85.

props.name: utilization
props.description: Utilization percent.

Grid.description: 12-column responsive grid (4 → 8 → 12 columns). Use `GridItem span` to size children.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between the cells: `sm` 12px, `md` 16px (24px from the tablet width up) or `lg` 24px (32px from the tablet width up).

GridBeams.description: A faint grid with light beams traveling along its lines. Content renders above it.

props.name: beams
props.description: Number of animated beams.

props.name: cellSize
props.description: Grid cell size in px.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for a beam to cross.

props.name: fade
props.description: Where the grid fades out: `radial`, `top`, `bottom`, `edges` or `none`.

GridItem.description: A cell of `Grid`: `span` columns on mobile, with `md` and `lg` spans for larger screens. Extra props are spread to the root.

props.name: lg
props.description: Columns on desktop (of 12).

props.name: md
props.description: Columns on tablet (of 8: 1 to 8 or `"full"`).

props.name: span
props.description: Columns on mobile (of 4). Default: full.

GroupInfoPanel.description: Side panel for a group chat: members with roles, shared media grid, mute and leave.

props.name: members
props.description: Members to list, each with a name, role and presence.

props.name: name
props.description: Group name, shown as the heading.

props.name: avatarSrc
props.description: Group avatar image URL.

props.name: currentUserId
props.description: Id of the signed-in member; that row is marked "you".

props.name: defaultMuted
props.description: Initial mute state when `muted` is not controlled.

props.name: description
props.description: Group description under the name.

props.name: leaveLabel
props.description: Label of the leave button. Default "Leave group".

props.name: media
props.description: Shared media shown as a thumbnail grid.

props.name: muted
props.description: Controlled state of the mute switch.

props.name: onAddMember
props.description: Called when the user presses Add member; the button is hidden when unset.

props.name: onLeave
props.description: Called when the user presses the leave button; the button is hidden when unset.

props.name: onMediaClick
props.description: Called with the item when the user opens a thumbnail.

props.name: onMemberClick
props.description: Called with the member when the user opens a member row.

props.name: onMutedChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the user flips the mute switch.

GuidedSetupSteps.description: Numbered onboarding checklist with copyable values, external links and "I did this" checks. Built on `Steps orientation="vertical"`.

props.name: steps
props.description: Setup steps in order, each with an id, title and optional description, copyable value and link.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially completed step ids when `value` is not controlled.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Fired once every step is checked.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the ids of the completed steps when the user checks or unchecks a step.

props.name: value
props.description: Ids of completed steps.

props.name: markOnly
props.description: Render only the geometric mark.

props.name: size
props.description: Height-driven size of the lockup.

HardwareFitHint.description: Badge + explanation of how a model fits the given hardware.

props.name: hardware
props.description: Memory and GPU of the machine to estimate fit on.

props.name: model
props.description: Memory footprint of the model (parameters, quantisation, size) to check against the hardware.

props.name: density
props.description: `compact` renders only the badge, with the explanation in a tooltip. Default `normal`.

props.name: variant
props.description: `compact` renders only the badge, with the explanation in a tooltip.

HeaderNav.description: App / marketing header: glass bar that gains a border when the page scrolls.

props.name: border
props.description: "scroll": show the bottom border once the page scrolls. "always" / "never".

props.name: containerSize
props.description: Inner container width. Default "lg".

props.name: innerClassName
props.description: Classes for the inner container that holds the brand, links and actions.

props.name: sticky
props.description: Stick to the top of the viewport. Default true.

HeaderNavActions.description: Right-aligned actions (sign in, CTA, theme toggle).

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as the child element (e.g. a router `Link`) while keeping the brand styles.

HeaderNavContent.description: Mega-menu panel; slides between triggers inside the shared viewport.

HeaderNavFeatureLink.description: Rich panel link with icon tile, title and description.

props.name: title
props.description: Link title.

props.name: badge
props.description: Small tag after the title, e.g. "New".

props.name: description
props.description: One-line description under the title.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon tile shown beside the title.
