HeaderNavLink.description: Simple navigation link (top level or inside a panel). Use `asChild` for router links.

props.name: variant
props.description: Render as a plain top-level nav link (default) or a compact row inside a panel.

HeaderNavMenu.description: Desktop navigation menu (Radix NavigationMenu) with an animated mega-menu viewport.

props.name: listClassName
props.description: Classes for the `ul` that holds the menu items (the root keeps `className`).

HeaderNavMobile.description: Hamburger button (mobile only) opening a slide-down sheet with nested sections. The ref points at the hamburger button.

props.name: items
props.description: Links of the mobile menu; each has a label, an `href` and optional children for a sub-list.

props.name: brand
props.description: Shown at the top of the sheet.

props.name: children
props.description: Extra content at the bottom (CTA buttons).

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the sheet content.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label for the hamburger.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the sheet opens or closes.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state of the sheet. Use with `onOpenChange`.

props.name: renderLink
props.type: (props: { href: string; className: string; children: React.ReactNode; onClick: () => void; }) => React.ReactElement
props.description: Router link renderer. Spread the given props onto your Link.

HeaderNavTrigger.description: Item that opens a mega-menu panel.

Heading.description: Heading with the display type scale (`size`); the element level (`as`) is independent of the look. Extra props are spread to the heading.

props.name: as
props.description: Heading element to render (`h1` to `h6`), independent of the visual `size`.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as the child element instead of the heading tag, keeping the heading styles.

props.name: size
props.description: Type scale step, from `display-xs` to `display-3xl`; large steps shrink on small screens.

HeartbeatStatusRow.description: Periodic heartbeat: pulse dot, period and time since the last beat; turns amber when beats are missed.

props.name: actions
props.description: Buttons on the right.

props.name: dismissLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the dismiss button.

props.name: intervalMs
props.description: Expected beat period; the row turns stale after two missed beats.

props.name: label
props.description: Kind label of the row. Default "Heartbeat".

props.name: lastBeatAt
props.description: Time of the last heartbeat; `null` or unset counts as stale.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Shows a dismiss button. Inside a `StatusStack` the row is also removed from the stack.

props.name: priority
props.description: Higher rows sort first inside a `StatusStack`. Default 0.

props.name: progress
props.type: { value: number; max: number; label: string }
props.description: Thin bar under the row.

props.name: title
props.description: Trailing, truncated description.

props.name: tone
props.description: Colour of the row and its progress bar (a `Tone`); the specialised rows pick one from their state when omitted.

HeatByApp.description: `BarList` preset ranking apps by energy impact (the heat they add), with a short explanation underneath.

props.name: apps
props.description: Apps with their heat contribution, drawn as ranked bars.

props.name: accent
props.description: Bar colour. Default primary.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Initial expanded state when uncontrolled.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Content shown when there are no items.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Controlled expanded state when `limit` hides rows. Use with `onExpandedChange`.

props.name: explanation
props.description: Short note under the list. Pass `false` to hide it.
props.default: "Energy impact estimates how hard each app makes the Mac work. Higher numbers mean more heat and faster fans."

props.name: header
props.description: Column headers above the list ("App" / "CPU").

props.name: highlightFirst
props.description: Subtle background on the first row (the leader).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the list.

props.name: limit
props.description: Show only the first `limit` rows until expanded.

props.name: loading
props.description: Data is on its way: with no items, placeholder rows stand in (header labels stay); with items, the root is marked busy.

props.name: loadingRows
props.description: Placeholder rows shown while loading with no items. Default 5.

props.name: max
props.description: Value of a full bar. Default: the largest value.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Called when the "Show all" toggle expands or collapses the list.

props.name: showAllLabel
props.description: Toggle text; receives the number of rows in total.

props.name: showAllToggle
props.description: Show a "Show all" / "Show less" toggle when rows are hidden. Default true.

props.name: showLessLabel
props.description: Text of the toggle while expanded.

props.name: sort
props.description: "desc" ranks by value (default); "none" keeps the given order.

props.name: valueFormatter
props.description: Formats the value shown at the end of each row. Default is the localized number.

HeatmapGrid.description: Generic value → color cell grid (per-core CPU, per-GPU load, matrices) with keyboard navigation.

props.name: data
props.description: Values in reading order, each a number, `null` for an empty cell, or a `{ value, label }` cell.

props.name: cellHeight
props.description: Cell height in px (bars default 40).

props.name: cellLabel
props.description: Default cell label: `Cell ${i}`.

props.name: cellSize
props.description: Fixed cell size in px; default stretches to fill the width.

props.name: colorStops
props.description: Custom step stops (overrides `scale`).

props.name: columns
props.description: Cells per row. Default 10.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Formats a cell value for the tooltip and the accessible label. Default is the localized number.

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between cells in px. Default 3.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the grid.

props.name: legend
props.description: Shows a "less to more" legend under the grid.

props.name: legendLabels
props.description: Texts for the low and high ends of the legend: `[low, high]`.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale for the default value text (one decimal and a percent sign). Pass one explicitly when the server and the browser must agree (SSR). Defaults to plain digits.

props.name: max
props.description: Value that maps to the strongest step; defaults to the largest value in the data.

props.name: min
props.description: Value that maps to the emptiest step; defaults to the smallest value in the data (0 when all are positive).

props.name: onCellClick
props.description:
Called with the cell and its index when a cell is clicked, or activated with Enter or Space. Cells stay
`gridcell`s with roving focus (they do not become buttons) and get a pointer cursor.

props.name: scale
props.description: Colour ramp: a semantic token (`primary`, `success`, `warning`, `destructive`, `info`) or `thresholds` to colour by `thresholds`.

props.name: shape
props.description: square: color-filled tiles · bar: vertical fill bars (per-core CPU).

props.name: showIndices
props.description: Show column indices below the grid, labelling every Nth (true = every 1).

props.name: steps
props.description: Number of discrete intensity steps above "empty". Default 4.

props.name: thresholds
props.description: Warning and danger percent cut-offs used when `scale="thresholds"`.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Tooltip content; `false` disables.

HeatmapLegend.description: "Less ▢▢▢▢ More" scale legend, or labeled swatches for custom stops.

props.name: colors
props.description: Swatch colours from the lowest to the highest step.

props.name: highLabel
props.description: Text after the swatches.

props.name: lowLabel
props.description: Text before the swatches.

props.name: stops
props.description: Labelled colour stops to list instead of the plain gradient (for threshold scales).

props.name: swatchSize
props.description: Swatch size in px.

HeroHeader.description: Marketing hero: eyebrow pill, display heading, subtext, CTAs on a mesh gradient.

props.name: align
props.description: Alignment of the copy and actions.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting text under the headline.
props.default: "Notes, tasks, calendar, mail, files, journal, finance and habits in one beautifully connected suite. Less switching, more doing."

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Small label above the title.

props.name: eyebrowHref
props.description: Makes the eyebrow a link to this URL.

props.name: media
props.description: Media below the copy (screenshot, DeviceFrame…).

props.name: primaryAction
props.description: Main call-to-action (`label`, optional `icon`, and `onClick` or `href`); `null` hides it.

props.name: secondaryAction
props.description: Secondary call-to-action; `null` hides it.

props.name: showLogos
props.description: Show a logo cloud under the actions.

props.name: title
props.description: Headline; the default is sample text, so always set it.
props.default: ( <> Your whole life, one calm thread )

HoverCard.description: Hover card root (preview on hover, e.g. user cards and link previews).

props.name: arrow
props.description: Renders the pointing arrow.

props.name: padded
props.description: Adds inner padding; turn it off for content that supplies its own (lists, menus).

props.name: side
props.description:
Side of the trigger the panel opens on. `start` and `end` follow the reading direction (left and right in LTR, swapped in
RTL, read from `DirectionProvider` or `<html dir>`); `left` and `right` stay physical. It flips when there is no room.

props.name: size
props.description: Panel width: `sm` 14rem, `md` 18rem, `lg` 24rem or `auto` (content width).

HoverCardTrigger.description: Element that opens the hover card.

props.name: align
props.description: Cross-axis alignment of the children (`align-items`).

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as the child element instead of a `<div>`, keeping the stack styles.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between children, in Tailwind spacing steps (4 = 1rem).

props.name: justify
props.description: Main-axis distribution of the children (`justify-content`).

props.name: wrap
props.description: Lets children wrap onto new lines when they overflow.

Icon.description: Sized, toned wrapper around any icon component.

props.name: as
props.description: The icon component to render, e.g. `RiHomeLine`.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label. When omitted the icon is decorative (`aria-hidden`).

props.name: size
props.description: Icon size: `xs` 12px, `sm` 16px, `md` 20px, `lg` 24px or `xl` 32px.

props.name: tone
props.description: Semantic colour; the default inherits the surrounding text colour.

IdentityAvatar.description:
An avatar for anyone in a Sutra room: people (photo or drawn initials), agents and machines (a Sutra mascot head whose face follows
the presence) and apps (the Bead app tiles), with presence drawn as a shaped mark or as a bead on a thread. Ink in the paper style,
the seed tint in the stock style. Decorative unless it has a name.

props.name: animated
props.description: Let an agent's mascot move (and a busy agent's bead slide along its thread). Avatars hold still by default; reduced motion stops it.

props.name: app
props.description: The Sutra app of an `app` avatar, drawn with `SutraAppIcon`. Other apps get a tile with their initials.

props.name: character
props.description: The Sutra mascot of an agent or machine (`SutraMascot` `character`). Without it the seed picks one (never the Sutradhar).

props.name: color
props.description: Seed colour override (any CSS colour) for the stock style; the paper style draws in ink. Defaults to a colour picked by the seed.

props.name: decorative
props.description: Hide from assistive technology (use it when the name is next to the avatar). Avatars without a name are always decorative.

props.name: kind
props.description:
What the avatar stands for: `person` a photo or initials, `agent` and `machine` a Sutra mascot head (machines in a rounded
square), `app` the Sutra app tile.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Defaults to the name, the kind and the presence ("Ada, agent, busy").

props.name: monogram
props.description:
`drawn` sets a person's initials in monoline strokes like the wordmark (one initial under 32 px); letters it has no drawing for,
and other scripts, fall back to `text`, the UI font.

props.name: name
props.description: Display name: the source of a person's initials and of the accessible name. Apps default to the app's name.

props.name: presence
props.description: Presence: `online`, `busy`, `away` or `offline`. Leave it out for no presence.

props.name: presenceStyle
props.description:
`mark` a small shaped mark in the corner (solid online, barred busy, half away, hollow offline); `bead` a thread round the face
with a bead on it (full thread online, a barred bead busy, half a thread away, a dashed thread and hollow bead offline). Apps
always use the mark.

props.name: seed
props.description: Stable id (a user or agent id). It picks the seed colour and, when `character` is not given, the agent's mascot. Defaults to `name`.

props.name: size
props.description: A step from `xs` (20 px) to `xl` (64 px), or a number of pixels.

props.name: src
props.description: A person's photo URL. The initials show while it loads, if it fails, or if the URL is unsafe (http(s), relative, `blob:` and `data:image/`).

ImageCropper.description: Image crop box: drag to move, eight handles to resize, aspect presets, quarter-turn rotation and optional zoom.

props.name: src
props.description: URL of the image to crop.

props.name: alt
props.description: Alternative text for the image. Default "Image to crop".

props.name: applyLabel
props.description: Text of the Apply button.

props.name: aspect
props.description: Width ÷ height to lock to, or `null` for free.

props.name: aspectOptions
props.description: Aspect presets, shown as a segmented control (see `imageCropperAspectOptions`).

props.name: crop
props.description: Crop in natural pixels of the image after `rotation`.

props.name: cropperRef
props.description: Imperative handle (`getCroppedBlob`, `rotate`, …). `ref` is the root element.

props.name: crossOrigin
props.description: `crossOrigin` of the loaded image; cross-origin images need CORS (`"anonymous"`) or the exported canvas is tainted.

props.name: defaultAspect
props.description: Initial aspect ratio when uncontrolled (`null` is free).

props.name: defaultCrop
props.description: Initial crop in natural pixels when uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultRotation
props.description: Initial rotation in degrees when uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultZoom
props.description: Initial zoom factor when uncontrolled.

props.name: errorState
props.description: Replaces the default "could not be loaded" message.

props.name: keyboardStep
props.description: Arrow-key step in natural pixels (Shift multiplies by 10). Default 1.

props.name: loading
props.description: Show the loading state even after the image has loaded (e.g. while the source is prepared).

props.name: maxZoom
props.description: Largest zoom factor.

props.name: minHeight
props.description: Smallest crop in natural pixels. Default 16.

props.name: minWidth
props.description: Smallest crop in natural pixels. Default 16.

props.name: minZoom
props.description: Smallest zoom factor.

props.name: onAspectChange
props.description: Called with the new aspect ratio (or `null` for free) when the user picks a preset.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Shows an Apply button that encodes the crop and calls this.

props.name: onCropChange
props.description: Called with the crop on every change while dragging or stepping.

props.name: onCropEnd
props.description: Fires when a drag ends or after a keyboard step, with the final crop.

props.name: onImageError
props.description: Called when the image fails to load.

props.name: onImageLoad
props.description: Called with the natural size of the image once it has loaded.

props.name: onRotationChange
props.description: Called with the new rotation (0, 90, 180 or 270) when the user rotates the image.

props.name: onZoomChange
props.description: Called with the new zoom factor when it changes.

props.name: output
props.description: Output settings for Apply and `getCroppedBlob`.

props.name: rotatable
props.description: Show the rotate left/right buttons. Default true.

props.name: rotation
props.description: Clockwise rotation in degrees (snapped to 0, 90, 180, 270).

props.name: stageClassName
props.description: Classes for the image area (default height `h-80`).

props.name: toolbar
props.description: Extra controls at the end of the toolbar.

props.name: zoom
props.description: Controlled zoom factor (1 shows the whole image). Use with `onZoomChange`.

props.name: zoomable
props.description: Show a zoom slider. Default false.

ImageWithFallback.description: Image that reserves its aspect ratio, shimmers while loading and shows "Image unavailable" on error.

props.name: alt
props.description: Alternative text of the image (empty for a decorative image).

props.name: fallback
props.description: Content for the error state. Default: icon + "Image unavailable".

props.name: fetcher
props.description: Load the image yourself (e.g. with auth headers). The blob becomes an object URL, revoked on unmount.

props.name: fit
props.description: `object-fit` of the image. Default "cover".

props.name: height
props.description: Intrinsic height in px; with `width` it reserves the aspect ratio before the image loads.

props.name: imgClassName
props.description: Classes for the `` element (the wrapper gets `className`).

props.name: onError
props.description: Called when the image fails to load.

props.name: onLoad
props.description: Called when the image has loaded.

props.name: ratio
props.description: Aspect ratio (width / height) to reserve, e.g. `16 / 9`. Overrides width/height.

props.name: src
props.description: URL of the image; with no `src` the fallback shows.

props.name: width
props.description: Intrinsic size; reserves the aspect ratio before the image loads.

IncomingCall.description: Ringing incoming call card with pulsing avatar rings and Accept / Decline / Message actions.

props.name: name
props.description: Caller display name.

props.name: avatar
props.description: Custom avatar node (overrides `avatarSrc`).

props.name: avatarSrc
props.description: Caller avatar image URL; initials are shown when unset.

props.name: onAccept
props.description: Called when the user accepts the call.

props.name: onDecline
props.description: Called when the user declines the call, or when it rings out without `onTimeout`.

props.name: onMessage
props.description: Shows a "Message" quick-reply action.

props.name: onTimeout
props.description: Called when `ringFor` elapses; `onDecline` is called instead when unset.

props.name: ringFor
props.description: Auto-dismiss after this many ms (calls `onTimeout`, else `onDecline`). `0` disables. Default 30000.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Extra line under the call type, e.g. "Sutra Mail · work".

props.name: type
props.description: `audio` or `video`; sets the call type line and the accept icon. Default "audio".

props.name: variant
props.description:
`card` renders inline as a non-modal dialog (focus stays where it is; Escape inside it declines).
`overlay` is a modal alert dialog over a scrim: it focuses Accept, traps focus, hides the page
from assistive tech, declines on Escape and returns focus when it unmounts.

InfoTooltip.description: Small (i) / (?) icon button that reveals a title + description tooltip.

props.name: align
props.description: Alignment of the tooltip along that side.

props.name: contentClassName
props.description: Classes for the tooltip bubble.

props.name: description
props.description: Body text.

props.name: icon
props.description: Trigger icon: an info "i" or a help "?".

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label for the trigger.

props.name: side
props.description: Side of the trigger the tooltip opens on.

props.name: size
props.description: Icon size.

props.name: title
props.description: Bold first line.

props.name: variant
props.description: Look of the bubble: `inverse` (dark) or `light`.

InkEmoji.description: An original hand-drawn monoline version of an emoji of the built-in set, drawn in `currentColor`; renders nothing for an emoji without art unless `fallback` is set.

props.name: emoji
props.description: The emoji character to draw, e.g. "👍". A trailing variation selector does not matter.

props.name: animate
props.description:
Moves the named parts of a solid or tint drawing (eyes blink, the heart beats, hands clap): `hover` plays once when the nearest
interactive parent (a button, link or option) is hovered or focused, `loop` repeats. Reduced motion shows the still drawing.

props.name: fallback
props.description: Draws the colour glyph as ink (the filtered glyph the paper style uses) for an emoji that has no drawing, instead of rendering nothing.

props.name: playKey
props.description: Plays the motion once whenever it changes to a truthy value (also on mount), e.g. a counter bumped when a reaction is added.

props.name: size
props.description: Edge length: a number is pixels, a string is any CSS length. The drawing scales with it and is still readable at 16.

props.name: title
props.description: Names the drawing for assistive technology (`true` uses its built-in name, or the glyph itself when it has none); without it the svg is decorative and `aria-hidden`.

props.name: variant
props.description:
How the ink is laid down: `solid` fills the shapes and cuts the features out as holes, `tint` adds a light tint of the ink for
the secondary parts (tears, blush, cuffs, the core of a flame), `outline` is the monoline drawing.

InlineAlert.description:
Contextual message placed inline with content (forms, panels, settings).
`layout="strip"` turns it into an edge-to-edge bar with only a bottom border, for the top of a page or panel.

props.name: action
props.description: Trailing control(s) beside the message, before the close button (e.g. a CTA). Use `InlineAlertActions` for a row under the text.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Surface style: `soft` (tinted), `outline` (bordered) or `accent` (soft with a coloured start edge).

props.name: dismissLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the dismiss button.

props.name: icon
props.description: Custom icon; pass `false` or `null` to hide the default per-variant icon.

props.name: layout
props.description: Shape: `box` is a rounded block, `strip` is a full-width bar with only a bottom border.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Shows a close button that calls this handler.

props.name: tone
props.description: Semantic colour. Default `info`.

props.name: variant
props.description: Legacy name of `tone`.

InlineAlertActions.description: Row of buttons/links under the description.

InlineCopy.description: Single-line command with a copy button, e.g. `npm i

props.name: value
props.description: The command or text to show and copy.

props.name: prompt
props.description: Prefix shown before the value (not copied). Set `false` to hide.

props.name: size
props.description: Snippet height and text size.

props.name: theme
props.description: `dark` keeps the surface dark; `light` follows the app theme.

InlineEditText.description:
Single-line inline editor for renaming things in place: Enter or blur commits, Escape cancels,
and key presses never reach the surrounding row's shortcuts.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focus the field and select its text when it mounts. Default true.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial draft text (uncontrolled). Also the value a commit is compared against.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Default "Edit text". `aria-label` wins when both are set.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Called on Escape, and on Enter / blur when there is nothing to commit (empty or unchanged).

props.name: onCommit
props.description: Called with the trimmed text on Enter or blur, when it is non-empty and differs from the starting value.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called on every keystroke with the raw draft.

props.name: value
props.description: Draft text (controlled).

Input.description: Text input with optional icons, text addons and a clear button. Consumes `Field` context.

props.name: className
props.description:
Classes for the element that renders. Without addons that is the `<input>` itself (the root).
With addons (`leadingIcon`, `trailingIcon`, `prefix`, `suffix`, `clearable`) it lands on the
**inner** `<input>`, not the outer wrapper, so layout classes (`w-48`, `flex-1`, margins) have no
visible effect there; use `wrapperClassName` for those.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Shows a clear button while the field has a value.

props.name: clearLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the clear button.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the field invalid: error border and `aria-invalid`. Inherited from a surrounding `Field` when omitted.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Icon rendered inside the field before the text.

props.name: onClear
props.description: Called after the clear button empties the field.

props.name: prefix
props.description: Text addon before the field, e.g. "https://".

props.name: size
props.description: Field height and text size.

props.name: suffix
props.description: Text addon after the field, e.g. ".com".

props.name: trailingIcon
props.description: Icon or small action rendered inside the field after the text.

props.name: variant
props.description: `outline` (default) is the bordered box; `filled` is a tinted surface with a hidden border.

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.description:
Classes for the outer wrapper `<div>`, which is only rendered when addons are present. Put
layout/sizing classes here when the input has addons.

InputGroup.description: A container that looks like a single input and hosts addons around a control.

props.name: size
props.description: Group height and text size.

props.name: variant
props.description: `outline` (default) is the bordered box; `filled` is a tinted surface with a hidden border (the surface returns to normal on focus).

InputGroupAddon.description: Text, icon or button placed at an edge of an `InputGroup`. Clicking it focuses the control.

props.name: align
props.description: Where the addon sits: at the start or end of the line, or in a row above (`block-start`) or below (`block-end`) the input.

InputGroupButton.description: Compact button sized to sit inside an `InputGroup`.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as the child element (e.g. a link) while keeping button styles.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretches the button to the width of its container.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Icon before the label.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner and disables the button.

props.name: size
props.description: Button size: `xs` or `sm` with text, `icon-xs` or `icon-sm` for square icon buttons.

props.name: spinnerProps
props.description: Overrides for the loading spinner (variant, size, `label`, colour via `className`); it inherits the button text colour by default.

props.name: trailingIcon
props.description: Icon after the label.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style: `primary` (filled), `secondary` (bordered), `tertiary` (muted fill), `soft`, `ghost`, `outline`, `destructive`, `destructive-soft`, `inverse` or `link`.

InputGroupInput.description: The input inside an `InputGroup`. Consumes `Field` context.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the group invalid: error border and `aria-invalid`. Inherited from a surrounding `Field` when omitted.

props.name: size
props.description: Input height and text size.

InputGroupText.description: Muted inline text inside an addon, e.g. "https://" or "USD".

InputGroupTextarea.description: The textarea inside an `InputGroup`. Consumes `Field` context.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the textarea invalid: error border and `aria-invalid`. Inherited from a surrounding `Field` when omitted.

InputOTP.description: One-time code input built on `input-otp`. Compose with `InputOTPGroup` and `InputOTPSlot`.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the field invalid: error ring on the slots and `aria-invalid`. Inherited from a surrounding `Field` when omitted.

props.name: size
props.description: Slot size.

InputOTPSlot.description: A single character cell with a blinking fake caret.

props.name: index
props.description: Zero-based position of the character this slot shows.

InstallButton.description: Install-the-app button. Hidden when not installable or already installed; shows Add to Home Screen steps on iOS.

props.name: appName
props.description: App name used in the label and the iOS instructions.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as the child element (e.g. a link) while keeping button styles.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretches the button to the width of its container.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Icon before the label.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner and disables the button.

props.name: onOutcome
props.description: Called with `accepted`, `dismissed` or `unavailable` after the user responds to the install prompt.

props.name: platform
props.description: Force a platform: `ios` always shows the Add to Home Screen instructions (useful for previews).

props.name: size
props.description: Button height and padding; `icon-*` sizes are square.

props.name: spinnerProps
props.description: Overrides for the loading spinner (variant, size, `label`, colour via `className`); it inherits the button text colour by default.

props.name: trailingIcon
props.description: Icon after the label.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style: `primary` (filled), `secondary` (bordered), `tertiary` (muted fill), `soft`, `ghost`, `outline`, `destructive`, `destructive-soft`, `inverse` or `link`.

InstalledExtensionCard.description: Installed plugin row: source, version, runtime status, auth, enable / update (consent) / open / hide / remove, slots and setup.

props.name: name
props.description: Extension name, shown as the card title.

props.name: runtime
props.description: Runtime status of the extension (`running`, `disabled`, `error`, `restart-required`); sets the status pill.

props.name: authRequired
props.description: Shows an "Auth required" badge when the extension needs the user to sign in before it works.

props.name: defaultEnabled
props.description: Initial on/off state when `enabled` is not controlled.

props.name: enabled
props.description: Controlled on/off state of the enable switch.

props.name: error
props.description: Error detail shown when `runtime` is `error`.

props.name: icon
props.description: Extension icon or logo, shown beside the name.

props.name: latestVersion
props.description: Newest available version; an update is offered when it differs from `version` and `onUpdate` is set.

props.name: onEnabledChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the user flips the enable switch.

props.name: onHide
props.description: Called when the user hides the extension from the UI without uninstalling it; the button is hidden when unset.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Called when the user opens the extension's page or settings; the button is hidden when unset.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Called after the user confirms removal; may return a promise to keep the dialog busy until it settles.

props.name: onUpdate
props.description: Called after the user consents to the update.

props.name: setupCommand
props.description: Setup command shown in a copyable block.

props.name: slots
props.description: UI slots this extension contributes to (e.g. "sidebar.footer").

props.name: source
props.description: "Catalog", a git URL or a local path.

props.name: updateNotes
props.description: Changelog or notes shown in the consent dialog.

props.name: updatePermissions
props.description: New permissions requested by the update.

props.name: version
props.description: Installed version (without the leading `v`).

InstallSnippet.description: Tabbed install commands per platform or package manager, each copyable.

props.name: tabs
props.description: Install methods as tabs; each has an `id`, a `label` and a `command` (or several).

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially selected tab id when uncontrolled.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the tab list.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the id of the tab the user picked.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected tab id. Use with `onValueChange`.

InviteMembersDialog.description: Invite people by email with a role, manage current members and copy an invite link.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the dialog panel.

props.name: defaultMembers
props.description: Initial member list when uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultRole
props.description: Role selected when the dialog opens.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting text under the heading.
props.default: "Collaborate on notes, tasks and calendars in this workspace."

props.name: inviteLink
props.description: Link the "Copy invite link" button copies. Without it the button is hidden.

props.name: members
props.description:
Controlled member list when paired with `onMembersChange`. Passed alone it only seeds the
list (deprecated: use `defaultMembers` for that).

props.name: onInvite
props.description: Called with the entered emails and the chosen role when the user sends the invites. A returned promise shows a spinner; throw to show the error message.

props.name: onMembersChange
props.description: Called with the full member list after a role change or removal.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the dialog opens or closes.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Use with `onOpenChange`.

props.name: roles
props.description: Roles offered in the role select; each has a `value` and a `label`.

props.name: title
props.description: Dialog heading; the default is sample text, so set it to your workspace.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Element that opens the dialog (rendered with `asChild`).

Item.description: One row: `ItemMedia`, `ItemContent` (`ItemTitle` and `ItemDescription`) and `ItemActions`. Static, or a link or button.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render the child element as the row (a router link, say) instead of a `div`.

props.name: chevron
props.description: Show a trailing chevron on a link, button or `asChild` row (added after the child's own content).

props.name: disabled
props.description: A link or button row that cannot be used (`aria-disabled`, dimmed).

props.name: href
props.description: Make the row one link. Put no buttons inside it (a link cannot hold interactive content).

props.name: onClick
props.description: Make the row one button. Put no buttons inside it.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Lays the media, content and actions out in a row or stacks them.

props.name: rel
props.description: Link `rel` when `href` is set. Defaults to `noreferrer noopener` for `target="_blank"`.

props.name: size
props.description: Row padding and gap: `md`, `sm` or `xs`. `"default"` is a deprecated alias of `"md"` (same classes); use `"md"`.

props.name: target
props.description: Link `target` when `href` is set.

props.name: variant
props.description: Surface of the row: plain, outlined card or muted panel.

ItemActions.description: Trailing controls of a row (badges, buttons, a switch); never shrinks and wraps nothing.

ItemContent.description: The text column of a row: stacks `ItemTitle` and `ItemDescription` and takes the free width.

props.name: lines
props.description: Lines before truncating: 1 (default), 2, or `"none"` to wrap freely.

ItemGroup.description: A list of `Item` rows: plain, an outlined box or a muted tray, with hairlines between rows when `divided`.

props.name: divided
props.description: Draws a divider between rows.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when there are no children (and not loading).

props.name: loading
props.description: Show placeholder rows in the real row layout while the rows are not known yet.

props.name: loadingRows
props.description: Number of placeholder rows. Default 3.

props.name: variant
props.description: Surface of the group: plain, an outlined card, or a muted tinted panel.

ItemMedia.description: The leading visual of a row: a bare icon or glyph, an icon tile, an image or an avatar.

props.name: variant
props.description: Shape of the media slot: plain, a tinted icon tile, a rounded image or a round avatar.

ItemSeparator.description: A hairline between rows of a group that is not `divided`.

ItemTitle.description: The row's title: one truncated line (compose a flex row inside it for badges).

JobBanner.description: Banner for a long-running background job with phase dots, elapsed time and done actions.

props.name: title
props.description: Name of the job, shown in the banner header.

props.name: detail
props.description: Extra detail, e.g. the current query.

props.name: elapsed
props.description: Elapsed seconds (when not using startedAt).

props.name: onAskAgain
props.description: Called when the user presses Ask again after the job ends; the button is hidden when unset.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Called when the user cancels a running job; the Cancel button is hidden when unset.

props.name: onOpenResult
props.description: Called when the user opens the finished result; the button is hidden when unset.

props.name: phase
props.description: Current phase id.

props.name: phases
props.description: Ordered phases of the job (id and label), drawn as a step trail; defaults to planning, searching, reading and writing.

props.name: startedAt
props.description: Epoch ms the job started; elapsed time ticks itself.

props.name: status
props.description: Lifecycle status (`running | succeeded | failed | canceled`; legacy `done` / `cancelled` still work).

JobDetail.description: Detail pane for one job: actions, schedule and next runs, configuration and run history.

props.name: job
props.description: The job to show (schedule, prompt, model, delivery, state).

props.name: deliveryStatus
props.description: Delivery state per target platform, shown next to each delivery target.

props.name: hasMoreRuns
props.description: More runs exist on the server; enables "Load more" in the history.

props.name: loadingMoreRuns
props.description: Shows a busy state on "Load more" while the next page is fetched.

props.name: modelLabel
props.description: Display label for the job's model id.

props.name: now
props.description: Reference time for relative labels; set it in tests and SSR for stable output.

props.name: onDelete
props.description: Called after the user confirms.

props.name: onEdit
props.description: Called with the job when the user presses Edit; the action is hidden when unset.

props.name: onLoadMoreRuns
props.description: Called when the user asks for the next page of runs.

props.name: onOpenTranscript
props.description: Called with the run when the user opens its transcript.

props.name: onPause
props.description: Called with the job when the user presses Pause; the action is hidden when unset.

props.name: onResume
props.description: Called with the job when the user presses Resume on a paused job; the action is hidden when unset.

props.name: onRunNow
props.description: Called with the job when the user presses Run now; the action is hidden when unset.

props.name: runs
props.description: Past runs, shown in the history list and the timeline.

props.name: runsPageSize
props.description: Runs revealed per "Load more" in the history.

props.name: showTimeline
props.description: Show a timeline of recent runs.

props.name: timeZone
props.description:
IANA time zone used to describe the schedule and format times (for example `Europe/Berlin`); the viewer's zone
when unset.

props.name: jobs
props.description: Jobs to list, one row each.

props.name: empty
props.description: Content shown when there is nothing to list.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when there are no jobs. Default "No scheduled jobs yet".

props.name: modelLabels
props.description: Map model ids to labels.

props.name: onDelete
props.description: Called after the user confirms.

props.name: onEdit
props.description: Called with the job when the user presses Edit; the action is hidden when unset.

props.name: onPause
props.description: Called with the job when the user presses Pause; the action is hidden when unset.

props.name: onResume
props.description: Called with the job when the user presses Resume on a paused job; the action is hidden when unset.

props.name: onRunNow
props.description: Called with the job when the user presses Run now; the action is hidden when unset.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called with the job when a row is pressed.

props.name: selectedId
props.description: Id of the selected job; `null` or unset selects none.

props.name: at
props.description: Time of the next run (timestamp or date); renders a relative "in 5 min" label with the exact time on hover.

JobRow.description: One scheduled job: name, schedule, state, next/last run, model and mode, with row actions.

props.name: job
props.description: The job to show (name, schedule, state, model, next and last run).

props.name: modelLabel
props.description: Label for the model id.

props.name: onDelete
props.description: Called after the user confirms.

props.name: onEdit
props.description: Called with the job when the user presses Edit; the action is hidden when unset.

props.name: onPause
props.description: Called with the job when the user presses Pause; the action is hidden when unset.

props.name: onResume
props.description: Called with the job when the user presses Resume on a paused job; the action is hidden when unset.

props.name: onRunNow
props.description: Called with the job when the user presses Run now; the action is hidden when unset.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called with the job when the row is pressed.

props.name: selected
props.description: Marks the row as the selected one in the list.

JobStatePill.description: Pill for a scheduled job's state (a StatusBadge preset); `running` shows a spinner.

props.name: state
props.description:
Job state (`scheduled`, `running`, `paused`, `error`, `completed` or `disabled`); sets the pill text, icon and
tone.

props.name: label
props.description: Replaces the default text of the state.

props.name: size
props.description: Badge size of the pill.

JsonInline.description: One-line syntax-colored JSON preview: `{ id: 1, name: "x", tags: Array(3) }`.

props.name: value
props.description: The value to render on one line (objects and arrays are summarised).

props.name: maxLength
props.description: Max characters before truncating with "…". Default 80.

JsonViewer.description: Collapsible JSON tree with search, copy value/path, chunked arrays and a raw view.

props.name: chunkSize
props.description: Children shown per "Show more" chunk. Default 100.

props.name: data
props.description: Value to display.

props.name: defaultExpandDepth
props.description: Levels expanded initially. Default 1.

props.name: defaultMode
props.description: Initial view when uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultSearch
props.description: Initial search text when uncontrolled.

props.name: json
props.description: Raw JSON text (parsed; invalid JSON shows an error and the raw text).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Maximum height of the viewer in px or CSS length; longer content scrolls.

props.name: mode
props.description: Controlled view: the collapsible `tree` or the `raw` text. Use with `onModeChange`.

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Called when a value or a path is copied, with the copied text, what was copied and the path.

props.name: onModeChange
props.description: Called when the user switches between tree and raw.

props.name: onSearchChange
props.description: Called with the search text as it changes.

props.name: search
props.description: Controlled search query.

props.name: searchable
props.description: Show the search box in the toolbar. Default true.

props.name: toolbar
props.description: Show the toolbar (search, expand/collapse all, tree/raw). Default true.

KanbanAssigneeAvatar.description: Human `Avatar` or procedural `AgentAvatar` for agent assignees. The ref points at the rendered `<span>` or `<svg>`.

props.name: assignee
props.description: The person or agent to show; agents render an `AgentAvatar`.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the avatar.

props.name: size
props.description: Pixel size. Default 20.

KanbanBoard.description: Drag-and-drop task board: sortable cards and columns, WIP limits, swimlanes, quick filters and screen-reader announcements.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the board. Default "Kanban board".

props.name: board
props.description: Controlled board model: columns and their cards.

props.name: boardSwitcher
props.description: Slot at the start of the toolbar (e.g. a board switcher).

props.name: collapsedColumns
props.description: Controlled ids of the collapsed columns.

props.name: defaultBoard
props.description: Initial board when `board` is not controlled.

props.name: defaultCollapsedColumns
props.description: Initially collapsed column ids when `collapsedColumns` is not controlled.

props.name: defaultFilters
props.description: Initial filters when `filters` is not controlled.

props.name: defaultSwimlanes
props.description: Initial grouping when `swimlanes` is not controlled.

props.name: filters
props.description: Controlled filters (search, assignees, labels, priorities).

props.name: hideToolbar
props.description: Hide the filter toolbar.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale used to format card dates.

props.name: now
props.description: Reference time for overdue checks.

props.name: onAddCard
props.description: Enables the per-column "Add card" composer.

props.name: onBoardChange
props.description: Called with the next board after any move (also in controlled mode).

props.name: onCardOpen
props.description: Called with the card when the user opens it.

props.name: onCollapsedColumnsChange
props.description: Called with the collapsed column ids when the user collapses or expands a column.

props.name: onColumnMove
props.description: Called with the column id and its new index when a column is moved to another position.

props.name: onFiltersChange
props.description: Called with the filters when the user changes any of them.

props.name: onMove
props.description: Called when a card is dropped in a new place. `toIndex` is the index within the full (unfiltered) column.

props.name: onSwimlanesChange
props.description: Called with the grouping when the user picks another one.

props.name: swimlanes
props.description: Controlled grouping into horizontal lanes: `none`, `assignee` or `priority`.

props.name: toolbarExtra
props.description: Extra toolbar content at the end.

KanbanCard.description: Task card: labels, title, priority, assignee (human or agent), due date, subtasks, comments, run status.

props.name: card
props.description: The card to show (title, priority, due date, label ids, subtask counts).

props.name: actions
props.description: Actions rendered top-right (e.g. a menu).

props.name: activatorProps
props.description: Props for the full-card activator button (drag listeners, aria).

props.name: activatorRef
props.description: Ref to the full-card activator button (for drag sensors).

props.name: assignee
props.description: Assignee resolved from the card's assignee id; shown as an avatar.

props.name: done
props.description: The card's column counts as done.

props.name: labels
props.description: Labels resolved from the card's label ids; shown as chips.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale used to format the due date.

props.name: now
props.description: Reference time for the overdue check.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Called when the user activates the card to open it.

props.name: overlay
props.description: Rendered in the drag overlay.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Rendered as a drop placeholder.

KanbanPriorityIcon.description: Linear-style priority glyph (bars, or an alert square for urgent).

props.name: priority
props.description: Priority level to draw (for example low, medium, high, urgent); sets the glyph and tone.

KanbanRunBadge.description: Badge for the status of an agent run (running shimmers, failed is red).

props.name: status
props.description: Run status; canonical `TaskStatus` names or legacy spellings (`queued`, `cancelled`).

KanbanToolbar.description: Quick filters for a board: search, assignee toggles, labels and swimlane grouping.

props.name: board
props.description: Board model; supplies the assignees, labels and priorities offered by the filters.

props.name: filters
props.description: Current filters (search, assignees, labels, priorities).

props.name: onFiltersChange
props.description: Called with the new filters when the user changes any of them.

props.name: boardSwitcher
props.description: Slot at the start of the toolbar (for example a board switcher).

props.name: extra
props.description: Extra toolbar content, pushed to the end.

props.name: onSwimlanesChange
props.description: Called with the grouping when the user picks one; the control is hidden when unset.

props.name: swimlanes
props.description: Current grouping into lanes: `none`, `assignee` or `priority`. Default "none".

KeybindEditor.description: Searchable, grouped shortcut list with a key recorder, conflict detection and reset.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial overrides when uncontrolled: an object of id to keys.

props.name: labels
props.description: Texts and accessible names (English by default); pass them to translate the editor.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fired for every binding change (including the cleared side of a replace and resets).
props.deprecated: Use `onValueChange` (the overrides object) when the whole value is enough.

props.name: onResetAll
props.description: Called after the user resets every binding to its default.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the full overrides object after a binding changes or is reset.

props.name: platform
props.description: Platform whose key glyphs are shown. Defaults to the detected platform.

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.description: Placeholder of the search field.

props.name: shortcuts
props.description: Shortcut list. Falls back to `useShortcutRegistry()` inside a `ShortcutProvider`.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled overrides: id → keys ("" = cleared).

KeyboardShortcutsDialog.description:
Searchable reference of keyboard shortcuts, grouped, rendered with Kbd keys. A preset over `ShortcutsDialog`:
it lists the live shortcut registry, or the static `groups` (keys written with mac glyphs keep rendering as glyphs).

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the dialog panel.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled.

props.name: groups
props.description:
Static groups. When omitted inside a `ShortcutProvider`, the dialog lists the live shortcut
registry instead (falling back to a default Sutra reference when the registry is empty).

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the dialog opens or closes.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Use with `onOpenChange`.

props.name: title
props.description: Dialog heading.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Element that opens the dialog (rendered with `asChild`).

KeyValue.description: One fact in a `KeyValueList`, optionally copyable.

props.name: label
props.description: Name of the entry, shown as the row's label.

props.name: children
props.description: The value, when `value` is not set.

props.name: copyable
props.description: Adds a copy button; `true` copies the value text, a string copies that text instead.

props.name: mono
props.description: Shows this value in the monospace face.

props.name: truncate
props.description: Single-line with ellipsis; the full text is in the `title` tooltip. Default true in `rows`.

props.name: value
props.description: The value; `children` work too. Empty values render the list's placeholder.

KeyValueList.description: Semantic description list of facts: name on one side, value on the other.

props.name: columns
props.description: Columns for the `grid` layout.

props.name: dividers
props.description: Hairlines between rows (rows/stacked layouts). Default true.

props.name: empty
props.description: Placeholder for missing values.

props.name: items
props.description: Data-driven alternative to `KeyValue` children.

props.name: layout
props.description: `rows` label left / value right, `stacked` label above value, `grid` stacked cells in columns.

props.name: mono
props.description: Render every value in the mono face.

KeyValueRowsInput.description: Repeatable key/value rows with add/remove, duplicate-key detection and optional value masking.

props.name: addLabel
props.description: Label of the button that appends an empty row.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial rows when `value` is not controlled.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every field and the add and remove buttons.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown instead of the rows while there are none.

props.name: keyLabel
props.description: Word that ends each key field's accessible name ("Header 1 name"). Default "key".

props.name: keyPlaceholder
props.description: Placeholder of the key field in each row.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the group, also used to label row inputs.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the full row list when the user edits, adds or removes a row.

props.name: rowSlot
props.description: `data-slot` of every row. Default "key-value-row"; the header rows of `CustomEndpointForm` use "endpoint-header-row".

props.name: secret
props.description: Mask values: always, never, or `"auto"` (keys that look like secrets). Default "auto".

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled rows as `{ key, value }` entries.

props.name: valueLabel
props.description: Word that ends each value field's accessible name. Default "value".

props.name: valuePlaceholder
props.description: Placeholder of the value field in each row.

KillButton.description: Two-mode kill control (SIGTERM / SIGKILL) with an inline "Kill 1234? Confirm / Cancel" step.

props.name: onKill
props.description:
Called with the chosen signal after the user confirms; may return a promise, and the button shows "Killing…"
until it settles.

props.name: pid
props.description: Process id, shown in the confirm step and used in labels.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the button.

props.name: loading
props.description: External loading state (e.g. waiting for the process to exit). Shows "Killing…".

props.name: name
props.description: Process name, used in labels.

props.name: onConfirmingChange
props.description: Called when the confirm step opens / closes.

props.name: pending
props.description: External busy state; shows "Killing…" while true.

props.name: markOnly
props.description: Render only the geometric mark.

props.name: size
props.description: Height-driven size of the lockup.

KunjiButton.description: Brand "Sign in with kunji" button that opens `KunjiSignIn` in a dialog.

props.name: client
props.description: Kunji client that creates the session and polls for approval (see `createKunjiClient`).

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial dialog open state when uncontrolled. Default false.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretches the button to the width of its container.

props.name: onError
props.description: Called with the error when sign-in fails or is denied.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the sign-in dialog opens or closes.

props.name: onSuccess
props.description: Called with the poll result once the user has approved sign-in in kunji.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled dialog open state.

props.name: signInProps
props.description: Props for the `KunjiSignIn` inside the dialog.

props.name: size
props.description: Button height and text size: `sm`, `md` or `lg`.

props.name: theme
props.description: Button colours: `dark`, `light` (bordered) or `amber`.

KunjiLink.description: Link a kunji wallet to the signed-in account: scan, confirm with the server, then "Linked ✓".

props.name: client
props.description: Kunji client that creates the session and polls for approval.

props.name: defaultLinked
props.description: Initial linked state when `linked` is not controlled.

props.name: description
props.description: Helper text under the heading.

props.name: linked
props.description: Controlled linked state.

props.name: onLink
props.description: Confirm the approved scan with the server. Throw to show an error.

props.name: onLinkedChange
props.description: Called with the new state after a link or unlink succeeds.

props.name: onUnlink
props.description: Remove the link. Hidden when omitted.

props.name: sub
props.description: Linked identity (`sub`).

props.name: title
props.description: Heading of the card. Default "kunji sign-in".

KunjiLinkedBadge.description: Small badge: "kunji linked" or "kunji not linked".

props.name: linked
props.description: Whether the account is linked to kunji; `false` shows the not-linked state. Default true.

props.name: size
props.description: Badge size.

props.name: sub
props.description: kunji `sub`, shortened in the tooltip.

KunjiMark.description:
The kunji brand assets, as published in the kunji brand guide: `variant="tile"` is the logo (the app icon: an amber
rounded square with the ink key set at -40 degrees) and `variant="glyph"` is the key mark on its own, drawn in
`currentColor` (ink on the amber button, paper on the dark one). Do not recolour, rotate, stretch or add effects.

props.name: size
props.description: Pixel size. The brand guide asks for at least 20px for the logo; 18px is what the official button uses for the key mark.

props.name: title
props.description: Accessible name; when unset the mark is decorative and hidden from assistive tech.

props.name: variant
props.description: `tile` the kunji logo (the amber app icon with the ink key), `glyph` the key mark alone in `currentColor`.

KunjiRpSignIn.description: Renders the official hosted rp.js button. Opt-in: Sutra's own `KunjiSignIn` makes no third-party requests.

props.name: options
props.description: Options for the hosted relying-party script (client id, callback and so on).

props.name: adapter
props.description: Adapter from `createRpScriptAdapter()`. Loading the hosted script is a third-party request.

props.name: onError
props.description: Called with the error when the hosted script fails to load or sign-in fails.

props.name: onSuccess
props.description: Called with the success detail from the hosted script.

KunjiSignIn.description: "Sign in with kunji" widget: runs the protocol against the app's own endpoints and renders every state.

props.name: client
props.description: Kunji client that creates the session and polls for approval (see `createKunjiClient`).

props.name: appName
props.description: App name shown in the identity line. Defaults to the session's.

props.name: audience
props.description: Domain shown in the identity line. Defaults to the session's audience.

props.name: autoStart
props.description: Start a session on mount. Default true.

props.name: codeLength
props.description: Digits for `enter` mode. Default 8.

props.name: codeMode
props.description: `show`: the app shows a code to type in kunji (the protocol's fallback). `enter`: type a code kunji shows.

props.name: deepLink
props.description: "Open kunji" same-device link: hero on small screens (`auto`), always, or never.

props.name: description
props.description: Replace the "You're signing in to … at …" line.

props.name: footer
props.description: Extra content under the widget (e.g. "Other ways to sign in").

props.name: notLinkedActions
props.description: Shown in the not-linked state. Defaults to buttons for `onLink`/`onRegister`.

props.name: onError
props.description: Called with the error when creating the session or polling fails.

props.name: onLink
props.description: Called when the user presses the link button in the not-linked state; the button shows when set.

props.name: onRegister
props.description: Called when the user presses the register button in the not-linked state; the button shows when set.

props.name: onStatusChange
props.description: Called with the new status each time the attempt moves to another state.

props.name: onSuccess
props.description: Called after the success animation with the approved poll result.

props.name: pollInterval
props.description: Override the client's poll interval.

props.name: qrLogo
props.description: Logo on the QR plate. Defaults to the kunji mark. Pass `null` for none.

props.name: qrSize
props.description: QR code width and height in px. Default 196, or 148 for the compact variant.

props.name: showSteps
props.description: Show the 1-2-3 steps. Default true except for `compact`.

props.name: slowAfter
props.description: Mark the attempt `slow` after this many ms of loading or awaiting approval. Default 15000. 0 disables.

props.name: statusText
props.description: Override live-region messages.

props.name: successDelay
props.description: Delay between the success state and `onSuccess`, for the animation. Default 900ms.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading. Pass `null` to hide the header.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Layout: `card` (bordered, with heading), `inline` (no chrome) or `compact` (smaller QR, no steps). Default
"card".

KunjiSignInPage.description: Full-page kunji sign-in: brand, the kunji QR as the hero, "Other ways to sign in" and a footer.

props.name: client
props.description: The kunji client that issues and polls sign-in challenges (and supplies the app name).

props.name: children
props.description: The form. Defaults to a `LoginCard`.

props.name: copyright
props.description: Copyright line.

props.name: footerLinks
props.description: Links in the page footer (terms, privacy, help); each has a `label` and an `href`.

props.name: heading
props.description: Heading above the widget; defaults to "Sign in to" plus the app name.

props.name: homeHref
props.description: Where the logo links to.

props.name: kunjiProps
props.description: Props passed through to the kunji widget (everything except `client`).

props.name: logo
props.description: Logo shown at the top. Defaults to the Sutra lockup.

props.name: onKunjiSuccess
props.description: Called with the poll result when a kunji sign-in is approved.

props.name: onPasswordSubmit
props.description: Called with the username and password when the password form is submitted. A returned promise shows a spinner; throw to show the error message.

props.name: onTokenSubmit
props.description: Called with the token when the token form is submitted. A returned promise shows a spinner; throw to show the error message.

props.name: otherMethods
props.description: Other ways offered under the widget. Pass `[]` to hide.

props.name: renderLink
props.description: Renders the logo and footer links in place of the default `<a>`, e.g. to use your router's Link.

props.name: usernameLabel
props.description: Label of the username field in the password form.

KunjiSignInView.description: Presentational kunji sign-in: QR with logo plate, countdown, steps, code fallback, deep link and per-state status.

props.name: state
props.description: Current sign-in state: status, QR payload, code and error, as returned by `useKunjiSignIn`.

props.name: appName
props.description: App name shown in the identity line. Defaults to the session's.

props.name: audience
props.description: Domain shown in the identity line. Defaults to the session's audience.

props.name: codeLength
props.description: Digits for `enter` mode. Default 8.

props.name: codeMode
props.description: `show`: the app shows a code to type in kunji (the protocol's fallback). `enter`: type a code kunji shows.

props.name: deepLink
props.description: "Open kunji" same-device link: hero on small screens (`auto`), always, or never.

props.name: description
props.description: Replace the "You're signing in to … at …" line.

props.name: footer
props.description: Extra content under the widget (e.g. "Other ways to sign in").

props.name: notLinkedActions
props.description: Shown in the not-linked state. Defaults to buttons for `onLink`/`onRegister`.

props.name: onLink
props.description: Called when the user presses the link button in the not-linked state; the button shows when set.

props.name: onRefresh
props.description: Called when the user refreshes an expired QR code.

props.name: onRegister
props.description: Called when the user presses the register button in the not-linked state; the button shows when set.

props.name: onRequestCode
props.description:
Called when the user asks for a code (`codeMode="show"`); the code option is available only when set or when the
session carries a code.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Called when the user retries after an error.

props.name: onStart
props.description: Called when the user starts sign-in (before a session exists).

props.name: onSubmitCode
props.description: Called with the typed code (`codeMode="enter"`).

props.name: qrLogo
props.description: Logo on the QR plate. Defaults to the kunji mark. Pass `null` for none.

props.name: qrSize
props.description: QR code width and height in px. Default 196, or 148 for the compact variant.

props.name: showSteps
props.description: Show the 1-2-3 steps. Default true except for `compact`.

props.name: statusText
props.description: Override live-region messages.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading. Pass `null` to hide the header.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Layout: `card` (bordered, with heading), `inline` (no chrome) or `compact` (smaller QR, no steps). Default
"card".

Label.description: Form label with an optional required asterisk and `hint`; use it with `htmlFor` or let `Field` wire it. Extra props are spread to the `<label>`.

props.name: hint
props.description: Muted helper shown after the label text, e.g. "(optional)".

props.name: required
props.description: Appends a red asterisk (hidden from assistive technology); set `required` on the control itself for validation.

LanguageBar.description: Source/target language row: recent chips, full picker and a swap button.

props.name: defaultSource
props.description: Initial source code when uncontrolled. Default "auto" (detect).

props.name: defaultTarget
props.description: Initial target code when uncontrolled. Default "en".

props.name: detected
props.description: Language detected while source is "auto".

props.name: languages
props.description: Languages to offer in both pickers; defaults to the built-in list.

props.name: onSourceChange
props.description: Called with the language code when the user picks a source language.

props.name: onSwap
props.description: Custom swap; default swaps (using the detected language when source is "auto").

props.name: onTargetChange
props.description: Called with the language code when the user picks a target language.

props.name: recentSources
props.description: Recently used source codes, most recent first, listed at the top of the source picker.

props.name: recentTargets
props.description: Recently used target codes, most recent first, listed at the top of the target picker.

props.name: source
props.description: Controlled source language code, or `"auto"` to detect.

props.name: target
props.description: Controlled target language code.

LanguagePicker.description: Searchable language list (English/native name/code) with Detect, Recent and keyboard navigation.

props.name: allowDetect
props.description: Offer the "Detect language" pseudo-option.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focuses the search field on mount.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially selected code when uncontrolled.

props.name: detected
props.description: Language detected while on "Detect".

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the list. Default "Languages".

props.name: languages
props.description: Languages to offer, each with a code and name; defaults to the built-in list.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the language code when the user picks a language.

props.name: recent
props.description: Recently used codes, most recent first.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled language code of the selected entry.

LayoutPresetPicker.description: Thumbnail grid of layout presets plus saving and re-applying custom arrangements.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called with the layout to apply.

props.name: allowSave
props.description: Show the save form. Default true.

props.name: current
props.description: Current arrangement: highlights the matching preset and is what "Save" stores.

props.name: defaultSavedPresets
props.description: Initially saved layouts when uncontrolled.

props.name: onSavedPresetsChange
props.description: Called with the full list of saved layouts after one is saved or deleted.

props.name: panes
props.description: Panes to distribute into a chosen preset (default: panes of `current`).

props.name: presets
props.description: Built-in presets. Default `layoutPresets`.

props.name: savedPresets
props.description: Controlled list of saved layouts (each with an `id`, a `name` and a `layout`), listed after the built-in presets. Use with `onSavedPresetsChange`.

LayoutThumbnail.description: Mini SVG preview of a layout tree.

props.name: layout
props.description: The layout to draw as a small thumbnail.

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between tiles in viewBox units (viewBox is 100×64). Default 3.

Lightbox.description: Fullscreen media viewer: arrows/swipe, zoom + pan, counter, thumbnails, Escape to close, focus trap.

props.name: items
props.description: Items to show; each has a `src`, an `alt` and an optional caption, type, thumbnail, poster and download name.

props.name: children
props.description: Children (e.g. `LightboxTrigger`s) can open the viewer at an index.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the viewer panel.

props.name: defaultIndex
props.description: Initial item index when uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled.

props.name: download
props.description: Show a download link for the current item. Default false.

props.name: index
props.description: Controlled index of the visible item. Use with `onIndexChange`.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the viewer. Default "Image viewer".

props.name: loop
props.description: Wrap from the last item to the first. Default false.

props.name: maxZoom
props.description: Maximum zoom factor. Default 4.

props.name: onIndexChange
props.description: Called with the new item index when the user browses.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the viewer opens or closes (Escape, backdrop click, the close button).

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Use with `onOpenChange`.

props.name: thumbnails
props.description: Show the thumbnail strip (when there is more than one item). Default true.

LightboxTrigger.description: Opens the surrounding `Lightbox` at `index`. Render inside `<Lightbox>`'s children.

props.name: index
props.description: Item index to open.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as the child element instead of a `<button>`, keeping the trigger behaviour.

LineChart.description: Multi-series line chart with optional dots and reference (threshold) lines.

props.name: data
props.description: Rows to plot, one per index value.

props.name: index
props.description: Key of the x (category / time) value in each datum.

props.name: series
props.description: Series to draw: each has a `key` (the field in each row), a `label` and an optional colour.

props.name: animate
props.description: CSS transitions on data changes (disabled under prefers-reduced-motion). Default true.

props.name: connectNulls
props.description:
Draw straight through null values instead of breaking the line (the null points themselves stay absent).
`xAxis.maxGap` still breaks it. Per-series `connectNulls` wins. Default false.

props.name: curve
props.description: Curve between points: smooth (`monotone`), straight (`linear`) or stepped.

props.name: defaultHiddenSeries
props.description: Initially hidden series keys when uncontrolled.

props.name: dots
props.description: Draw a dot on every data point.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Content shown instead of the plot when there is no data.

props.name: grid
props.description: Gridlines along value ticks ("horizontal"), category ticks ("vertical"), both, or none. Default horizontal.

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in px (legend excluded). Default 240.

props.name: hiddenSeries
props.description: Controlled list of hidden series keys (toggled from the legend). Use with `onHiddenSeriesChange`.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Defaults to a description built from the series.

props.name: legend
props.description: Default: shown below for 2+ series.

props.name: legendInteractive
props.description: Allow toggling/isolating series from the legend. Default true.

props.name: loading
props.description: Data is on its way: with no data, a placeholder plot (and legend) of the same size; with data, the root is marked busy.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale for the default number and date formatting. Pass one explicitly when the server and the browser must agree (SSR). Defaults to the runtime locale.

props.name: onActiveIndexChange
props.description: Called with the hovered index (or `null` when the pointer leaves); use it to sync other views.

props.name: onHiddenSeriesChange
props.description: Called with the hidden series keys when a legend entry is toggled.

props.name: referenceLines
props.description: Horizontal threshold / target lines.

props.name: strokeWidth
props.description: Line thickness in px.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Shows a tooltip with every series at the hovered index.

props.name: valueFormatter
props.description: Formats values in the tooltip and on the value axis. Receives the value and the series key. Default is the localized number.

props.name: xAxis
props.description: Index axis options (drawn vertically in horizontal bar layout).

props.name: yAxis
props.description: Value axis options.

LinkPreviewCard.description: Link card with title, description, domain and an optional image slot. Data comes from the app; nothing is fetched.

props.name: href
props.description: Address the card links to; unsafe schemes are not linked.

props.name: description
props.description: Short excerpt of the page.

props.name: domain
props.description: Overrides the domain derived from `href`.

props.name: icon
props.description: Site icon; defaults to a local Favicon monogram.

props.name: image
props.description: Image slot (app-provided element; Sutra never fetches previews).

props.name: layout
props.description: `horizontal` puts the image beside the text, `vertical` stacks it above.

props.name: title
props.description: Page title; the domain is used when unset.

LiveVisitorsMap.description:
Live analytics screen: a header with live, country and source counts, a globe or flat map of avatar markers with
source badges and clusters, a visitor list whose rows select and fly to the marker, and a card for the selected visitor.

props.name: visitors
props.description: Visitors currently on the site, each with a location, source and last-seen time.

props.name: autoRotate
props.description: Spin the globe while nothing is selected (see `Globe`'s `autoRotate`). Default true.

props.name: defaultSelectedId
props.description: Initially selected visitor id when `selectedId` is not controlled.

props.name: defaultView
props.description: Default `globe`.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown in the list when there are no visitors.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the screen. Default "Live visitors".

props.name: liveWithinMs
props.description: Visitors seen within this many ms get a pulsing marker and read "now". Default 60 000.

props.name: loading
props.description: Data is on its way: skeletons with no visitors yet, otherwise the screen is marked busy.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for country names and numbers.

props.name: mapClassName
props.description: Classes for the map column.

props.name: maxSources
props.description: How many sources the header lists before "+N". Default 4.

props.name: now
props.description: Reference time for "now / 1m" labels. Default: the clock, refreshed every 15 s.

props.name: onSelectedIdChange
props.type: (id: string | null, visitor: LiveVisitor | undefined) => void
props.description: Called when a marker or list row is selected, or the card is closed (`null`).

props.name: onViewChange
props.description: Called with the view when the user flips the globe and flat switch.

props.name: renderVisitorActions
props.description: Actions in the visitor card, e.g. a "View history" button.

props.name: selectedId
props.description: Controlled id of the selected visitor; `null` selects none.

props.name: sources
props.description: Header source counts. Defaults to counts grouped from `visitors`.

props.name: total
props.description: Live count in the header when it differs from `visitors.length` (e.g. only a sample is plotted).

props.name: view
props.description: Controlled view: `globe` or `flat`.

props.name: windowLabel
props.description: Time window text in the header, e.g. "Last 30 minutes".

LocalModelBrowser.description: Searchable list of downloadable local models with quant variants, fit hints and download progress.

props.name: models
props.description: Models available to download, each with its quantisation options.

props.name: downloads
props.description: Per-model download state, keyed by model id.

props.name: hardware
props.description: Machine profile; when set, each model shows a hardware-fit hint.

props.name: onCancelDownload
