props.description: Called with the model id when the user cancels a running download.

props.name: onDownload
props.description: Called with the model id and the chosen quantisation when the user starts a download.

props.name: onQueryChange
props.description: Called with the search text when the user types in the search field.

props.name: query
props.description: Search text that filters the list; controlled by the parent when set.

LockScreen.description: Full-screen vault unlock: PIN boxes, password or passkey, with attempts, lockout and recovery-key mode.

props.name: appName
props.description: App identity shown above the form.

props.name: description
props.description: Text under the heading.

props.name: footer
props.description: Extra content at the bottom (e.g. "Sign out").

props.name: fullscreen
props.description: Cover the window (`fixed`). Set false to fill the parent box.

props.name: icon
props.description: App icon; defaults to the Sutra mark.

props.name: lockedUntil
props.description: Externally imposed lockout end (epoch ms).

props.name: lockoutSeconds
props.description: Lockout length in seconds, or a function of how many lockouts happened (1, 2, …).

props.name: maxAttempts
props.description: Wrong attempts allowed before a lockout. UI-only: the counter lives in this component's state and resets on reload, so enforce real limits on the server.

props.name: mode
props.description: Primary unlock method. `passkey` shows only the passkey button.

props.name: onPasskey
props.description: Shows "Unlock with passkey". Resolve `false` to report a failure.

props.name: onRecover
props.description: Enables the "Use recovery key" secondary mode.

props.name: onUnlock
props.description: Resolve `true` to unlock, `false` for a wrong secret. Throwing counts as wrong.

props.name: passkeyLabel
props.description: Text of the passkey button.

props.name: pinLength
props.description: Number of digits of the PIN.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading of the lock screen.

LoginCard.description: Email + password sign-in card with remember me, forgot link and SSO buttons.

props.name: defaultEmail
props.description: Initial value of the email field.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting text under the heading; each card has its own default.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message shown above the form (e.g. a failed sign-in); also marks the form invalid.

props.name: footer
props.description: Replace the default footer (e.g. "Don't have an account? Sign up"). Pass `null` to hide it.

props.name: forgotPasswordHref
props.description: Link target of "Forgot password?".

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Element of the card title (`1` is an `h1`). Use `2` or lower when the card sits inside a page that has its own `h1`.

props.name: loading
props.description: Disables the form and shows a spinner on the submit button (use it while you sign in).

props.name: logo
props.description: Show the Sutra mark above the title, or pass a custom logo. Default: true for `card`.

props.name: onSocialSignIn
props.description: Called with the provider when a social button is clicked. A returned promise shows a spinner on that button.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called with the form values. Return a promise to show a spinner; throw to show the error message.

props.name: providers
props.description: OAuth providers shown above the form. Pass `[]` to hide.

props.name: renderLink
props.description: Router link renderer for the footer and inline links.

props.name: showRemember
props.description: Shows the "Remember me" checkbox.

props.name: signUpHref
props.description: Link target of the "Sign up" prompt.

props.name: socialLayout
props.description: Social buttons as a row/grid (for two or three providers) or stacked full-width.

props.name: submitLabel
props.description: Text of the submit button.

props.name: title
props.description: Card heading; each card has its own default.

props.name: variant
props.description: `card` renders a bordered surface; `plain` renders only the content (for full-page layouts).

LogoCloud.description: A grid or marquee row of company logos.

props.name: columns
props.description: Grid columns (non-marquee).

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds per full marquee loop.

props.name: limit
props.description: Number of placeholder logos when `logos` is not provided.

props.name: logos
props.description: Logos to show. Defaults to the first `limit` placeholder logos.

props.name: logoSize
props.description: Size of each logo.

props.name: marquee
props.description: Scroll the logos in an infinite marquee row instead of a grid.

props.name: muted
props.description: Muted grayscale logos that brighten on hover.

props.name: pausable
props.description: Marquee mode: show a pause and play button beside the row (see `Marquee` `pausable`).

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.description: Pauses the marquee while the pointer is over it.

props.name: reverse
props.description: Runs the marquee in the opposite direction.

props.name: title
props.description: Optional caption above the logos, e.g. "Trusted by teams at".

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.name: defaultFilter
props.description: Initial search text when uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultLevels
props.description: Initially shown levels when uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultPaused
props.description: Initial pause state when uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultRegex
props.description: Initially treat the search text as a regular expression.

props.name: defaultShowLineNumbers
props.description: Initial line-number visibility when uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultShowTimestamps
props.description: Initial timestamp visibility when uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultSource
props.description: Initially selected source when uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultWrap
props.description: Initial wrapping when uncontrolled.

props.name: downloadName
props.description: File name for "Download". Default `logs.log`.

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Legacy name of `emptyState`.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when there are no lines (and no filter/connection message applies). Default "No log lines yet".

props.name: entries
props.description: Alias of `lines`.

props.name: filter
props.description: Controlled search text. Use with `onFilterChange`.

props.name: filterBySource
props.description: Also hide entries whose `source` differs from the selected one (client-side). Default false.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the scrolling area. Default 360.

props.name: hideToolbar
props.description: Hide the toolbar (search, level filters, actions).

props.name: levels
props.description: Levels currently shown. Default all.

props.name: lines
props.description: Log lines: raw strings (ANSI allowed) or structured entries. Append to the same array or pass a new one.

props.name: maxLines
props.description: Ring-buffer cap on retained lines. Default 10 000.

props.name: onFilterChange
props.description: Called with the search text as it changes.

props.name: onLevelsChange
props.description: Called with the shown levels when a level filter is toggled.

props.name: onPausedChange
props.description: Called when the user pauses or resumes.

props.name: onReconnect
props.description: Called by the "Reconnect" button shown while disconnected.

props.name: onRegexChange
props.description: Called when the regex toggle changes.

props.name: onShowLineNumbersChange
props.description: Called when the line-number toggle changes.

props.name: onShowTimestampsChange
props.description: Called when the timestamp toggle changes.

props.name: onSourceChange
props.description: Called with the source the user picked.

props.name: onWrapChange
props.description: Called when the wrap toggle changes.

props.name: paused
props.description: Controlled pause state: while paused the view freezes and new lines are counted. Use with `onPausedChange`.

props.name: regex
props.description: Treat the filter as a regular expression.

props.name: rowHeight
props.description: Row height in px used for virtualization. Default 20.

props.name: showLineNumbers
props.description: Controlled visibility of the line-number column. Use with `onShowLineNumbersChange`.

props.name: showTimestamps
props.description: Controlled visibility of the timestamp column. Use with `onShowTimestampsChange`.

props.name: source

MagicLinkCard.description: Passwordless sign-in: email only, then a "check your inbox" confirmation.

props.name: defaultEmail

props.description: Disables the form and shows a spinner on the submit button.

props.name: logo
props.description: Show the Sutra mark above the title, or pass a custom logo. Default: true for `card`.

props.name: mailAppHref

props.name: onSentChange

props.name: onSubmit

props.name: passwordSignInHref
props.description: Link target of the "Sign in with password" alternative.

props.name: renderLink
props.description: Router link renderer for the footer and inline links.

props.name: sent
props.description: Control the "check your inbox" state.

props.name: title
props.description: Card heading; each card has its own default.

props.name: variant
props.description: `card` renders a bordered surface; `plain` renders only the content (for full-page layouts).

Magnetic.description:
Makes its child drift toward the mouse when the pointer comes within `radius` of it (the `magnetic` utility). The
wrapper stays put and measures; an inner box moves, so the hit area and the layout do not shift. Clicks, hover and
focus work as without it. Wrap a button, a link or an icon; not a text field. Touch and reduced motion: still.

props.name: radius
props.description: How far past its edge the pointer starts to pull, in px. Default 80.

props.name: strength
props.description: How much of the pointer's offset it follows, 0..1. Default 0.35 (paper scales it down).

Markdown.description: Token-styled markdown renderer (GFM), memoized per block so streaming only re-renders the tail.

props.name: children
props.description: Markdown source.

props.name: citeCount
props.description:
Number of citable sources: bracketed refs like `[1]` or `[2,3]` in prose (not code or links)
render as citation pills. Defaults to `sources.length` when `sources` is given.

props.name: components
props.description: Override or extend the element renderers. Keep the object stable (module scope or useMemo).

props.name: math
props.description:
Render TeX math with KaTeX: inline `$…$` and display `$$…$$`. Default false.
Consumers must also load the KaTeX stylesheet once: `import "katex/dist/katex.min.css";`

props.name: onCite
props.description: Called with the 1-based source number when a citation pill is clicked (pills render as buttons).

props.name: rehypePlugins
props.description: Extra rehype plugins. Keep the array stable.

props.name: remarkPlugins
props.description: Extra remark plugins (GFM is always on). Keep the array stable.

props.name: sources
props.description: Sources for citation pills; `sources[n-1]` supplies the title (and href/snippet hover card).

MarketingHeader.description: Marketing site header: logo, Products mega-menu of the 8 Sutra apps, links, auth actions and a mobile sheet.

props.name: apps

props.name: border

props.name: getAppHref

props.name: renderLink
props.description: Renders every link in place of the default `<a>`, e.g. to use your router's Link. Spread the given props onto it.

props.name: signupHref

props.name: signupLabel
props.description: Text of the sign-up button.

props.name: sticky
props.description: Pins the header to the top of the page.

MarketplaceCard.description: Marketplace entry card: banner, icon, name, author, description, stars, version, capabilities (+N), platforms, dates, tier.

props.name: compact
props.description: Legacy form of `density="compact"`.

props.name: maxCapabilities

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Called with the extension when the card is clicked; the card then becomes a button.

MarketplaceGrid.description: Filterable marketplace: tier/category pills with counts, sort pills, category sections with "View all", load more and empty state.

props.name: items
props.description: Extensions to list, before search and filters.

props.name: defaultCategory
props.description: Initially selected category filter when uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultSort

props.name: defaultTier
props.description: Initially selected tier filter when uncontrolled.

props.description: Called when the empty state's reset button is pressed (after filters reset).

MarketplaceHero.description: Marketplace / docs hero: title, subtitle, meta stats row and a search field on a mesh-gradient glow.

props.name: children
props.description: Extra content under the search (popular tags, CTAs).

props.name: defaultQuery
props.description: Initial search text when uncontrolled.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Small label above the title.

props.name: onQueryChange
props.description: Called with the search text as it changes.

props.name: query
props.description: Controlled search text. Use with `onQueryChange`.

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.description: Placeholder of the search field.

props.name: stats
props.description: Counters under the search (e.g. plugins, authors); each has a `label` and a `value`.
props.default: [ { value: "678", label: "plugins" }, { value: "120", label: "authors" }, { value: "1.2M", label: "installs" }, ]

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Supporting text under the headline.
props.default: "Tools, hooks and integrations built by the Sutra team and the community. Install in one command."

props.name: title
props.description: Hero headline.

Marquee.description:
An endless, slowly scrolling row of items (logos, chips, quotes). The row repeats its items as often as the width needs,
hides the repeats from assistive tech and stands still, wrapped onto lines, under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Keep the items presentational: the repeats are inert, so links and buttons inside would not work in them.

props.name: children
props.description: The items. Each child becomes one list item; the whole set is repeated to make the loop seamless.

props.name: defaultPaused
props.description: Initial paused state when uncontrolled. Default false.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for one loop. Default 30.

props.name: fade
props.description: Fade the left and right edges out. Default true.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between items: a number is pixels, a string is any CSS length. Default `3rem`.

props.name: itemClassName
props.description: Classes for every item's `li`.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the list.

props.name: onPausedChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the button is pressed.

props.name: pausable
props.description:
Show a pause and play button at the end of the row, in the flow beside the track (WCAG 2.2.2: moving content
needs a control that outlasts hover and focus, for touch and keyboard users). Hidden under reduced motion, where
the row is already still. Default false.

props.name: paused
props.description: Controlled paused state. The button toggles it; `pauseOnHover` still pauses on top of it.

props.name: pauseLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the pause button (a toggle: it stays the same while `aria-pressed` flips). Default "Pause scrolling".

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.description: Stop scrolling while the pointer or keyboard focus is inside. Default true.

props.name: reverse
props.description: Scroll left to right instead of right to left.

McpServerCard.description: MCP server summary with transport, status, tool count, last error and Test / Connect / Disable / Remove / Logs actions.

props.name: name

props.name: status

Connection state: `connected`, `connecting`, `failed`, `disabled` or `needs-auth`; sets the status pill and the

props.name: transport

props.name: endpoint

props.name: moreInfoLabel

props.description: The media controls that read the container.

MemoryGlyphIcon.description: Small SVG swatch of a memory-map glyph.

props.name: size

MemoryMap.description: Knowledge / memory graph over time on a canvas: d3-force layout, radial time rings, pan/zoom, legend filter, time scrubber, detail panel and an accessible list view.

props.name: nodes
props.description: Memories to plot, each with an id, title, kind, creation time and optional links to other nodes.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.name: defaultHiddenKinds

props.name: defaultListView
props.description: Initial state when `listView` is not controlled.

props.name: defaultSelectedId

props.name: defaultZoom

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale used to format dates and numbers.

props.name: onEdit

props.description: Called with the hidden kinds when the user toggles one in the legend.

props.name: onLayout

props.name: onListViewChange

props.name: onTimeRangeChange

props.name: onZoomChange

props.name: radialTime

props.name: renderDetail

MorphDialog.description:
A dialog (or bottom sheet) that grows out of the rectangle of the thing that opened it and shrinks back into it. The panel is
clipped to the origin's box and its radius and slides onto its final place (Web Animations on the spring token, nothing is
scaled, so text never stretches); the scrim, the shadow and the parts marked `data-morph-fade` appear late and go early.
It is a Radix Dialog underneath: focus is trapped and handed back on close (to the `trigger`, or to whatever had it), Escape,
the close button and a press on the scrim close it, and the panel stays mounted until the closing flight ends. Reduced motion
(or no `animate`) means no flight at all. Pass `origin` (an element, a ref or a rect), or use `ExpandCard` for a card that is
its own origin. Start the panel's content with the same face as the origin and the flight reads as one object.

props.name: title
props.description: Accessible name of the dialog.

props.name: children
props.description: The panel content. Parts marked `data-morph-fade` appear late and go early.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes of the panel.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Start open (uncontrolled).

props.name: description
props.description: Accessible description.

props.name: onCloseAutoFocus
props.description: Runs when focus is handed back; `preventDefault()` keeps the default (the trigger, or whatever had focus).

props.name: onMorphEnd
props.description: Runs when the open or close flight has finished (at once under reduced motion).

props.name: onOpenAutoFocus
props.description: Runs when focus moves into the panel; `preventDefault()` keeps Radix from choosing the element.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Asked to open or close: Escape, the close button, a press on the scrim or the trigger.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the dialog is open (controlled).

props.name: origin
props.description: The box the panel grows from and shrinks back into. It is measured when the dialog opens and again when it closes. Without one the panel lifts in.

props.name: overlayClassName
props.description: Classes of the scrim.

props.description: Show the title as a heading at the top of the panel instead of hiding it from sight. Default false.

props.description: Width of the panel: sm, md or lg. Default "md".

props.name: trigger
props.description: The element that opens it (rendered with `asChild`); it gets focus back on close.

props.name: variant
props.description: `"dialog"` is centred, `"sheet"` docks to the bottom edge, `"auto"` is a sheet below the `sm` breakpoint. Default "auto".

MorphPill.description:
One surface that changes size between states (idle, a picker, a running timer, a sync status): its width and height
follow the measured content on a spring token, and the new content fades in as the old one goes. Under reduced
motion the size and the content swap at once (the shared net). Controlled (`state`) or uncontrolled (`defaultState`);
pass a function as a state's content to switch states from inside. It is an inline surface: put it in a container
with room (`max-w-full` keeps it inside a narrow one, and its content is clipped, not overflowing).

props.name: states
props.description: The content of each state; a function receives the current state and `setState`, for buttons inside the pill.

props.name: announcement
props.description: Text for a polite live region that screen readers hear when the state changes (the pill itself is silent).

props.description: Initial state key when uncontrolled.

props.description: Accessible name; makes the pill a `role="group"`.

props.name: onStateChange
props.description: Called with the new state key when `setState` from a state's render function is used.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the pill's root `<div>` (the component is generic, so `ref` is a plain prop).

props.name: spring
props.description: Which spring token the size change rides. Default "snappy".

props.name: state
props.description: Controlled state key; one of the keys of `states`. Use with `onStateChange`.

PanSurface.description:
An inertial canvas for boards and big images: drag it and it keeps gliding with time-based friction (`usePan`), stops at its
edges with a springy bounce, and moves with the wheel and the arrow keys (Shift for bigger steps, Page Up and Down, Home to
recenter). With `zoom` the existing `useZoomPan` handles the scale (wheel with Ctrl or Command, buttons, `+`, `-`, `0`);
the offset stays in `usePan`'s CSS variables, so a drag never re-renders. A recenter button appears once the canvas has
moved. It is a labelled, focusable group whose content stays in the DOM order for screen readers. A drag on a button inside
the canvas still pans and the click after a drag is swallowed; put `data-pan-ignore` on parts that need their own pointer
handling. The surface takes touch from the page (`touch-action: none` on its axis), so leave room to scroll around it.

props.name: children
props.description: The canvas: a board, a big image, a diagram. It is centred and keeps its own size.

props.name: apiRef
props.description: Imperative handle (`recenter`, `panTo`, `panBy`, `get`).

props.name: axis
props.description: Axis that follows the finger; the other is left to native scrolling. Default "both".

props.name: bounds
props.description: `"content"` stops the canvas where its edge meets the viewport (a canvas that fits cannot move); `"none"` lets it go anywhere. Default "content".

props.name: contentClassName
props.description: Classes of the layer that moves (padding around the canvas goes here).

props.name: contentSize
props.description: Natural size of the canvas when it is known (otherwise measured).

props.name: controls
props.description: The control buttons: `"auto"` shows them once the canvas has moved or zoomed, `true` always, `false` never. Default "auto".

props.name: defaultScale
props.description: The zoom at rest and after Recenter. Default 1.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Ignore drags, the wheel and keys (and drop the tab stop).

props.name: friction
props.description: Friction per second of the glide after a flick. Default 6.

props.name: home
props.description: Where the canvas rests and where Recenter and Home bring it: `"center"`, or `"start"` to line its inline-start and top edges up with the viewport's (a board begins at its first column; right-to-left text starts at the right). Default "center".

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the surface. Default "Pannable canvas".

props.name: maxScale
props.description: Largest zoom. Default 4.

props.name: minScale

Shared by every document opened with it. Takes precedence over `workerSrc`.

`GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc`. The modern `pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs` works too, but only in the
newest browsers; where it fails on a missing built-in the viewer warns once and parses in the page instead.
Serve it from the page's origin under a strict CSP (a cross-origin worker needs `worker-src blob:`).

Presence.description:
Mounts a child when `present` turns true and unmounts it after its exit animation when it turns false. The child carries `data-state="open" | "closed"` and `data-presence="enter" | "idle" | "exit"`, so plain classes do the motion:
...
 An exiting child is `inert` and `aria-hidden` (out of the tab order and the accessibility tree at once, still painted) and is removed on its own `animationend` / `transitionend`, or after `exitDuration`. Under `prefers-reduced-motion` it mounts and unmounts at once, with no enter or exit state. For a list use `AnimatedList`; Radix overlays already do this.

props.name: children
props.description: One element that accepts DOM props (it gets `data-state`, `data-presence`, `inert` and the animation listeners).

props.name: present
props.description: Whether the child should be on screen. Going to false keeps it mounted until its exit animation has ended.

props.name: enterDuration
props.description: Milliseconds before an entering child settles to `idle` even if no `animationend` or `transitionend` arrived (a safety net; the child's own end event settles it first). Default 600.

props.name: exitDuration
props.description: Milliseconds before an exiting child is removed even if no `animationend` or `transitionend` arrived. Default 200, the speed of `animate-fade-out`.

props.name: initial
props.description: Animate the child in when it is present on the first render too. Default false.

props.name: onExited
props.description: Called once the child has been removed.

Progress.description:
Linear progress bar, determinate or indeterminate (role="progressbar"): how far a task has got.
For a level read against thresholds (disk usage, context window) use `Meter` instead.
Restyle the track with `className` (e.g. `rounded-none bg-transparent` for an edge strip) and the fill with `indicatorClassName`.

props.name: color
props.description: Legacy name of `tone`.

props.name: formatValue
props.description:
Formats the displayed value; receives the value and `max`. Default is the rounded percentage, e.g. "40%". A text or number
result is also used as `aria-valuetext`.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Forces the looping animation regardless of `value` (also used when `value` is null).

props.name: indicatorClassName
props.description: Classes for the filled indicator bar (`className` styles the track).

props.name: label
props.description: Text shown above the bar; it also becomes the accessible name.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show the percentage on the right of the bar or above it, next to the label.

props.name: size
props.description: Track height: 2xs 2px (hairline loading strips), xs 4px, sm 6px, md 8px, lg 12px. Default "md".

props.name: tone
props.description: Semantic colour of the filled part. Default "primary".

props.name: value
props.description: Completed amount from 0 to `max`; `null` or `undefined` renders the indeterminate animation.

ProgressCircle.description:
Circular progress ring with centered value (role="progressbar"): task completion, like `Progress`.
`RingMeter` draws the same ring as a threshold-coloured level (role="meter"), e.g. a context window.

props.description: Custom center content (overrides the value).

props.name: gradient

props.description: Accessible name of the progressbar (`aria-label`).

props.name: max
props.description: Value that counts as 100%.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show the percentage in the center. Default true.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter in px.

props.name: strokeWidth
props.description: Ring thickness in px.

props.name: tone
props.description: Semantic colour of the filled part. Default "primary".

props.name: value
props.description: Completed amount from 0 to `max`; the centre shows it as a percentage unless `children` replaces it.

QuotaBars.description:
Compact row of provider icons with thin accent bars, as in a dashboard's Agents tile. Each bar is a meter named after
the provider with value text such as "72% left".

The Agents tile is a `StatCard` with this row as its body:
```tsx
<StatCard label="Agents" icon={<RiRobot2Line />} accent="violet" href="/agents"
  caption="Claude · Max 20x · This week" value="72%" unit="left"
  stats={[{ label: "Resets", value: formatResetsIn(claude.resetsAt) }, { label: "Sessions", value: 2 },
          { label: "Tokens today", value: formatTokens(1_780_000) }]}>
  <QuotaBars quotas={quotas} />
</StatCard>
```
