props.description: Ring diameter: sm 44, md 56 (default), lg 72.

props.name: startsAt
props.description: Window start; enables the pace line ("On pace · 10% to spare").

props.name: tolerance
props.description: "On pace" band in percentage points. Default 5.

props.name: used
props.description: Usage so far in units of `limit`. Wins over `percent`.

QuotaStrip.description: Row of provider quota rings: one column on phones, two on small screens, four on wide ones.

props.name: quotas
props.description: Quotas to show, one ring each.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when `quotas` is empty. Default "No quotas".

props.name: loading
props.description: Waiting for the quotas: with none yet, `loadingRows` placeholder rings stand in (rings without a reading show placeholders too).

props.name: loadingRows
props.description: Placeholder rings while loading with no quotas. Default 4.

props.name: mode
props.description: What each ring and number show: `left` (remaining) or `used`. Default "left".

props.name: now
props.description: Reference time for pace and reset text. Default `Date.now()` at render.

props.name: size
props.description: Ring size.

props.name: tolerance
props.description: "On pace" band in percentage points. Default 5.

props.name: variant
props.description: `card` (default): a padded card surface · `plain`: no surface.

RadarChart.description: Radar (spider) chart: polygon rings, labelled spokes, toggleable series, spoke-by-spoke keyboard and a tooltip per spoke.

props.name: data
props.description: One row per spoke (a measure), with a value for each series.

props.name: index
props.description: Key of the spoke name in each datum.

props.name: series
props.description: One polygon per series.

props.name: animate
props.description: CSS transitions on data changes (disabled under prefers-reduced-motion). Default true.

props.name: defaultHiddenSeries
props.description: Initially hidden series keys when uncontrolled.

props.name: domain
props.description:
Value range from the center to the rim: `[min, max]`, either end may be `"auto"` (fit the data). Default: from
0 (or the lowest value, when negative) up to a round number above the highest.

props.name: dots
props.description: Mark each value on its spoke. Default true.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Content shown instead of the plot when there is no data.

props.name: fill
props.description: Tint the inside of each polygon. Default true.

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in px (legend excluded). Default 320.

props.name: hiddenSeries
props.description: Controlled list of hidden series keys (toggled from the legend). Use with `onHiddenSeriesChange`.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Defaults to a description built from the series.

props.name: legend
props.description: Default: shown below for 2+ series.

props.name: legendInteractive
props.description: Allow toggling/isolating series from the legend. Default true.

props.name: levelLabels
props.description: Print the ring values between the first two spokes. Default true.

props.name: levels
props.description: Approximate number of grid rings. Default 4.

props.name: loading
props.description: Data is on its way: with no data, a placeholder radar (and legend) of the same size; with data, the root is marked busy.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale for the default number formatting. Pass one explicitly when the server and the browser must agree (SSR). Defaults to the runtime locale.

props.name: onActiveIndexChange
props.description: The spoke under the pointer or keyboard focus (index in `data`), or null.

props.name: onHiddenSeriesChange
props.description: Called with the hidden series keys when a legend entry is toggled.

props.name: shape
props.description: Grid rings as polygons (default) or circles. Fewer than three spokes always use circles.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Shows a tooltip with every series at the hovered axis.

props.name: valueFormatter
props.description: Formats values in the tooltip and on the axis. Receives the value and the series key. Default is the localized number.

RadioCard.description: Bordered, selectable card variant of a radio item.

props.name: label
props.description: Primary text of the card (the whole card is the label and click target).

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting text under the label.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon shown at the start of the card.

props.name: indicatorPosition
props.description: Which side of the card the radio dot sits on.

props.name: radioClassName
props.description: Class for the radio control (`className` styles the card).

props.name: size
props.description: Radio size: `sm` 14px or `md` 16px.

RadioField.description: Radio item with a label and optional description.

props.name: description
props.description: Secondary text under the label, announced as the item description.

props.name: label
props.description: Label shown beside the radio and wired to it, so clicking it selects the item.

props.name: labelClassName
props.description: Classes for the `<label>` element.

props.name: size
props.description: Radio size: `sm` 14px or `md` 16px.

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.description: Classes for the wrapper around the radio, label and description.

RadioGroup.description: Single-choice group of radio items. Consumes `Field` context.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the group invalid: error styling on the items and `aria-invalid`. Inherited from a surrounding `Field` when omitted.

RadioGroupField.description: Data-driven radio group with a label, description and an `options` array.

props.name: options
props.description: Options to render, in order; each has a `value`, a `label` and optional description, icon and disabled flag.

props.name: description
props.description: Help text under the group label.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the group invalid: error styling on the items and `aria-invalid`. Inherited from a surrounding `Field` when omitted.

props.name: label
props.description: Group label shown above the options; it is the accessible name of the group.

props.name: size
props.description: Radio size for every option.

props.name: variant
props.description: `card` renders each option as a `RadioCard`.

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.description: Class for the outer wrapper.

RadioGroupItem.description: A radio button with a springy dot indicator.

props.name: size
props.description: Radio size: `sm` 14px or `md` 16px.

RangeSlider.description: `Slider` preset with two thumbs (defaults to the full min–max range).

props.name: accent
props.description: Categorical colour for the range, thumb border and active marks. Default primary.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Formats the number shown in the value bubble (see `showValue`). Default shows the raw value.

props.name: getValueText
props.description: Accessible value text per thumb (`aria-valuetext`), e.g. `(v) => v + "%"`.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the slider invalid: error styling on the range and `aria-invalid`. Inherited from a surrounding `Field` when omitted.

props.name: marks
props.description: Tick marks under the track; numbers or `{ value, label }`.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show a value bubble above the thumb on hover, focus and drag. `"always"` keeps it visible.

props.name: size
props.description: Track and thumb size.

props.name: thumbLabels
props.description:
Accessible labels per thumb, e.g. `["Volume"]` or `["Minimum", "Maximum"]`. Without it a single thumb is named by
`aria-label` / `aria-labelledby` (or the surrounding `FieldLabel`); two thumbs are "Minimum" and "Maximum".

props.name: tone
props.description: Semantic colour (`success`, `warning`, …). Takes precedence over `accent`.

Rating.description: Star rating input with hover preview, half steps and radiogroup keyboard support.

props.name: activeClassName
props.description: Class applied to the filled part of each icon (defaults to an amber fill).

props.name: allowClear
props.description:
Let the user take the rating back to 0: click the selected star again, press Delete, Backspace or 0, or arrow
below the first step. `false` keeps a given rating at one star or more. Default true.

props.name: allowHalf
props.description: Allow half-star values (0.5 steps).

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial rating when uncontrolled.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the control: dimmed and not focusable.

props.name: getLabel
props.description: Builds the accessible label for each option.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon component used for every star; receives `className`.

props.name: inactiveClassName
props.description: Class applied to the empty part of each icon.

props.name: max
props.description: Number of stars.

props.name: name
props.description: Name for a hidden input, for native form submission.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new rating when the user picks, clears or steps it.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Displays the rating without letting the user change it (still announced as a rating).

props.name: size
props.description: Star size.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled rating, from 0 to `max` (halves when `allowHalf`). Use with `onValueChange`.

RatingSummary.description: Review summary: average score, stars, count and a 5→1 distribution chart.

props.name: average
props.description: Average score, e.g. 4.3.

props.name: count
props.description: Total number of ratings. Defaults to the sum of `distribution`.

props.name: countLabel
props.description: Text after the count.

props.name: distribution
props.description: Ratings per star, keyed by star value: `{ 5: 120, 4: 40, … }`.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale used to format the average and the counts.

props.name: max
props.description: Number of stars the average is out of.

ReadToolBody.description: File read body: path, line range and an optional snippet.

props.name: path
props.description: Path of the file that was read.

props.name: endLine
props.description: Last line that was read (1-based); completes the "Lines 10–40" label.

props.name: language
props.description: Code language for highlighting the `snippet`; guessed from `path` when unset.

props.name: onOpenFile
props.description: Called when the user presses the path; the path is plain text when unset.

props.name: snippet
props.description: Excerpt of what was read.

props.name: startLine
props.description: First line that was read (1-based); shown in the range label and used as the snippet's first line number.

props.name: totalLines
props.description: Total lines in the file; shown as "of N" after the range, or alone as "N lines" without a range.

RealProfileConsentDialog.description: Asks before letting the agent use the user's real browser profile (cookies, logins) instead of a clean one.

props.name: agentName
props.description: Name of the agent asking for the real browser profile, shown in the copy.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the dialog content.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when `open` is not controlled.

props.name: defaultRemember
props.description: Default state of "Remember my choice".

props.name: onChoose
props.description: Called with the choice and whether to remember it. Closes the dialog.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the dialog opens or closes.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state of the dialog.

props.name: profileName
props.description: e.g. "Chrome — Personal".

props.name: site
props.description: Site the agent wants to open, shown in the copy.

ReasoningPill.description: Composer pill summarizing thinking / fast / effort, with a popover of toggles and an EffortSlider.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial settings when `value` is not controlled.

props.name: levels
props.description: Effort levels offered in the slider, lowest to highest.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new settings when the user changes any control in the popover.

props.name: supportsEffort
props.description: Show the effort slider; set false when the current model has fixed effort.

props.name: supportsFast
props.description: Show the Fast mode switch; set false when the current model has no fast mode.

props.name: supportsThinking
props.description: Hide controls the current model doesn't support.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled reasoning settings (thinking on/off, effort level, fast mode).

RecoveryKey.description: Recovery key panel: grouped mono grid, copy/download/share/print, auto-clear countdown and a confirm-saved step.

props.name: value
props.description: The raw key (separators are ignored).

props.name: autoClearAfter
props.description: Hide the key after this many ms (0 disables). Default 60000.

props.name: columns
props.description: Grid columns for the groups. Default 4.

props.name: confirm
props.description: Ask the user to type the last 4 characters before finishing. Default true.

props.name: fileContent
props.description: File body. Defaults to a short header plus the grouped key.

props.name: fileName
props.description: Download file name; `false` hides the button.

props.name: groupSize
props.description: Characters per group, separated by a gap. Default 4.

props.name: onConfirmed
props.description: Called after the confirm step succeeds (or on "I've saved it" when `confirm` is false).

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Called after the key has been copied.

props.name: onDownload
props.description: Called after the key file has been downloaded.

props.name: onHide
props.description: Fired when the key is hidden (timer or "Hide now").

props.name: onPrint
props.description: Override printing.

props.name: printable
props.description: Show a Print button. Default true.

props.name: share
props.description: Show a Share button when the Web Share API is available.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading of the card. Default "Recovery key".

RecoveryKeyInput.description: Recovery key entry with auto-grouping, uppercase normalization and validation.

props.name: alphabet
props.description: Allowed characters (tested per uppercased char).

props.name: className
props.description:
Classes for the element that renders. Without addons that is the `<input>` itself (the root).
With addons (`leadingIcon`, `trailingIcon`, `prefix`, `suffix`, `clearable`) it lands on the
**inner** `<input>`, not the outer wrapper, so layout classes (`w-48`, `flex-1`, margins) have no
visible effect there; use `wrapperClassName` for those.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Shows a clear button while the field has a value.

props.name: clearLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the clear button.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial key when `value` is not controlled.

props.name: groupSize
props.description: Characters per group shown between separators. Default 4.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the field invalid: error border and `aria-invalid`. Inherited from a surrounding `Field` when omitted.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Icon rendered inside the field before the text.

props.name: length
props.description: Expected number of characters. Default 24.

props.name: onClear
props.description: Called after the clear button empties the field.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Called once the key reaches `length` and passes `validate`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the normalized key (no separators) on every edit.

props.name: prefix
props.description: Text addon before the field, e.g. "https://".

props.name: separator
props.description: Text between groups in the field. Default "-".

props.name: showStatus
props.description: Show the "n / length" counter and validity hint. Default true.

props.name: size
props.description: Field height and text size.

props.name: suffix
props.description: Text addon after the field, e.g. ".com".

props.name: trailingIcon
props.description: Icon or small action rendered inside the field after the text.

props.name: validate
props.description: Return true or an error message.

props.name: value
props.description: Normalized key (no separators).

props.name: variant
props.description: `outline` (default) is the bordered box; `filled` is a tinted surface with a hidden border.

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.description:
Classes for the outer wrapper `<div>`, which is only rendered when addons are present. Put
layout/sizing classes here when the input has addons.

RecurrencePicker.description: Repeat-rule editor: none / daily / weekly (weekday toggles) / monthly / yearly / custom interval, plus an end condition.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial rule when uncontrolled; the default is "does not repeat".

props.name: legend
props.description: Caption of the fieldset, shown above the controls.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new rule after every edit.

props.name: referenceDate
props.description: Reference date used for sensible defaults (weekday, day of month). Default today.

props.name: showSummary
props.description: Show the human-readable summary under the controls. Default true.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled recurrence rule (frequency, interval, weekdays, end). Use with `onValueChange`.

RegionStatusMap.description:
Infrastructure regions on a world map or globe: markers toned by status and sized by load, replication/traffic
links as arcs, a status legend with counts, a sortable region table whose rows select the marker, and a detail
panel (status, incident, load meter, latency and node readings, links, actions) for the selected region.

props.name: regions
props.description: Regions to plot and list, each with a name, location, status, latency and load.

props.name: autoRotate
props.description: Spin the globe view slowly (see `Globe`'s `autoRotate`).

props.name: cluster
props.description: Merge nearby markers into count bubbles. Default false.

props.name: defaultSelectedId
props.description: Initially selected region id when `selectedId` is not controlled.

props.name: defaultSort
props.description: Initial table sort when `sort` is not controlled.

props.name: defaultView
props.description: Initial view when `view` is not controlled: `map` or `globe`.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown instead of the map and table when there are no regions.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the map. Defaults to a summary ("Region map: 12 regions, 1 down, 2 degraded").

props.name: latencyThresholds
props.description: Latency (ms) at which readings turn warning / destructive. Default `{ warning: 150, danger: 300 }`.

props.name: links
props.description: Replication or traffic links between regions, drawn as arcs toned by health.

props.name: loading
props.description: Data is on its way: skeletons with no regions yet; otherwise the current regions stay and the root is busy.

props.name: loadingRows
props.description: Skeleton rows in the table while loading. Default 5.

props.name: loadThresholds
props.description: Load percent at which meters turn warning / destructive. Default `{ warn: 75, danger: 90 }`.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for numbers.

props.name: onSelectedIdChange
props.type: (id: string | null, region: StatusRegion | undefined) => void
props.description: Called with the region id (or `null`) and the region when the user selects or clears one.

props.name: onSortChange
props.description: Called with the sort (or `null`) when the user changes it.

props.name: onViewChange
props.description: Called with the view when the user flips the map and globe toggle.

props.name: renderRegionActions
props.description: Actions in the selected region's detail panel (e.g. "Open dashboard", "Drain").

props.name: selectedId
props.description: Selected region id (shows its detail and highlights its marker and row).

props.name: sort
props.description: Table sort. Default: status, worst first. `null` keeps the order of `regions`.

props.name: view
props.description: Flat map (default) or globe.

props.name: viewToggle
props.description: Show the map / globe toggle. Default true.

RegisterWithKunji.description: First-time kunji registration: handle with live rules, name, invite code, then awaiting approval if needed.

props.name: awaitingProps
props.description: Props passed through to the `AwaitingApproval` screen shown when the account is pending.

props.name: firstAdmin
props.description: First person on the server becomes its admin.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Element of the card title (`1` is an `h1`).

props.name: joinPolicy
props.description: How new people join.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Create the account. Return `{ pending: true }` (or use `joinPolicy="approval"`) to show `AwaitingApproval`.

props.name: reservedHandles
props.description: Handles that cannot be taken (checked case-insensitively).

props.name: sub
props.description: kunji identity being registered.

props.name: suggestedName
props.description: Name the field starts with.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading of the form.

props.name: variant
props.description: `card` draws the bordered card; `plain` drops the chrome.

RemoteCursor.description: Colored pointer/caret with a name label for another collaborator; the label fades when idle.

props.name: name
props.description: Collaborator name shown on the cursor label.

props.name: x
props.description: Position inside the nearest positioned ancestor (px number or any CSS length).

props.name: y
props.description: Vertical position inside the nearest positioned ancestor (a number is px, or any CSS length).

props.name: caretHeight
props.description: Caret height in px. Default 20.

props.name: color
props.description: Defaults to a color derived from `id ?? name`.

props.name: id
props.description: Stable collaborator id; with the name, it seeds the default colour.

props.name: idleTimeout
props.description: Hide the name label after this many ms without movement. Default 3000; 0 keeps it.

props.name: variant
props.description: `arrow` for canvases, `caret` for text editors.

RemoteScreenViewer.description: Frame for an agent's computer-use screen: state, control lease, fit / fullscreen, latency and screenshot. Bring your own VNC canvas.

props.name: state
props.description: Connection state: `connecting`, `live`, `paused` or `disconnected`; sets the status badge and overlay.

props.name: children
props.description:
Your remote-desktop surface. Sutra does not bundle a VNC / RDP client: mount e.g. a noVNC
`RFB` canvas (or a WebRTC `<video>`) here and it is scaled into the frame.

props.name: controller
props.description: Who holds the input lease.

props.name: defaultController
props.description: Initially controlling party when `controller` is not controlled.

props.name: defaultFit
props.description: Initial scale-to-fit state when `fit` is not controlled.

props.name: fit
props.description: Scale-to-fit (default) or actual size with scrolling.

props.name: frameSrc
props.description: Alternative to `children`: an image stream (MJPEG URL or the latest screenshot data URL).

props.name: latencyMs
props.description: Round-trip latency in ms.

props.name: onControllerChange
props.description: Called with the new controller when the user takes or hands back control.

props.name: onFitChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the user toggles between fit and actual size.

props.name: onReconnect
props.description: Shows a Reconnect button while disconnected.

props.name: onScreenshot
props.description: Shows a screenshot button.

props.name: screenHeight
props.description: Remote desktop height in px, used with `screenWidth` for the aspect ratio. Default 800.

props.name: screenWidth
props.description: Remote desktop width / height, used for the aspect ratio and "actual size". Default 1280×800.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading in the viewer toolbar.

ReorderableList.description:
Accessible reorderable list: drag handle with placeholder, Space-to-lift keyboard moves, optional arrow buttons, live announcements.
A generic plain function (React 19 `ref` prop) rather than `forwardRef`, which would erase the item type `T`.

props.name: getKey
props.description: Returns a stable unique key for an item.

props.name: items
props.description: Items to render, in the current order.

props.name: onReorder
props.description: Called with the new order and a description of the move after every reorder.

props.name: renderItem
props.description: Renders the row content for an item; the context carries drag and position state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables dragging, the handles and the move buttons.

props.name: flip
props.description:
Rows glide to their new place when the order changes (while dragging, with the keyboard or the buttons), and a
dropped row settles from where it was let go (`useFlip`; pass options to tune it). Off under reduced motion. Default true.

props.name: getLabel
props.description: Text used in announcements and button labels. Defaults to `String(item)`.

props.name: handle
props.description: Show the drag handle (pointer drag + keyboard pick-up). Default true.

props.name: itemClassName
props.description: Classes for every row.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the list.

props.name: labels
props.description: Button names and screen-reader announcements (English by default); pass them to translate the list.

props.name: moveButtons
props.description: Show up / down buttons on each row.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the `<ul>` element (the component is generic, so `ref` is a plain prop).

RepeatButton.description: Tri-state repeat toggle cycling off → all → one.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial mode when `value` is not controlled. Default "off".

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the next mode when the user presses the button, which cycles off, all and one.

props.name: size
props.description: Button size: `sm`, `md` or `lg`.

props.name: tone
props.description: `default` follows the theme; `overlay` is for controls drawn over video or artwork.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled repeat mode: `off`, `all` or `one`.

props.name: id
props.description: The request id to show and copy.

RequestInspector.description: LLM / API request record: header, param chips and Messages | Request | Response | Raw tabs.

props.name: record
props.description: The request to inspect (messages, request and response bodies, timing, tokens).

props.name: defaultTab
props.description: Initially active tab when `tab` is not controlled.

props.name: hideHeader
props.description: Hide the header (when rendered under a table row that already shows it).

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale used to format numbers and times.

props.name: onTabChange
props.description: Called with the tab when the user switches tabs.

props.name: tab
props.description: Controlled active tab: `messages`, `request`, `response` or `raw`.

RequestLogTable.description: Filterable, paginated request log with rows that expand into a RequestInspector.

props.name: records
props.description: Request log records, one row each, newest first.

props.name: defaultFilters
props.description: Initial filters when `filters` is not controlled.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when no record matches the filters.

props.name: expandedId
props.description: Controlled expanded record id.

props.name: filters
props.description: Controlled filters (status, model, time range, search).

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale used to format numbers and times.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Called with the record id (or `null`) when the user expands or collapses a row.

props.name: onFiltersChange
props.description: Called with the filters when the user changes any of them.

props.name: pageSize
props.description: Rows per page. Default 20.

props.name: showIdentity
props.description: Shows the Identity (user or key) column. Default true.

props.name: toolbar
props.description: Extra toolbar content (refresh button, date picker…).

ResetPasswordCard.description: Set a new password with strength meter and confirmation; success state afterwards.

props.name: backHref
props.description: Link target of the "Back to sign in" link.

props.name: continueHref
props.description: Makes the success state's "Continue" button a link to this URL (alternative to `onContinue`).

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting text under the heading; each card has its own default.
props.default: "Your new password must be different from previously used passwords."

props.name: error
props.description: Error message shown above the form; also marks the form invalid.

props.name: footer
props.description: Replace the default footer (e.g. "Don't have an account? Sign up"). Pass `null` to hide it.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Element of the card title (`1` is an `h1`). Use `2` or lower when the card sits inside a page that has its own `h1`.

props.name: loading
props.description: Disables the form and shows a spinner on the submit button.

props.name: logo
props.description: Show the Sutra mark above the title, or pass a custom logo. Default: true for `card`.

props.name: minScore
props.description: Minimum strength score (1 to 4) required to submit.

props.name: onContinue
props.description: Called from the success state's "Continue" button.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called with the new password when the form is submitted. A returned promise shows a spinner; throw to show the error message.

props.name: renderLink
props.description: Router link renderer for the footer and inline links.

props.name: title
props.description: Card heading; each card has its own default.

props.name: variant
props.description: `card` renders a bordered surface; `plain` renders only the content (for full-page layouts).

ResourceHero.description: Endpoint / service header: name, status, copyable endpoint, uptime, readiness and config chips.

props.name: name
props.description: Resource name, shown as the heading.

props.name: actions
props.description: Buttons on the right of the header.

props.name: chips
props.description: Config chips (key → value).

props.name: description
props.description: Line under the name (for example a model or region).

props.name: endpoint
props.description: Endpoint URL with a copy button.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon beside the name.

props.name: ready
props.type: { ready: number; total: number; noun?: string }
props.description: "N of M ready" counter.

props.name: status
props.description: Connection state (`online`, `offline`, `connecting` or `error`); sets the status dot and label. Default "online".

props.name: statusLabel
props.description: Replaces the default text of the status.

props.name: uptime
props.description: Preformatted uptime shown beside the status.

ResponseRating.description: Good / Bad rating with optional follow-up reason chips and a thank-you state.

props.name: badReasons
props.description: Reason chips after a bad rating. Empty to submit immediately.

props.name: goodReasons
props.description: Reason chips after a good rating. Empty (default) to submit immediately.

props.name: onRate
props.description: Called with `good` or `bad` as soon as the user picks a thumb.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description:
Called with the rating and chosen reasons once the user finishes (immediately when there are no reasons for that
rating).

props.name: prompt
props.description: Prompt beside the thumbs. Default "How did this go?".

props.name: thanksText
props.description: Text shown after submitting. Default "Thanks for the feedback".

ReviewFileTree.description: Changed files as a directory tree with colored A / M / D / R status letters and single selection.

props.name: files
props.description: Changed files; shown as a folder tree built from their paths.

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: Initially selected path when `selected` is not controlled.

props.name: onOpenFile
props.description: Called on click / Enter on a file.

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.description: Called with the file path (or `null`) when the selection changes.

props.name: selected
props.description: Selected file path.

props.name: showStats
props.description: Per-file +/− counts. Default false.

props.name: size
props.description: Row size.

ReviewScopeTabs.description: Uncommitted / Branch vs base / Last turn scope switch with file counts.

props.name: baseBranch
props.description: Base branch for the "Branch vs base" label.

props.name: counts
props.description: File counts per scope.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial scope when `value` is not controlled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the scope when the user switches tabs.

props.name: scopes
props.description: Hide scopes, e.g. "turn" outside a session.

props.name: size
props.description: Tab size.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled review scope: `uncommitted`, `branch` or `turn`.

RewindButton.description: Message-action icon button that opens a `RewindDialog`.

props.name: message
props.description: Preview of the target message.

props.name: buttonClassName
props.description: Extra classes for the trigger button; `className` goes to the dialog.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the dialog content.

props.name: confirmLabel
props.description: Label of the confirm button. Default "Rewind".

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when `open` is not controlled.

props.name: defaultScope
props.description: Initially selected scope when `scope` is not controlled; defaults to the first enabled one.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the trigger button.

props.name: files
props.description: Files that would be restored.

props.name: fork
props.description: Show the fork notice when the conversation is rewound. Default true.

props.name: forkNotice
props.description: Text of the fork notice; shown when `fork` is true.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label and tooltip. Default "Rewind to here".

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the dialog opens or closes.

props.name: onRewind
props.description: Called with the chosen scope when the user confirms; may return a promise, and the dialog waits for it.

props.name: onScopeChange
props.description: Called with the scope value when the user picks another one.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state of the dialog.

props.name: scope
props.description: Controlled value of the selected scope.

props.name: scopes
props.description:
What can be rewound (conversation, files or both); defaults to the built-in options. Disabled options cannot be
chosen.

props.name: timestamp
props.description: When the target message was sent.

props.name: title
props.description: Dialog heading.

RewindDialog.description: Rewind to a message/checkpoint: preview, "What to restore" choice, file summary and fork notice.

props.name: message
props.description: Preview of the target message.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the dialog content.

props.name: confirmLabel
props.description: Label of the confirm button. Default "Rewind".

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when `open` is not controlled.

props.name: defaultScope
props.description: Initially selected scope when `scope` is not controlled; defaults to the first enabled one.

props.name: files
props.description: Files that would be restored.

props.name: fork
props.description: Show the fork notice when the conversation is rewound. Default true.

props.name: forkNotice
props.description: Text of the fork notice; shown when `fork` is true.
props.default: "A new forked conversation will be created; the current one stays in your history."

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the dialog opens or closes.

props.name: onRewind
props.description: Called with the chosen scope when the user confirms; may return a promise, and the dialog waits for it.

props.name: onScopeChange
props.description: Called with the scope value when the user picks another one.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state of the dialog.

props.name: scope
props.description: Controlled value of the selected scope.

props.name: scopes
props.description:
What can be rewound (conversation, files or both); defaults to the built-in options. Disabled options cannot be
chosen.

props.name: timestamp
props.description: When the target message was sent.

props.name: title
props.description: Dialog heading.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Element that opens the dialog (rendered with `asChild`).

RichEmbed.description: Renders a URL as a provider embed (after consent) or a link card. The iframe src is only built into the DOM post-consent.

props.name: url
props.description: Address to embed; matched against `providers`, and shown as a link card when no provider matches.

props.name: consented
props.description: Skip the consent gate (only when your app already obtained consent).

props.name: description
props.description: Excerpt shown on the link-card fallback.

props.name: image
props.description: Image slot for the link-card fallback (app-provided).

props.name: onAllowAlways
props.description:
Fired with the consent key when the user picks "Always allow": the provider id (e.g. `"youtube"`),
or `"<id>:<origin>"` for origin-scoped providers such as Mastodon (`"mastodon:<origin>"`).
Store it as-is in `EmbedConsentProvider`'s `allowed` list.

props.name: onConsent
props.description: Fired when the embed is loaded after consent, with the provider id and the consent key.

props.name: providers
props.description: Embed providers to match `url` against, first match wins; defaults to the built-in list.

props.name: title
props.description: Title for the local preview, the iframe title and the link card.

RichTextEditor.description:
TipTap 3 WYSIWYG editor (StarterKit + Link + Placeholder) with Sutra prose styling, a bubble
toolbar on selection and/or a fixed `RichTextToolbar`, controlled HTML or JSON value.

The extension setup (`extensions`, `starterKit`, `history`, `placeholder`) is read when the editor is
created, as in TipTap; remount with a new `key` to change it. For Yjs: `history={false}` plus
`extensions={[Collaboration.configure({ document: ydoc })]}`, and leave `value`/`defaultValue` unset.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focuses the editor on mount.

props.name: contentClassName
props.description: Classes for the editable content area.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial content when `value` is not controlled.

props.name: editorRef
props.description: Receives the TipTap editor instance.

props.name: extensions
props.description:
Extra TipTap extensions (mentions, tables, Collaboration…), appended after the built-ins. Read once at mount:
the TipTap editor is created once, so remount (change `key`) to apply a different set.

props.name: format
props.description: Default "html".

props.name: history
props.description:
StarterKit's undo/redo history. Default true. Set false when something else owns undo, e.g. Yjs through TipTap's
Collaboration extension (which brings its own undo/redo, so the toolbar buttons stay). Without a replacement the
toolbar's undo/redo buttons are hidden. Read once at mount (remount with a new `key` to change it); wins over
`starterKit.undoRedo`.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the editable area. Default "Rich text editor".

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called on every edit with the serialized value and the TipTap editor.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called on every edit with the serialized value and the TipTap editor.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Text shown while the document is empty. Default "Start writing…".

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Makes the content non-editable. Default false.

props.name: size
props.description: Prose size. Default "md".

props.name: starterKit
props.description:
StarterKit options merged over the defaults (`{ link: false }`; the editor adds its own Link). Set a key to `false`
to drop that extension, e.g. `{ heading: { levels: [1, 2] }, codeBlock: false }`. Read once at mount.

props.name: toolbar
props.description: "bubble" (on selection), "fixed" (above), "both" or "none". Default "bubble".

props.name: value
props.description: HTML string (`format="html"`) or ProseMirror JSON (`format="json"`).

RichTextToolbar.description: Fixed formatting toolbar for a `RichTextEditor` (or any TipTap editor with StarterKit + Link).

props.name: editor
props.description: The TipTap editor to control (from `editorRef` or `useEditor`); the toolbar renders nothing while it is `null`.

props.name: children
props.description: Extra tools appended after the defaults.

props.name: history
props.description:
Undo / redo buttons. Default true; they are left out anyway when the editor has no undo/redo commands
(`RichTextEditor history={false}` without a replacement such as TipTap's Collaboration extension).

RingMeter.description:
Compact ring showing a fill level against thresholds (role="meter"), e.g. an AI context window.
It draws the same ring as `ProgressCircle` (`ProgressRingSvg`); use `ProgressCircle` for task completion (role="progressbar").

props.name: value
props.description: Value in `max` units (percent by default). `null` means no reading yet: an empty track.

props.name: accent
props.description:
Categorical ring colour (a provider or metric colour). Colour order: the warning/danger threshold colours, then
`tone`/`color`, then `accent`, then primary. Sets `--sutra-accent` on the root.

props.name: children
props.description: Extra content after the ring, e.g. a token count.

props.name: color
props.description: Legacy name of `tone`.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name, e.g. "Context window".

props.name: loading
props.description: Waiting for the first reading: with `value` null, the track stays empty and a placeholder stands in for the percentage.

props.name: max
props.description: Value that counts as 100%.

props.name: showValueAbove
props.description: Show the percentage beside the ring once it reaches this percent. Default 50. Use 0 to always show.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter in px. Default 20.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Ring thickness in px; scales with `size` by default.

props.name: thresholds
props.description: Warning and danger percent cut-offs for the automatic colour, or `false` to turn it off.

props.name: tone
props.description: Base tone below thresholds. Default `primary`.

RotatingNoticeBar.description: Global notice strip that rotates through notices with a dot pager and a pause button, also pausing on hover or focus. Renders an `AlertBanner`.

props.name: notices
props.description: Notices to rotate through; each has an `id` and `content`, with optional tone and action.

props.name: autoRotate
props.description: Default true. Always off under prefers-reduced-motion.

props.name: interval
props.description: Seconds per notice. Default 6.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the notice region.

props.name: labels
props.description: Texts for the controls and their accessible names (English by default); pass them to translate the bar.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Persist a dismissal (the bar hides it locally either way).

props.name: onIndexChange
props.description: Called with the shown index and the notice when the rotation advances or the user pages.

props.name: sticky
props.description: Stick to the top. Default false.

RotatingQRPairing.description: Live pairing QR: polls a rotating payload, crossfades on change, counts down and walks through pairing phases. Built on `QRCodeCard`.

props.name: getPayload
props.description: Polled while waiting for a scan. Return the current pairing payload (or `{ connected: true }`).

props.name: caption
props.description: Instructions under the QR code, shown only while waiting for a scan.

props.name: connectedLabel
props.description: Text shown in the `connected` phase. Default "Device linked".

props.name: defaultPhase
props.description: Initial phase when `phase` is not controlled.

props.name: error
props.description: Error detail shown in the `error` phase.

props.name: expiresAt
props.description: Absolute deadline (ms epoch) for the whole pairing session.

props.name: installingLabel
props.description: Text shown in the `installing` phase. Default "Installing the bridge…".

props.name: onConnected
props.description: Called once when the device links and the phase becomes `connected`.

props.name: onPhaseChange
props.description: Called with the new phase when polling or the timer moves the flow on.

props.name: onRefresh
props.description: Called by the Refresh / Retry button, after the phase returns to waiting.

props.name: phase
props.description: Controlled phase of the pairing flow: `installing`, `waiting`, `connected`, `expired` or `error`.

props.name: pollInterval
props.description: Poll interval in ms. Default 2000.

props.name: size
props.description: QR code width and height in px.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading above the QR code.

props.name: ttl
props.description: Session lifetime in seconds, restarted on refresh. Ignored when `expiresAt` is set.

RuleScopePicker.description: Inline destination link ("in this session ▾") that opens a menu of rule scopes.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially selected scope value when `value` is not controlled; defaults to the first scope.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the picker.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the scope value when the user picks another scope.

props.name: prefix
props.description: Text before the link (visually). Default "in".

props.name: scopes
props.description: Scopes a "don't ask again" rule can apply to; defaults to the built-in set.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value of the selected scope (for example this session, this project, always).

RunHistory.description: Past runs of a job: start, duration, status, cost/tokens, trigger, error snippet and a transcript link.

props.name: runs
props.description: Past runs of the job, newest first.

props.name: empty
props.description: Content shown when there is nothing to list.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when there are no runs. Default "No runs yet".

props.name: hasMore
props.description: More runs exist on the server; "Load more" calls `onLoadMore` once local runs are exhausted.

props.name: loadingMore
props.description: Shows a busy state on the "Load more" button while the next page is fetched.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale used to format run times. Default "en-US".

props.name: onLoadMore
props.description: Called when the user presses "Load more" after the local runs are all shown and `hasMore` is true.

props.name: onOpenTranscript
props.description: Called with the run when the user opens its transcript; the link is hidden when unset.

props.name: pageSize
props.description: Runs revealed per "Load more". Default 5.

RunTicker.description: One-line rolling activity reel: each new line pushes the previous one up and out. Click to see every line.

props.name: activities
props.description: Activities to show in the ticker, in order; the latest one is on top of the reel.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Initial expanded state when `expanded` is not controlled.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Controlled expanded state of the full activity list.

props.name: label
props.description: Label before the reel.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the user expands or collapses the list.

props.name: running
props.description: Shows a spinner while true.

SandboxedFrame.description: An iframe with a strict sandbox, permissions allow-list, no referrer leakage and lazy loading.

props.name: title
props.description: Required accessible title.

props.name: aspectRatio
props.description: Width / height ratio (e.g. 16/9). Ignored when `height` is set.

props.name: height
props.description: Fixed height in px.

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.description: Class for the outer wrapper.

SaveStatus.description: Autosave indicator: saved (with relative time), unsaved, saving, error with retry, conflict with actions.

props.name: status
props.description: Save state (`saved`, `dirty`, `saving`, `error` or `conflict`); sets the icon, label and tone.

props.name: error
props.description: Error detail shown in the tooltip.

props.name: labels
props.description: Override the default labels.

props.name: now
props.description: Reference time (tests / SSR); disables the refresh timer.

props.name: onKeepMine
props.description: Conflict: overwrite the server copy with this one.

props.name: onLoadTheirs
props.description: Conflict: load the other copy.

props.name: onResolve
props.description: Conflict: open a resolver (e.g. `ConflictResolver`).

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Shows a Retry button in the error state.

props.name: savedAt
props.description: Last successful save; renders "Saved 2m ago" (refreshed every 30 s).

props.name: size
props.description: Text and icon size.

ScatterChart.description: Scatter (and bubble) chart: nearest-point hover, keyboard stepping in x order, toggleable series and reference lines.

props.name: data
props.description: One row per observation: an x value plus a y value for each series (and a size when `sizeKey` is set).

props.name: index
props.description: Key of the x value in each datum.

props.name: series
props.description: Series to draw; each has a `key`, a `label` and an optional colour and size field.

props.name: animate
props.description: CSS transitions on data changes (disabled under prefers-reduced-motion). Default true.

props.name: bubbleSize
props.description: Radius in px of the smallest and the largest bubble. Default: 4 up to 22 on a wide chart, a smaller maximum as it narrows.

props.name: defaultHiddenSeries
props.description: Initially hidden series keys when uncontrolled.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Content shown instead of the plot when there is no data.

props.name: grid
props.description: Gridlines. Default both.

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in px (legend excluded). Default 280.

props.name: hiddenSeries
props.description: Controlled list of hidden series keys (toggled from the legend). Use with `onHiddenSeriesChange`.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Defaults to a description built from the series.

props.name: legend
props.description: Default: shown below for 2+ series.

props.name: legendInteractive
props.description: Allow toggling/isolating series from the legend. Default true.

props.name: loading
props.description: Data is on its way: with no data, a placeholder plot (and legend) of the same size; with data, the root is marked busy.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale for the default number and date formatting. Pass one explicitly when the server and the browser must agree (SSR). Defaults to the runtime locale.

props.name: onActivePointChange
props.type: (point: { seriesKey: string; index: number } | null) => void
props.description: The point under the pointer or keyboard focus: its series key and index in `data`, or null.

props.name: onHiddenSeriesChange
props.description: Called with the hidden series keys when a legend entry is toggled.

props.name: pointSize
props.description: Radius in px of points that have no `sizeKey`. Default 4.5.

props.name: referenceLines
props.description: Threshold lines: horizontal at a value, or vertical (`axis: "x"`) at an x value.

props.name: sizeFormatter
props.description: Formats bubble sizes (tooltip and table).

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Shows a tooltip with the hovered point.

props.name: valueFormatter
props.description: Formats y values.

props.name: xAxis
props.description: X-axis options (hide, domain, tick count, formatter).

props.name: yAxis
props.description: Value axis. Unlike bar and area charts it fits the data: it only includes 0 when `min` says so.

SchemaForm.description: Form generated from a JSON-Schema-like object: nested sections, arrays, validation, section nav + search, and debounced autosave.

props.name: schema
props.description: Root schema (an object schema).

props.name: autosave
props.description: Save automatically after edits (debounced).

props.name: autosaveDelay
props.description: Debounce in ms for autosave. Default 800.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial form value when uncontrolled.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every field.

props.name: disabledFields
props.description: Disable fields by path with a reason.

props.name: labels
props.description: Texts of the form chrome (English by default); pass them to translate the form.

props.name: navThreshold
props.description: Show section navigation + search when there are more top-level fields than this. Default 8.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Legacy name of `onValueChange`.

props.name: onSave
props.type: (value: Record<string, unknown>, changedKeys: string[]) => void | Promise<void>
props.description: Autosave callback with the full value and the changed top-level keys. Throw to mark the fields "Not saved".

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Explicit submit (non-autosave). Only called when valid.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the whole form value after every edit.

props.name: submitLabel
props.description: Text of the submit button (explicit-submit mode).

props.name: validateOnMount
props.description: Show all validation errors immediately (default: after blur or submit).

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled form value. Use with `onValueChange`.

props.name: prefix
props.description: Prefix label. Default "Applies to".

props.name: profile
props.description: Profile name, or `null`/omitted for "All profiles".

ScopeIcon.description: Icon for a scope as a ready-to-render node.

props.name: scope
props.description: Scope id or object whose definition picks the icon.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the icon.

props.name: definitions
props.description: Extra or overriding scope definitions, merged over the built-in set.

ScopeList.description: Requested permissions as readable rows with icons, risk and optional toggles.

props.name: scopes
props.description: Requested scopes: id strings (`read:orders`) or objects with constraints.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially granted optional ids when `value` is not controlled.

props.name: definitions
props.description: Extra or overriding scope definitions (label, description, icon, risk), merged over the built-in set.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every toggle.

props.name: held
props.description: Ids already granted earlier; shown with an "Already granted" tag.

props.name: labels
props.description: Untrusted app-supplied labels by scope id, used only when no definition matches.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the granted optional ids when the user toggles one.

props.name: optional
props.description: Ids the user may toggle. Others are required (always granted).

props.name: showId
props.description: Show the raw scope id under each label. Default true.

props.name: showRisk
props.description: Show the risk badge on medium/high scopes. Default true.

props.name: value
props.description: Granted optional scope ids (controlled).

ScopeMatrix.description: Apps × scopes grant grid with a TTL per row and a "replace prior grant" option.

props.name: apps
props.description: Apps to list as rows, each with an id and name.

props.name: scopes
props.description: Column scope ids.

props.name: defaultReplacePrior
props.description: Initial state of the option when `replacePrior` is not controlled.

props.name: defaultTtl
props.description: Initial lifetime in seconds per app id when `ttl` is not controlled.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial grants (scope ids per app id) when `value` is not controlled.

props.name: definitions
props.description: Extra or overriding scope definitions (label, description, icon, risk), merged over the built-in set.

props.name: held
props.description: Scopes each app already holds; pre-ticked and tagged.

props.name: onReplacePriorChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the user flips the option.

props.name: onTtlChange
props.description: Called with the lifetime in seconds per app id when the user changes one.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the grants (scope ids per app id) when the user ticks or clears a cell.

props.name: replacePrior
props.description: Controlled state of the "Replace prior grant" option.

props.name: showReplacePrior
props.description: Show the "Replace prior grant" option (defaults to on when any app holds scopes).

props.name: ttl
props.description: TTL seconds per app id.

props.name: ttlOptions
props.description: Lifetimes offered per app, each with seconds and a label; defaults to the built-in set.

props.name: value
props.description: Granted scope ids per app id.

ScopeSelector.description: Selector for which profile a capability change applies to. The ref goes to the trigger.

props.name: profiles
props.description: Available profile names.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the trigger.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially selected profile when `value` is not controlled; `null` means all profiles.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the selector.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the profile name, or `null` for all profiles.

props.name: prefix
props.description: Text before the selected profile in the trigger.

props.name: size
props.description: Trigger size.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected profile, or `null` for all profiles.

ScrollArea.description: Custom-styled scroll container with thin overlay scrollbars and optional edge fades. The viewport is focusable while it overflows; `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby` name it as a `region`.

props.name: fadeEdges
props.description: Fade content into gradient masks at the edges that can still scroll.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Which scrollbars to render. Default "vertical".

props.name: viewportClassName
props.description: Classes for the inner viewport (e.g. a max height).

props.name: viewportRef
props.description: Ref to the scrolling viewport element (for `scrollTo` or scroll listeners).

ScrollBar.description: Thin scrollbar track + thumb; rendered automatically by `ScrollArea`.

props.name: thumbClassName
props.description: Classes for the draggable thumb.

ScrollProgressBar.description:
A thin bar that fills as the scroller scrolls (the `scroll-progress-bar` utility plus the script fallback). Decorative
(`aria-hidden`); place it `sticky top-0` inside a scroll area or `fixed inset-x-0 top-0` for the page. Empty where no
timeline or script can drive it, and under reduced motion.

props.name: forceFallback
props.description: Run the script fallback even where the browser has native scroll timelines. Default false.

props.name: scroller
props.description: The scrolling element to follow. Default: the nearest scrolling ancestor, else the page.

ScrollReveal.description:
Fades and moves its content in as it scrolls into view, scrubbed by the scroll position (it reverses when you scroll
back). It is the `scroll-reveal` utility plus the script fallback: browsers with `animation-timeline` run it as a CSS
animation with no JavaScript; others get `--sutra-progress` from `useScrollProgress`, and with neither the content is
simply there. Reduced motion shows the end state at once. Not for dense tables, live data or anything above the fold
that must be readable on load. It replaces the element's own `translate` and `scale`, so wrap, do not stack. Keep it out of `overflow-hidden` wrappers (a native timeline binds to the nearest clipping ancestor, which never scrolls): use `overflow-clip` there.

props.name: as
props.description: Element to render. Default `div`.

props.name: distance
props.description: Travel in px for the sliding directions. Default 24.

props.name: forceFallback
props.description: Run the script fallback even where the browser has native scroll timelines (to try the Firefox path). Default false.

props.name: from
props.description: Where it comes from as it enters: slides up (default), down, from the inline start or end, or only fades or scales in.

props.name: scroller
props.description: The scrolling element for the script fallback. Default: the nearest scrolling ancestor, else the page.

ScrollStage.description:
A sticky stage over a scroll runway: the stage stays in view while you scroll through the runway, and
`--sutra-progress` (0 at the start, 1 at the end) is set on the stage root so its children can follow it in CSS
(`opacity-(--p)` with `--p: clamp(0, (var(--sutra-progress, 1) - .3) / .4, 1)`). Scrolling stays native: no
hijacking, no snapping, keyboard and touch work as usual, and the content can be focused and read at any progress.
Without script, or under reduced motion, the variable is unset (children read it with a default of 1, their end
state) and the stage is an ordinary block with no runway.

props.name: onScrollProgress
props.description: Called with the progress (0..1) in a frame while it changes.

props.name: runway
props.description: Length of the scroll runway: a CSS length, or a number of viewport heights. Default 3 (`300vh`).

props.name: scroller
props.description: The scrolling element. Default: the nearest scrolling ancestor, else the page.

props.name: stageHeight
props.description: Height of the sticky stage: a CSS length. Default `100dvh`; use a fixed length inside a scroll area.

SearchInput.description: Search field with an icon, a keyboard shortcut hint and a clear button.

props.name: className
props.description:
Classes for the element that renders. Without addons that is the `<input>` itself (the root).
With addons (`leadingIcon`, `trailingIcon`, `prefix`, `suffix`, `clearable`) it lands on the
**inner** `<input>`, not the outer wrapper, so layout classes (`w-48`, `flex-1`, margins) have no
visible effect there; use `wrapperClassName` for those.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Shows a clear button while the field has a value.

props.name: clearLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the clear button.

props.name: hotkey
props.description:
Global shortcut that focuses the field, e.g. "/" or "mod+k" (⌘ on macOS, Ctrl elsewhere).
Also rendered as a key hint unless `shortcut` is provided.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the field invalid: error border and `aria-invalid`. Inherited from a surrounding `Field` when omitted.

props.name: onClear
props.description: Called after the clear button empties the field.

props.name: prefix
props.description: Text addon before the field, e.g. "https://".

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Custom key hint shown while the field is empty (strings render as `Kbd`).

props.name: size
props.description: Field height and text size.

props.name: suffix
props.description: Text addon after the field, e.g. ".com".

props.name: trailingIcon
props.description: Icon or small action rendered inside the field after the text.

props.name: variant
props.description: `outline` (default) is the bordered box; `filled` is a tinted surface with a hidden border.

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.description:
Classes for the outer wrapper `<div>`, which is only rendered when addons are present. Put
layout/sizing classes here when the input has addons.

With `hotkey` it also listens for the shortcut (through the shortcut registry when a `ShortcutProvider` is present).

props.name: label

props.name: placeholder

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Shortcut hint (and hotkey) as a keys spec: "mod+k" (⌘ on macOS, Ctrl elsewhere), "/", … Default "mod+k".

props.name: size
props.description: Field height: sm 32px, md 36px, lg 40px. Default md.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible field label (also used as the accessible name).

props.name: value
props.description: The secret to mask, reveal and copy.

props.name: clipboardClearAfter
props.description: Clear the clipboard this many ms after copying (0 disables). Default 30000.

props.name: copyable
props.description: Show a copy button. Default true.

props.name: defaultRevealed
props.description: Initial reveal state when `revealed` is not controlled. Hidden by default.

props.name: description
props.description: Helper text under the field.

props.name: maskChar

props.name: maskLength

props.name: mono

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Called after the secret has been copied.

props.name: onRevealedChange

props.name: renderAs

props.name: revealable
props.description: Show a reveal toggle. Default true.

props.name: revealed

SectionRail.description:
Section navigation that highlights the section in view ("On this page", a sticky sub-nav). The links are real
anchors (`aria-current="location"` on the active one); a click scrolls the section to the top of its scroller,
respecting reduced motion. Tracking is `useScrollSections`; pass `value` to drive the highlight yourself.

props.name: sections
props.description: Sections to list, in order; each has an `id` and a `label`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Active id before any section has been seen, when uncontrolled.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when there are no sections. Default: nothing is rendered.

props.name: getHref
props.description: The link target of a section, also written to the address bar on click. Default `#id`; give a router URL where `#id` is taken.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark. Default "Table of contents".

props.name: loading
props.description: Show placeholder rows in the rail's layout while the sections are not known yet.

props.name: offset
props.description: Pixels below the top of the scroll area where a section starts to count as current (see `useScrollSections`).

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when the active id changes (tracked or clicked), and on a click when controlled.

props.name: orientation
props.description: `vertical` is an "On this page" column with a rule; `horizontal` is a scrolling row of tabs for a sticky sub-nav. Default vertical.

props.name: root
props.description: The scrolling element the sections live in. Default: the viewport.

props.name: rootMargin
props.description: Observer root margin, replacing the `offset` based default.

props.name: smoothScroll
props.description: Smooth-scroll to a section on click (reduced motion jumps). `false` leaves the browser's own anchor jump. Default true.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading above the rail. Default "On this page" for a vertical rail; none when horizontal.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled active id. Omit it and the rail tracks the sections in view itself.

props.name: onSeek
