ShareCodeControls.description: Copy the current view as a compact base64url share code, or load one (validated).

props.name: onImport
props.description: Called with a validated view decoded from a pasted code.

props.name: state
props.description: Current view to export.

SharedElement.description:
An element that flies between two screens when the change is applied with `useViewTransition`: render it with the same
`name` in the list and in the detail view. It is a plain box with a `view-transition-name` (`data-shared-element`
carries the name for tests and debugging); without browser support, or under reduced motion, nothing animates.

props.name: name
props.description: The entity id (a note id, a photo id). The same name on the old and the new screen is what morphs; it must be unique on screen at any one time.

props.name: active
props.description: Set false to leave the element unnamed (name only the row that is about to transition, so a long list is not snapshotted whole). Default true.

props.name: as
props.description: Element to render. Default `div`.

props.name: group
props.description: `view-transition-class` for the group, so one CSS rule styles every shared element. Default `sutra-shared` (see sutra.css).

ShareDialog.description: Share an item: invite with a role, per-person roles, general access, link role + expiry, and copy link.

props.name: access
props.description: Controlled who can open the item: `restricted` (invited people), `workspace` or `link` (anyone with the link). Use with `onAccessChange`.

props.name: allowComments
props.description: Controlled state of the "Allow comments on public link" switch.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the dialog panel.

props.name: currentUserId
props.description: Id (in `people`) of the signed-in person: their row says "(you)" and offers "Leave" unless they own the item.

props.name: defaultAccess
props.description: Initial access when uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultAllowComments
props.description: Initial state of the comments switch when uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultExpiry
props.description: Initial link expiry when uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultInviteRole
props.description: Role preselected for invites. Default "editor".

props.name: defaultLinkRole
props.description: Initial link role when uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultPeople
props.description: Initial people list when uncontrolled.

props.name: expiresAt
props.description: Expiry date for a controlled `custom` expiry (or to show an existing deadline).

props.name: expiry
props.description: Controlled link expiry: `never`, `1h`, `1d`, `7d`, `30d` or `custom`.

props.name: itemName
props.description: Name of the shared item, shown in the title ("Share “Q4 plan”"). Without it the title is "Share".

props.name: link
props.description: The link the "Copy link" button copies. Without it the button is hidden.

props.name: linkRole
props.description: Controlled role granted by the link (`editor`, `commenter` or `viewer`). Use with `onLinkRoleChange`.

props.name: onAccessChange
props.description: Called with the new access level.

props.name: onAllowCommentsChange
props.description: Called with the new state of the comments switch.

props.name: onCopyLink
props.description: Called with the link after the user copies it.

props.name: onExpiryChange
props.description: `expiresAt` is null for "never".

props.name: onInvite
props.description: Called when someone is invited, with the role picked next to the email field.

props.name: onLeave
props.description: Called when the current user chooses "Leave".

props.name: onLinkRoleChange
props.description: Called with the new link role.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the dialog opens or closes.

props.name: onPeopleChange
props.description: Called with the full people list after a role change or removal.

props.name: onRemovePerson
props.description: Called with the person id when they are removed.

props.name: onRoleChange
props.description: Called with the person id and the new role when a role is changed.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Use with `onOpenChange`.

props.name: people
props.description:
Controlled people list when paired with `onPeopleChange`. Passed alone it only seeds the
list (deprecated: use `defaultPeople` for that).

props.name: showAllowComments
props.description: Show the "Allow comments on public link" switch for public links. Default true.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Element that opens the dialog (rendered with `asChild`).

props.name: workspaceName
props.description: Workspace name for the "Anyone at …" access option. Pass "" to hide that option.

Sheet.description:
Edge-anchored panel root (a Dialog).

Dialog vs Sheet vs Drawer: `Sheet` slides in from `side` (left, right, top, bottom) and stays put; `Dialog` is a
centred modal; `Drawer` is a touch-first bottom sheet with a grabber, drag-to-dismiss and snap points, built on
the Sheet parts below.

SheetContent.description:
Sheet panel sliding in from `side`. A sheet opened inside another sheet stacks on top of it: the one underneath
scales down and fades (`data-nested`), and the reduced-motion net removes the movement.

props.name: blur
props.description: Frosted panel: translucent surface with a backdrop blur, so the page shows through.

props.name: children
props.description: Sheet body content.

props.name: detached
props.description: Float the panel off the screen edges with rounded corners.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Set to `false` to keep the sheet open on Escape and outside clicks, and to hide the built-in close button.

props.name: overlayClassName
props.description: Classes for the dimmed backdrop behind the sheet.

props.name: showClose
props.description: Show the close button (default: when `dismissible`).

props.name: side
props.description:
Edge the panel slides from. `start` and `end` follow the document direction (left and right in LTR); `left` and
`right` are fixed.

props.name: size
props.description: Panel width (left, right, start, end) or height (top, bottom). Without it: 24rem wide, or as tall as its content.

SheetFooter.description: Sheet action row, pinned to the bottom.

ShipBar.description: Bottom git action bar: branch, ahead/behind, commit message and a Commit / Commit & push / Create PR split button.

props.name: branch
props.description: Current branch name.

props.name: changedCount
props.description: Files that would be committed.

props.name: action
props.description: Primary action of the split button.

props.name: actionDisabledReasons
props.description: Extra per-action reasons (e.g. `{ pr: "GitHub CLI not signed in" }`).

props.name: ahead
props.description:
Commits the branch is ahead of its upstream; with no changed files, a non-zero value still allows the `pr`
action.

props.name: baseBranch
props.description: Branch the work will be merged into, shown beside the current branch.

props.name: behind
props.description:
Commits the branch is behind its upstream; a non-zero value disables push and PR actions with a "Pull first"
reason.

props.name: branchStatus
props.description: Working-tree state of the branch (`clean`, `dirty` or `conflict`); adds a status dot to the branch pill.

props.name: conflicts
props.description: Number of conflicted files; a non-zero value disables every ship action with a "Resolve conflicts first" reason.

props.name: defaultAction
props.description: Initial primary action when `action` is not controlled.

props.name: defaultMessage
props.description: Initial commit message when `message` is not controlled.

props.name: delegateLabel
props.description: Label of the hand-to-agent button. Default "Hand to agent".

props.name: error
props.description: Failure message shown when `status` is `error`.

props.name: generateSlot
props.description: Custom content next to the message field (e.g. a suggestion chip).

props.name: generating
props.description: Shows a busy state on the Generate button while a message is being written.

props.name: message
props.description: Controlled commit message.

props.name: onActionChange
props.description: Called with the action (`commit`, `commit-push` or `pr`) when the user picks one from the split button.

props.name: onCommit
props.description: Called with the commit message when the user runs the `commit` action.

props.name: onCommitAndPush
props.description: Called with the commit message when the user runs the `commit-push` action.

props.name: onCreatePR
props.description: Called with the commit message when the user runs the `pr` action.

props.name: onDelegate
props.description: "Hand to agent": delegate committing / resolving to the agent.

props.name: onGenerateMessage
props.description: Adds a "Generate" button for the message.

props.name: onMessageChange
props.description: Called with the message on every edit.

props.name: progressLabel
props.description: Shown while running, e.g. "Pushing…".

props.name: result
props.description: Shown on success, e.g. "Committed a1b2c3d".

props.name: status
props.description: Progress of the ship action: `idle`, `running`, `success` or `error`.

ShortcutKeys.description: Renders a keys spec as platform-aware Kbd chips, with "then" between sequence steps.

props.name: keys
props.description: Keys spec: "mod+k", "shift+?", "g t".

props.name: kbdClassName
props.description: Classes for each Kbd chip.

props.name: platform
props.description: Platform whose key glyphs are shown (`mac` shows ⌘ and ⌥). Defaults to the detected or provided platform.

props.name: size
props.description: Key chip size.

ShortcutProvider.description: Central keyboard shortcut registry. Mount once near the app root.

props.name: children
props.description: The app subtree whose shortcuts the manager handles.

props.name: platform
props.description: Platform used to read `mod` and to show key glyphs. Defaults to the detected platform.

props.name: sequenceTimeout
props.description: Max delay between the keys of a sequence. Default 1000ms.

props.name: target
props.description: Element the keydown listener attaches to. Default `document`.

ShortcutScope.description: Activates a scope while mounted; `useShortcut` calls inside default to this scope.

props.name: name
props.description: Scope name; shortcuts registered inside it are listed under this group.

props.name: children
props.description: The subtree the scope applies to.

props.name: enabled
props.description: Turns the scope's shortcuts on or off without unmounting.

props.name: exclusive
props.description: Block every lower scope, including global (modal behaviour).

ShortcutsDialog.description: Cheat sheet auto-populated from the shortcut registry, with search. Opens with shift+? by default.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the sheet content.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled.

props.name: description
props.description: Text under the heading.

props.name: extraGroups
props.description: Extra static groups appended to the registry listing.

props.name: includeRegistry
props.description: List the live shortcut registry. Default true; `false` shows only `extraGroups` (a static cheat sheet).

props.name: keys
props.description: Shortcut that toggles the sheet. Default "shift+?"; `null` disables.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the sheet opens or closes.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state of the sheet. Use with `onOpenChange`.

props.name: platform
props.description: Platform for the key glyphs. Defaults to the provider's (or the detected) platform.

props.name: title
props.description: Sheet heading.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Element that opens the sheet (rendered with `asChild`); focus returns to it on close.

props.name: defaultPressed
props.description: Initial state when `pressed` is not controlled.

props.name: onPressedChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the user presses the button.

props.name: pressed
props.description: Controlled shuffle state.

props.name: size
props.description: Button size: `sm`, `md` or `lg`.

props.name: tone
props.description: `default` follows the theme; `overlay` is for controls drawn over video or artwork.

Sidebar.description: App sidebar. Collapses to icons on desktop and becomes a sheet on mobile.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: icon: shrink to an icon rail · offcanvas: slide fully away · none: never collapse.

props.name: mobileTitle
props.description: Accessible title for the mobile sheet.

props.name: side
props.description: Edge of the layout the sidebar sits on.

props.name: variant
props.description: Look: `default` (flush panel), `inset` (content area sits in a card beside it) or `floating` (detached rounded panel).

SidebarGroupLabel.description: Group heading; fades out in icon mode.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render the label as its child element (a heading, a link) instead of a `div`, merging the label's classes and props into it.

SidebarInset.description: Main content area next to the sidebar. Raised card when the sidebar is `inset`.

props.name: as
props.description: Element to render. Default `"main"`; use `"div"` when the page already has a `<main>`.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Merge props onto the single child element instead of rendering a wrapper.

SidebarMenuButton.description: Menu row: icon, label, badge; shows a tooltip when the sidebar is collapsed to icons.

props.name: active
props.description: Marks the current page (sets `aria-current="page"`).

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as the child element (e.g. a router `Link`) while keeping the button styles.

props.name: badge
props.description: Count or status shown on the right; hidden in icon mode.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon at the start of the row; it stays visible in the icon rail.

props.name: isActive
props.description: Legacy name of `active`.

props.name: size
props.description: Row height: `sm`, `md` or `lg` (taller, for a two-line row).

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Tooltip in icon mode. Defaults to `children` when it is a string.

SidebarMenuItem.description: Wrapper for a menu button (and its sub menu).

SidebarMenuSub.description: Collapsible nested menu under a menu item. Hidden in icon mode.

props.name: active
props.description: Marks the current page (sets `aria-current="page"`).

props.name: badge
props.description: Badge or count at the end of the row.

props.name: children
props.description: Sub-menu items, shown when the row is expanded.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon at the start of the row; it stays visible in the icon rail.

props.name: isActive
props.description: Legacy name of `active`.

props.name: label
props.description: Or let the sub menu render its own trigger button.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Custom trigger element (wrapped with Collapsible.Trigger asChild).

SidebarMenuSubButton.description: Nested link row inside `SidebarMenuSub`. Wrapped in its own list item.

props.name: active
props.description: Marks the current page (sets `aria-current="page"`).

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as the child element (e.g. a router `Link`) while keeping the link styles.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon at the start of the sub item.

props.name: isActive
props.description: Legacy name of `active`.

props.name: size
props.description: Sub item height and text size.

SidebarProvider.description: Holds collapsed / mobile state, registers ⌘B, and lays out sidebar + inset.

props.name: collapsed
props.description: Controlled collapsed state of the sidebar (icon rail or hidden, per `collapsible`). Use with `onCollapsedChange`.

props.name: contained
props.description:
Fill the parent element instead of the viewport (for previews, panels and nested layouts).
The parent needs a definite height.

props.name: defaultCollapsed
props.description: Initial collapsed state when uncontrolled.

props.name: iconWidth
props.description: CSS width in icon mode. Default "3rem".

props.name: onCollapsedChange
props.description: Called when the sidebar collapses or expands (trigger button or keyboard shortcut).

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Key used with ⌘/Ctrl to toggle. Default "b". Pass `null` to disable.

props.name: width
props.description: CSS width of the expanded sidebar. Default "16rem".

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as the child element (e.g. a link) while keeping button styles.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretches the button to the width of its container.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Icon before the label.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner and disables the button.

props.name: size
props.description: Button height and padding; `icon-*` sizes are square.

props.name: spinnerProps
props.description: Overrides for the loading spinner (variant, size, `label`, colour via `className`); it inherits the button text colour by default.

props.name: trailingIcon
props.description: Icon after the label.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style: `primary` (filled), `secondary` (bordered), `tertiary` (muted fill), `soft`, `ghost`, `outline`, `destructive`, `destructive-soft`, `inverse` or `link`.

SidebarUserCard.description: Account row with an `Avatar` (solid seed colour), name, email and chevron. Use as a dropdown trigger.

props.name: name
props.description: Display name shown in the card (and used for the initials).

props.name: avatarColor
props.description: Background of the initials circle. Defaults to a color derived from the name.

props.name: avatarSrc
props.description: Image URL; falls back to initials.

props.name: email
props.description: Email shown under the name.

props.name: hideChevron
props.description: Hide the trailing chevron.

SideThread.description: Docked mini-chat for quick side questions that don't interrupt the main conversation. Resizable from its top edge.

props.name: exchanges
props.description: Question and answer pairs, oldest first; an exchange without an answer is pending.

props.name: busy
props.description: Disables asking while an answer is pending.

props.name: defaultHeight
props.description: Initial height in px when `height` is not controlled.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when there are no exchanges yet.
props.default: "Ask a quick side question without interrupting the main conversation."

props.name: height
props.description: Controlled height of the thread in px.

props.name: loading
props.description: Disables asking while an answer is pending. Default: any exchange is pending.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Largest height in px the user can resize to. Default 640.

props.name: minHeight
props.description: Smallest height in px the user can resize to. Default 140.

props.name: onAsk
props.description: Called with the question text from the side composer.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called when the user closes the thread; the close button is hidden when unset.

props.name: onHeightChange
props.description: Called with the height in px (rounded and clamped) when the user resizes the thread.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder of the side composer. Default "Ask a quick side question…".

props.name: resizable
props.description: Show the top resize handle (pointer drag, ↑/↓, PageUp/PageDown, Home/End). Default true.

props.name: step
props.description: Keyboard resize step in px. Default 16.

props.name: title
props.description: Header title. Default "Side question".

SignedInPanel.description: Signed-in summary: `AccountPanel` plus kunji linking, sign out and sign out everywhere.

props.name: name
props.description: Account holder's name, shown as the heading and used for the avatar fallback.

props.name: apps
props.description: Apps signed in on this account, listed in the panel.

props.name: avatarSrc
props.description: Avatar image URL; initials are shown when unset.

props.name: client
props.description: Enables "Link kunji" when given.

props.name: defaultKunjiLinked
props.description: Initial linked state when uncontrolled.

props.name: handle
props.description: Handle or email under the name.

props.name: kunjiLinked
props.description: Controlled linked state of the kunji identity. Use with `onLinkKunji` and `onUnlinkKunji`.

props.name: kunjiSub
props.description: The linked kunji subject id, shown once linked.

props.name: onLinkKunji
props.description: Called with the poll result when the user links their kunji identity.

props.name: onSignOut
props.description: Called when the user signs out of this session; the button is hidden when unset.

props.name: onSignOutEverywhere
props.description: Ends every session (with a confirm dialog).

props.name: onUnlinkKunji
props.description: Called when the user unlinks their kunji identity.

props.name: role
props.description: Role badge, e.g. "Admin".

SignInMap.description:
Where sign-ins come from: outcome-toned markers (clustered) on a flat map or globe, impossible-travel arcs,
new-country flags, a summary row and a list of flagged sign-ins with review and revoke actions.

props.name: defaultSelectedId
props.description: Initially selected event id when `selectedId` is not controlled.

props.name: defaultView
props.description: Default `map`.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Replaces the default "No sign-ins" view.

props.name: events
props.description: Sign-in attempts in any order. Events without a valid point or time are left out.

props.name: knownCountries
props.description:
Countries each account already signs in from (alpha-2). A first successful sign-in from any other country is a
new location. Omitted: the country of each account's earliest successful sign-in is its baseline.

props.name: loading
props.description: Data is on its way: skeletons with no events yet, otherwise the events stay on screen (a refresh).

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for country names, dates and numbers.

props.name: maxKmh
props.description: Fastest plausible travel in km/h; faster pairs are flagged. Default 900 (a passenger jet).

props.name: minDistanceKm
props.description:
Pairs closer than this are never flagged, since IP geolocation is only city-accurate (a phone on mobile data can
appear a region away). Default 100.

props.name: now
props.description: Reference time for relative times (tests, stories). Default: the clock, updated every 30 s.

props.name: onReview
props.description: Shows a "Review" action on flagged events and the selected event's details.

props.name: onRevoke
props.description: Shows "Revoke" on successful sign-ins other than the current one. May return a promise (the button spins until it settles).

props.name: onSelectedIdChange
props.type: (id: string | null, event: SignInEvent | undefined) => void
props.description: Called with the selected event id (or `null`) and the event when the user selects or clears one.

props.name: onViewChange
props.description: Called with the view when the user flips the map and globe switch.

props.name: reviewLabel
props.description: Default "Review".

props.name: revokeLabel
props.description: Default "Revoke".

props.name: selectedId
props.description: Selected event id: highlighted on the map, in the flagged list and shown in the detail panel.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading. Default "Sign-in activity".

props.name: view
props.description: Controlled view: `map` or `globe`.

props.name: viewToggle
props.description: Show the map / globe switch. Default true.

props.name: windowLabel
props.description: The period the events cover, next to the title ("Last 7 days").

SignInMethods.description: Sign-in method tabs (kunji QR, username + password, access token) that remember the last one used.

props.name: client
props.description: The kunji client that issues and polls sign-in challenges (and supplies the app name).

props.name: defaultMethod
props.description: Method shown first when nothing is remembered; defaults to the first of `methods`.

props.name: description
props.description: Text under the heading.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Element of the card title (`1` is an `h1`).

props.name: kunjiProps
props.description: Props passed through to the kunji widget (everything except `client`).

props.name: labels
props.description: Overrides for the method tab labels, keyed by method id (`kunji`, `password`, `token`).

props.name: methods
props.description: Methods to offer, in order. Default all three.

props.name: onKunjiSuccess
props.description: Called with the poll result when a kunji sign-in is approved.

props.name: onPasswordSubmit
props.description: Called with the username and password when the password form is submitted. A returned promise shows a spinner; throw to show the error message.

props.name: onTokenSubmit
props.description: Called with the token when the token form is submitted. A returned promise shows a spinner; throw to show the error message.

props.name: rememberKey
props.description: localStorage key for the last used method. `null` disables remembering.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading of the card.

props.name: usernameLabel
props.description: Label of the username field, e.g. "Lab username".

props.name: variant
props.description: `card` draws the bordered card; `plain` drops the chrome so you can place it in your own surface.

SignUpCard.description: Account creation card: name, email, password with strength meter and terms checkbox.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting text under the heading; each card has its own default.
props.default: "Start your free 14-day trial. No credit card required."

props.name: error
props.description: Error message shown above the form; also marks the form invalid.

props.name: footer
props.description: Replace the default footer (e.g. "Don't have an account? Sign up"). Pass `null` to hide it.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Element of the card title (`1` is an `h1`). Use `2` or lower when the card sits inside a page that has its own `h1`.

props.name: loading
props.description: Disables the form and shows a spinner on the submit button.

props.name: logo
props.description: Show the Sutra mark above the title, or pass a custom logo. Default: true for `card`.

props.name: minScore
props.description: Minimum strength score (1–4) required to submit. Default 2.

props.name: onSocialSignIn
props.description: Called with the provider when a social button is clicked. A returned promise shows a spinner on that button.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called with the form values (name, email, password). Return a promise to show a spinner; throw to show the error message.

props.name: privacyHref
props.description: Link target of the privacy-policy text.

props.name: providers
props.description: OAuth providers shown above the form. Pass `[]` to hide.

props.name: renderLink
props.description: Router link renderer for the footer and inline links.

props.name: signInHref
props.description: Link target of the "Sign in" prompt.

props.name: socialLayout
props.description: Social buttons as a row/grid (for two or three providers) or stacked full-width.

props.name: submitLabel
props.description: Text of the submit button.

props.name: termsHref
props.description: Link target of the terms-of-service text.

props.name: title
props.description: Card heading; each card has its own default.

props.name: variant
props.description: `card` renders a bordered surface; `plain` renders only the content (for full-page layouts).

SimpleSelect.description: Data-driven select: pass `options` and get a styled trigger + list.

props.name: options
props.description: Options to render, in order; each has a `value`, a `label` and optional description, icon and disabled flag.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: Id(s) of the element(s) that describe the trigger (hint, error text).

props.name: aria-invalid
props.description: Overrides the invalid state announced to assistive technology; normally set `invalid` instead.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the trigger when there is no visible label.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Id(s) of the element(s) that label the trigger.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the trigger.

props.name: contentClassName
props.description: Classes for the popover list.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the select. Inherited from a surrounding `Field` when omitted.

props.name: id
props.description: `id` of the trigger, so a `<label htmlFor>` or `Field` can point at it.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the select invalid: error border and `aria-invalid`. Inherited from a surrounding `Field` when omitted.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Icon shown at the start of the trigger.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Trigger text while nothing is selected.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the select required. Inherited from a surrounding `Field` when omitted.

props.name: size
props.description: Trigger height and text size.

props.name: children
props.description: The element the tooltip describes; it must accept a ref and focus.

props.name: content
props.description: Tooltip content.

props.name: align
props.description: Alignment of the tooltip along that side.

props.name: contentClassName
props.description: Classes for the tooltip bubble.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Skip the tooltip entirely (renders children only).

props.name: shortcut
props.description:
Keyboard shortcut. A keys spec ("mod+k", "g t") renders platform-aware chips; a glyph string ("⌘K")
or an array (["⌘", "K"]) renders one Kbd per entry.

props.name: side
props.description: Side of the trigger the tooltip opens on; it flips when there is no room.

props.name: variant
props.description: Look of the bubble: `inverse` (dark) or `light` (bordered popover surface).

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the placeholder (px number or CSS length); a circle without a height is as tall as it is wide.

props.name: lines
props.description: Number of text lines (shape "text" only). The last line is shorter.

props.name: shape
props.description: What the placeholder looks like: text lines, a circle (avatar) or a rectangle.

props.name: shimmer
props.description: Shimmer sweep instead of a pulse. Default true.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the placeholder (px number or CSS length); defaults to the full width.

SkillCard.description: Skill list card: name, description, provenance, category, toolset icons and an enable switch.

props.name: skill
props.description: The skill to show (name, description, source, enabled state).

props.name: onEnabledChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the user flips the enable switch.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called when the card is pressed.

props.name: selected
props.description: Marks the card as the selected one in a list.

SkillDetail.description: Skill detail: header with actions, SKILL.md preview, frontmatter and security scan tabs.

props.name: skill
props.description: The skill to show (name, description, source, enabled state).

props.name: defaultTab
props.description: Initially active tab when `tab` is not controlled.

props.name: frontmatter
props.description: Parsed SKILL.md frontmatter, shown as key/value rows on the Frontmatter tab.

props.name: markdown
props.description: SKILL.md body (markdown).

props.name: onArchive
props.description: Called after the user confirms archiving the skill; the button is hidden when unset.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called when the user closes the detail view; the close button is hidden when unset.

props.name: onEdit
props.description: Called when the user presses Edit; the button is hidden when unset.

props.name: onEnabledChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the user flips the enable switch.

props.name: onTabChange
props.description: Called with the tab id when the user switches tabs.

props.name: scan
props.description: Security scan result for the skill; props of `SecurityScanVerdict`, shown on the Security tab.

props.name: tab
props.description: Controlled active tab (`preview`, `frontmatter` or `security`).

SkipButton.description: Circular-arrow button that skips back or forward a number of seconds.

props.name: direction
props.description: `back` skips backwards, `forward` skips ahead. Default "forward".

props.name: onSkip
props.description: Called with the signed delta, e.g. `-10`.

props.name: seconds
props.description: Seconds to skip (drawn inside the glyph). Default 10.

props.name: size
props.description: Button size: `sm`, `md` or `lg`.

props.name: tone
props.description: `default` follows the theme; `overlay` is for controls drawn over video or artwork.

SlashMenu.description: Inline command / mention listbox anchored to the caret of a composer textarea.

props.name: anchorRef
props.description: The composer textarea to attach to.

props.name: commands
props.description: Commands (or mentions) to offer, each with a name, optional description and keywords.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when nothing matches. Default "No matching commands".

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Content shown when there is nothing to list.

props.name: filter
props.description: Custom filter; default matches name/keywords (prefix matches first).

props.name: heading
props.description: Header label. Default "Commands" (or "Mentions" for "@").

props.name: maxRows
props.description: Max visible rows before scrolling. Default 8.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called with the chosen command and the trigger match (trigger, query and caret range) when the user picks one.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Trigger character(s). Default "/". Use "@" for mentions.

Slider.description:
Range input with one or more thumbs, optional value bubble and labeled marks. `ref` and `className` land on the
outer wrapper (which also holds the marks); the other props go to the Radix slider root inside it.

props.name: accent
props.description: Categorical colour for the range, thumb border and active marks. Default primary.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Formats the number shown in the value bubble (see `showValue`). Default shows the raw value.

props.name: getValueText
props.description: Accessible value text per thumb (`aria-valuetext`), e.g. `(v) => v + "%"`.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the slider invalid: error styling on the range and `aria-invalid`. Inherited from a surrounding `Field` when omitted.

props.name: marks
props.description: Tick marks under the track; numbers or `{ value, label }`.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show a value bubble above the thumb on hover, focus and drag. `"always"` keeps it visible.

props.name: size
props.description: Track and thumb size.

props.name: thumbLabels
props.description:
Accessible labels per thumb, e.g. `["Volume"]` or `["Minimum", "Maximum"]`. Without it a single thumb is named by
`aria-label` / `aria-labelledby` (or the surrounding `FieldLabel`); two thumbs are "Minimum" and "Maximum".

props.name: tone
props.description: Semantic colour (`success`, `warning`, …). Takes precedence over `accent`.

SlideToConfirm.description:
Confirm an irreversible action by sliding the thumb along the track. It is a `role="slider"` (value 0 to 100, arrow keys step,
Home resets, End and Enter and Space confirm), the offset follows the finger without React state (`useDrag`), a release short of
90% springs back, and under reduced motion the release is instant. `onConfirm` may return a promise: the control stays busy
until it settles and slides back if it rejects.

props.name: confirmed
props.description: The thumb is at the end. Pass `false` to slide it back after a confirmation.

props.name: confirmedLabel
props.description: Hint shown once the thumb reaches the end.

props.name: defaultConfirmed
props.description: Initial confirmed state when uncontrolled.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables dragging and the keyboard.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon on the thumb. Default a chevron.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible hint, also the slider's accessible name. Default "Slide to confirm".

props.name: loading
props.description: Thumb at the end with a spinner while the action runs (a promise from `onConfirm` does the same by itself).

props.name: loadingLabel
props.description: Shown while the action runs. Default "Confirming…".

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Runs once the thumb reaches the end (or Enter, Space or End is pressed). A returned promise keeps the control busy; a rejection slides it back.

props.name: onConfirmedChange
props.description: Called when the control reaches or leaves the confirmed state.

props.name: size
props.description: Control height and thumb size.

props.name: step
props.description: Arrow key step in percent of the track. Default 10.

props.name: tone
props.description: Colour of the thumb and the filled track.

SlotFill.description:
Declaratively contribute `children` to a slot while mounted. Renders nothing in place.
Registers once per slot/id/order/source; later `children` updates re-render only the filled content.

props.name: slot
props.description: Target slot name.

props.name: children
props.description: Content to render in the slot.

props.name: id
props.description: Stable id; defaults to a generated one.

props.name: order
props.description: Lower renders first; ties keep registration order. Default 0.

props.name: source
props.description: Name of the contributor (for example a plugin), shown in the error note when the fill throws.

SlotOutlet.description: Renders every contribution registered for `name`, in order, each isolated by an error boundary.

props.name: name
props.description: Slot name, e.g. "sidebar.footer".

props.name: fallback
props.description: Rendered when nothing is registered.

props.name: onContributionError
props.description: Called when a contribution throws while rendering.

props.name: unwrapped
props.description: Render contributions without the wrapper div.

SlotProvider.description: Provides a slot registry to `SlotOutlet` and `SlotFill` below it.

props.name: children
props.description: App subtree that can render `SlotOutlet`s and `SlotFill`s.

props.name: contributions
props.description: Initial contributions when no `registry` is given.

props.name: registry
props.description: Use an existing registry (e.g. one plugins register into at startup).

Snackbar.description: Compact dark (inverse) notification bar with an optional action, Material-style.

props.name: message
props.description: Notification text.

props.name: action
props.description: Optional action button on the right (`label` and `onClick`), e.g. Undo.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the dismiss button.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon shown before the message.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Legacy name of `onDismiss`.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Shows a dismiss button when provided.

SocialButton.description: OAuth sign-in button with the provider's logo. Defaults to "Continue with {Provider}".

props.name: provider
props.description: Identity provider; sets the logo and the default label ("Continue with Google").

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as the child element (e.g. a link) while keeping the button styles.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretches the button to the width of its container.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner and disables the button (with `asChild`: `aria-disabled`, no tab stop, clicks swallowed, `aria-busy`).

props.name: size
props.description: Button height and text size.

props.name: variant
props.description: Look: `default` (outlined), `brand` (provider colours) or `icon` (square, icon only; set an `aria-label`).

SortFilterMenu.description: View options menu with sort radio items, direction and checkbox filters.

props.name: align
props.description: Alignment of the menu against the trigger.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the trigger.

props.name: defaultDirection
props.description: Initial sort direction when uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultFilters
props.description: Initially active filter values when uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultSort
props.description: Initial sort value when uncontrolled.

props.name: direction
props.description: Controlled sort direction. Use with `onDirectionChange`.

props.name: filterOptions
props.description: Filter choices (checkable); each has a `value` and a `label`.

props.name: filters
props.description: Controlled list of active filter values. Use with `onFiltersChange`.

props.name: label
props.description: Text of the trigger button.

props.name: onDirectionChange
props.description: Called with the direction the user picked.

props.name: onFiltersChange
props.description: Called with the full list of active filter values after a change.

props.name: onSortChange
props.description: Called with the sort value the user picked.

props.name: sort
props.description: Controlled sort value. Use with `onSortChange`.

props.name: sortOptions
props.description: Sort choices; each has a `value` and a `label`.

SourcePane.description: Source text pane: auto-growing textarea, counter, clear, did-you-mean strip, voice/speak slots, RTL.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial text when uncontrolled. Default "".

props.name: lang
props.description: Language code of the text (drives `dir` and `lang`).

props.name: maxLength
props.description: Character limit. Default 5000.

props.name: minHeight
props.description: Minimum textarea height in px. Default 128.

props.name: onAcceptSuggestion
props.description: Called with the suggestion when the user accepts the "Did you mean" correction.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the text on every edit.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder of the text area. Default "Enter text".

props.name: speak
props.description: Slot for a SpeakButton (default renders one for `lang` when text is present).

props.name: suggestion
props.description: "Did you mean" correction.

props.name: textareaProps
props.description: Props passed to the textarea.

props.name: tools
props.description: Extra footer tools (e.g. a TransliterationToggle).

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled text to translate.

props.name: voice
props.description: Slot for a VoiceInput.

SparkBar.description: Tiny inline column chart. A left-to-right island like `Sparkline`: the first bar is always on the physical left.

props.name: data
props.description: Values to plot, one bar each, in order.

props.name: accent
props.description: Categorical colour (`blue`, `amber`, …, a semantic token or any CSS colour). `tone` and `color` take precedence.

props.name: color
props.description: Any CSS colour (token names still work; prefer `tone` for those). Default primary.

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between bars in px (viewBox units).

props.name: height
props.description: Intrinsic height in px.

props.name: highlightLast
props.description: Draws the last bar in full colour and the others in `mutedColor`.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the chart (it is exposed as an image).

props.name: max
props.description: Fixed scale top (e.g. 100 for percentages). Defaults to the larger of 0 and the data maximum.

props.name: min
props.description: Fixed scale bottom (e.g. 0). Defaults to the smaller of 0 and the data minimum.

props.name: mutedColor
props.description: Color for non-highlighted bars when `highlightLast` is on. Defaults to a faded `color`.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius of the bars in px (viewBox units).

props.name: responsive
props.description: Stretches to 100% of the container width.

props.name: tone
props.description: Semantic colour. Takes precedence over `color`.

props.name: width
props.description: Intrinsic width in px (or viewBox width when `responsive`).

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.description: Classes for the wrapper around the SVG.

Sparkline.description: Tiny inline trend chart. It is a left-to-right island: the series always runs from the physical left, also on a right-to-left page.

props.name: data
props.description: Values to plot, in order.

props.name: accent
props.description:
Categorical colour (`blue`, `amber`, …, a semantic token or any CSS colour). `tone` and `color` take
precedence. Pass `color="var(--sutra-accent, var(--primary))"` to follow an accent set by a parent instead.

props.name: color
props.description: Any CSS colour (token names such as "primary" still work; prefer `tone` for those).

props.name: gradient
props.description: Gradient under the line (`type="area"`). Default true.

props.name: height
props.description: Intrinsic height in px.

props.name: highlightLast
props.description: Dot on the last data point.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the chart (it is exposed as an image).

props.name: max
props.description: Fixed top of the y-domain; defaults to the data range.

props.name: min
props.description: Fixed y-domain; defaults to the data range.

props.name: responsive
props.description: Stretch to 100% of the container width.

props.name: smooth
props.description: Draws the line as a smooth curve instead of straight segments.

props.name: strokeWidth
props.description: Line thickness in px.

props.name: tone
props.description: Semantic colour. Takes precedence over `color`.

props.name: trend
props.description: Color green when the series ends higher than it started, red otherwise.

props.name: type
props.description: Chart style: a `line`, a filled `area` or `bar`s.

props.name: width
props.description: Intrinsic width (or viewBox width when `responsive`).

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.description: Classes for the wrapper around the SVG.

SpeakButton.description: Reads text aloud with the system voice for `lang`; hidden when no such voice exists.

props.name: text
props.description: Text to read aloud.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as the child element (e.g. a link) while keeping button styles.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretches the button to the width of its container.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label while idle. Default "Listen".

props.name: lang
props.description: BCP-47 language of `text`.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Icon before the label.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner and disables the button.

props.name: rate
props.description: Speaking speed, where 1 is normal; passed to speech synthesis.

props.name: size
props.description: Button height and padding; `icon-*` sizes are square.

props.name: spinnerProps
props.description: Overrides for the loading spinner (variant, size, `label`, colour via `className`); it inherits the button text colour by default.

props.name: trailingIcon
props.description: Icon after the label.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style: `primary` (filled), `secondary` (bordered), `tertiary` (muted fill), `soft`, `ghost`, `outline`, `destructive`, `destructive-soft`, `inverse` or `link`.

Spinner.description: Loading indicator. Uses `currentColor`, so set a text color to recolor it.

props.name: frames
props.description: glyph only: a built-in frame set or custom frames. Default "dots".

props.name: interval
props.description: glyph only: milliseconds per frame. Default 80.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label. Default "Loading". Pass `""` to make the spinner decorative (hidden from assistive tech).

props.name: paused
props.description: glyph only: hold the current frame.

props.name: size
props.description: Spinner diameter: `xs` 12px, `sm` 16px, `md` 20px, `lg` 24px or `xl` 32px.

props.name: variant
props.description:
ring: arc spinner · dots: three bouncing dots · bars: equalizer · pulse: breathing dot ·
glyph: cycling text glyphs (braille dots, arcs, …; inherits font size and colour unless `size` is set).

The box variants scale with their box, so `className="h-1.5 w-6"` gives a compact row of dots.

SpinnerVerbs.description: Loader that rotates through whimsical verbs with a shimmer, elapsed time and token count.
SpinnerVerbs.deprecated: Use `<AgentStatusLine state="thinking" verbs={…} layout="inline" tokensPrefix="↓" />`; this is now a preset of it.

props.name: hint
props.description: Optional hint after the stats, e.g. "esc to interrupt".

props.name: icon
props.description: Replaces the default spinner glyph.

props.name: interval
props.description: Ms between verbs. Default 3000.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible status label. Default "Working".

props.name: order
props.description: Default "random".

props.name: startedAt
props.description: Shows elapsed time when set.

props.name: tokens
props.description: Token count shown beside the elapsed time.

props.name: verbs
props.description: Words cycled while working (for example "Pondering"); defaults to a built-in list.

SplitButton.description: A primary action fused with a chevron that opens a menu of secondary actions.

props.name: actions
props.description: Secondary actions listed in the chevron menu.

props.name: align
props.description: Alignment of the menu against the button.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as the child element (e.g. a link) while keeping button styles.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretches the button to the width of its container.

props.name: groupClassName
props.description: Class for the outer group.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Icon before the label.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner and disables the button.

props.name: menuContent
props.description: Custom menu content (rendered after `actions`).

props.name: menuHeading
props.description: Optional heading inside the menu.

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the chevron button. Default "More options".

props.name: size
props.description: Button's text-size scale; the chevron uses the matching icon size. Default "md".

props.name: spinnerProps
props.description: Overrides for the loading spinner (variant, size, `label`, colour via `className`); it inherits the button text colour by default.

props.name: trailingIcon
props.description: Icon after the label.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style: `primary` (filled), `secondary` (bordered), `tertiary` (muted fill), `soft`, `ghost`, `outline`, `destructive`, `destructive-soft`, `inverse` or `link`.

SplitPane.description: Two resizable panes with an accessible draggable divider, persistence and a narrow-width fallback.

props.name: collapseBelow
props.description: Below this container width (px) the split collapses.

props.name: collapseMode
props.description: When collapsed: stack both panes, or show one at a time with a toggle. Default "stack".

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Allow Enter on the handle to collapse/restore the first panel. Default true.

props.name: defaultSize
props.description: Initial size of the first panel in percent; also the double-click reset value. Default 50.

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum first-panel size in percent. Default 85.

props.name: min
props.description: Minimum first-panel size in percent. Default 15.

props.name: onSizeChange
props.description: Called with the first panel's size in percent while the divider moves.

props.name: orientation
props.description: `horizontal`: panes side by side (vertical divider). `vertical`: stacked (horizontal divider).

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the first panel in percent (controlled).

props.name: step
props.description: Keyboard step in percent (Shift ×2). Default 5.

props.name: storageKey
props.description: Persist the size in localStorage under this key.

SplitPaneHandle.description: Draggable divider: `role="separator"` with arrows/Home/End, Enter to collapse, double-click to reset.

props.name: withGrip
props.description: Show a grip in the middle of the divider. Default true.

SplitPanePanel.description: One side of a `SplitPane`. The first panel is sized; the second fills the rest.

props.name: label
props.description: Label used by the narrow-width toggle (`collapseMode="primary"`).

SplitText.description:
Text that reveals itself character by character or word by word (`animate-fade-up` plus the `stagger` delay on `--i`).
Accessible by construction: the real text sits once in a visually hidden span, and the pieces are `aria-hidden`, so a
screen reader never hears letters, and copying and find-in-page still see words (a word stays unbroken at line ends).
Under `prefers-reduced-motion`, or with `animate={false}`, it renders the plain text.

props.name: text
props.description: The text. Screen readers get it whole.

props.name: animate
props.description: Set false to show the text as it is, with no reveal (changing it replays the reveal when true). Default true.

props.name: as
props.description: The element to render. Default `span`.

props.name: by
props.description: Reveal by character or by word. Default "char".

props.name: effect
props.description: The entrance of each piece. Default "fade-up".

props.name: step
props.description: Milliseconds between pieces. Default 24 for characters, 70 for words. The whole reveal is capped at about 1.2 s.

Spotlight.description: A soft radial glow for heroes and cards.

props.name: animated
props.description: Slowly drift the glow.

props.name: color
props.description: Glow color (any CSS color). Defaults to the brand color.

props.name: intensity
props.description: Glow strength, 0 to 1.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter in pixels.

props.name: x
props.description: Center position, as CSS lengths/percentages.

props.name: y
props.description: Vertical centre position, as a CSS length or percentage.

SpotlightCard.description:
A `Card` with a soft glow that follows the mouse (the `spotlight` utility on `usePointerVars`). It also glows at the
centre while something inside has keyboard focus. Touch, reduced motion and no hover leave it plain. Decoration only.

props.name: as
props.description: Element to render, so a card can sit in the page outline as an `article`, `section` or list item.

props.name: glowSize
props.description: Radius of the glow in px. Default 240 (the `--sutra-spotlight-size` token).

props.name: padded
props.description: Adds 24px (16px at `size="sm"`) of padding on the card itself; the parts carry their own padding instead.

props.name: size
props.description: `sm` tightens the padding of the card and its parts.

SSOOnlyCard.description: Stack of OAuth buttons (plus optional SAML SSO) for SSO-only sign in.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting text under the heading; each card has its own default.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message shown above the buttons (e.g. a failed sign-in).

props.name: footer
props.description: Replace the default footer (e.g. "Don't have an account? Sign up"). Pass `null` to hide it.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Element of the card title (`1` is an `h1`). Use `2` or lower when the card sits inside a page that has its own `h1`.

props.name: logo
props.description: Show the Sutra mark above the title, or pass a custom logo. Default: true for `card`.

props.name: onSAML
props.description: Show a "Continue with SAML SSO" button.

props.name: onSocialSignIn
props.description: Called with the provider when a social button is clicked. A returned promise shows a spinner on that button.

props.name: privacyHref
props.description: Link target of the privacy-policy text.

props.name: providers
props.description: OAuth providers to list; defaults to Google, Microsoft, Apple, GitHub and Slack.

props.name: renderLink
props.description: Router link renderer for the footer and inline links.

props.name: showSAML
props.description: Shows the "Continue with SAML SSO" button (needs `onSAML`).

props.name: termsHref
props.description: Link target of the terms-of-service text.

props.name: title
props.description: Card heading; each card has its own default.

props.name: variant
props.description: `card` renders a bordered surface; `plain` renders only the content (for full-page layouts).

Stack.description: Flex stack on the 4px spacing grid.

props.name: align
props.description: Cross-axis alignment of the children (`align-items`).

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as the child element instead of a `<div>`, keeping the stack styles.

props.name: direction
props.description: Main axis of the flex layout: `column` stacks, `row` lines up.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between children, in Tailwind spacing steps (4 = 1rem).

props.name: justify
props.description: Main-axis distribution of the children (`justify-content`).

props.name: wrap
props.description: Lets children wrap onto new lines when they overflow.

StackedMeter.description: One bar split into colored parts with a legend (storage breakdown, wait vs. generate…).

props.name: parts
props.description: Segments of the bar in order; each has a label, a value and an optional colour.

props.name: caption
props.description: Secondary line under the bar, e.g. "resets in 2h".

props.name: label
props.description: Text shown above the bar; also the accessible name of the meter.

props.name: legend
props.description:
Legend under the bar. `true` / `"inline"` (default): wrapping chips. `"list"`: one `BreakdownList` row per
part with the value right-aligned and a percent column. `false` hides it.

props.name: loading
props.description: Waiting for the first breakdown: with no `parts` the bar is a muted track and the legend shows placeholders.

props.name: max
props.description: Capacity. Defaults to the sum of parts (bar is full).

props.name: partSlot
props.description: `data-slot` of each part. Default "stacked-meter-part".

props.name: showPercent
props.description: Show each part's percentage (of `max`, else of the total) in the legend. Default false inline, true for `"list"`.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show the label / value header. Default true.

props.name: size
props.description: Bar height.

props.name: trackProps
props.description:
Props for the bar itself. By default it is `role="img"` named by a parts summary; pass

StagedSetupHero.description: One-click local-model quickstart: stage rail with statuses, per-stage CTA, download progress and retry.

StatCard.description:
KPI tile: label, big value, delta, hint and optional sparkline. With `href`/`onClick` the label becomes a

props.name: accent
props.description: Categorical colour for the icon chip, label, trend and progress bar. `tone` stays for status.

props.name: caption

props.name: chevron

props.name: children

props.name: delta
props.description: Change vs. a previous period. Numbers are shown signed with `deltaSuffix`.

props.name: deltaIntent

props.name: deltaLabel
props.description: Comparison period, e.g. "vs last week".

props.name: deltaSuffix
props.description: Appended to numeric deltas. Default "%".

props.name: hint

props.name: iconPlacement

props.name: trendPlacement

This covers the platform, not the agent: for what the agent itself is doing (thinking, running a tool,
waiting for permission) use `AgentStatusLine`, which sits in the same slot. Show one at a time.

StepWizard.description:
A multi-step flow in one place: the steps slide in the direction you are going, the area grows or shrinks to the
height of the current step, and a progress bar or `Steps` shows where you are. `canAdvance` validates before moving
forward (it may be async), Back is free, focus moves to the new step's panel so a screen reader announces it, and
Enter in a text field presses Next. Controlled with `value` or uncontrolled. Under reduced motion the steps swap
with no slide and the height jumps.

props.name: steps
props.description: Steps in order; each has an `id`, a `title` and the content to show.

props.name: canAdvance
props.description:
Checked before leaving a step forward (Next, Finish, or a jump ahead); return false (or a promise of false) to stay.
While a promise is pending the buttons wait. Going back is never checked.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially shown step id when uncontrolled.

props.name: footer
props.description: Replace the Back / Next row, or pass false to hide it.

props.name: indicator
props.description: `"auto"` shows `Steps` from a container width of 28rem up and a progress bar below; or force one. Default "auto".

props.name: keepMounted
props.description: Keep every step mounted (hidden) so typed values survive going back. Default false: only the current step is rendered.

props.name: labels
props.description: Overrides for the button and progress texts (`back`, `next`, `finish`, `step`).

props.name: onBlocked
props.description: Called when `canAdvance` keeps the user on a step: show the error there.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: The Finish button was pressed on the last step (after `canAdvance`). It may return a promise; the button shows loading until it settles.

props.name: onError
props.description: `canAdvance` or `onComplete` threw or rejected: the wizard stays on the step.

props.name: onValueChange
props.type: (id: string, meta: { index: number; direction: "forward" | "back" }) => void
props.description: Called with the new step id, its index and the direction when the user moves between steps.

props.name: stepsProps
props.description: Passed to `Steps` (variant, size, connector).

props.name: value
props.description: Id of the step in view.

SutraAppIcon.description:
App icon for a Sutra suite app: a tile with a thread running across it, a bead on the thread and one pictogram in the bead.
The thread leaves the tile on both sides, so a row of icons reads as beads on one string.

props.name: app
props.description: The Sutra app to draw the icon for.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner style of the tile.

props.name: size
props.description: Rendered pixel size (width and height).

props.name: title
props.description: Accessible title. When omitted, the graphic is hidden from assistive tech.

props.name: tone
props.description: Colour of the icon. Default `mono`.

SutradharSting.description:
A short logo sting with Sutradhar and the Sutra mark (the crescent bead on its thread), drawn in ink like the mascot. The
final lockup is the markup (it renders on the server, under reduced motion and before a play starts); while it plays, the
shared mascot frame driver writes the frames. It pauses off screen; `astra-endless` keeps streaming for as long as it is on
screen. Decorative unless `title` is set. The art is direction-agnostic: it is drawn the same in left-to-right and right-to-left
layouts (Sutradhar walks in from the left and the astra's aim is a protractor angle, like a logo), so it is never mirrored.

props.name: aim
props.description:
The astra's aim in degrees, measured like a protractor: 90 points straight up, 180 level to the left, 270 straight down.
Clamped to 30 to 330; left out, `astra` aims at 150 and `astra-endless` at 172. Aimed to the right (under 90 or over
270) he turns round and faces where he fires; aimed steeply up or down the view pulls back just enough to keep the whole
wave on the stage, and for a downward shot he rises off the ground as he swings. `mark` does not use it.

props.name: autoPlay
props.description: Play once when the sting first comes on screen. False shows the final lockup until `replayKey` changes.

props.name: loop
props.description:
Play again after a short hold on the lockup, for as long as it is on screen. `astra-endless` never stops, so it has no use
for it.

props.name: onComplete
props.description:
Called when a play reaches its lockup (also at once under reduced motion, where only the lockup is shown); for
`astra-endless`, once its stream runs at full length (it keeps playing).

props.name: paused
props.description: Freeze the animation where it is (the clock stops; resume to carry on from there). Use it for off-screen or background stings.

props.name: replayKey
props.description: Change it to play the sting again from the start.

props.name: size
props.description:
Rendered height: a number of pixels or any CSS length; the width follows the drawing (6:5 for `mark`, 16:13 for `astra`,
32:13 for `astra-endless`). Unlike `SutraMascot` and the brand marks, whose `size` is both width and height, the stings
are wider than tall, so `size` is the height only.

props.name: title
props.description:
Accessible name. A string names the graphic, `true` uses the label of the variant (`Sutradhar forms the Sutra mark`, ...),
and leaving it out keeps the sting decorative (hidden from assistive technology).

props.name: variant
props.description:
`mark` Sutradhar walks in with a bare thread, the crescent bead drops onto it and becomes the Sutra mark, he plants it and
smiles (about 4.6 s). `astra` he summons a hand astra (the crescent bead on a short thread), charges it until ink lightning
crackles round the bead, swings it into the aim and fires an ink wave out of its head into empty space (about 5.4 s). Both
end on a still lockup. `astra-endless` is the same astra on a wide stage that never stops once fired: the lightning keeps
crackling round the bead, arcs and beads flow out along the wave, and the wave streams on across the whole stage and thins
away at its far end (it is at full length after about 4.6 s and keeps playing while on screen).

props.name: intro
props.description:
Play the intro once on mount: the mark's intro (see `SutraMark`), then the drawn wordmark writes itself (about 2.3 s in
all). Reduced motion shows the still logo.

props.name: layout
props.description: Mark beside the wordmark (`horizontal`) or above it (`stacked`).

props.name: markOnly
props.description: Hide the wordmark and show only the mark.

props.name: markVariant
props.description: Which `SutraMark` variant leads the lockup. Default `glyph` (ink on paper).

props.name: product
props.description: Optional product suffix shown after the wordmark, e.g. "notes".

props.name: size
props.description: Logo size.

SutraMark.description: The Sutra logomark: a crescent bead on an upright thread. Ink on paper by default, so it follows the text colour.

props.name: intro
props.description:
Play the intro once when the mark mounts: the crescent drops in and lands with a short bounce, then the thread draws down
through its opening and on behind the base (about 1.4 s). Reduced motion shows the still mark. Remount (change `key`) to
play it again.

props.name: size
props.description: Rendered pixel size (width and height).

props.name: title
props.description: Accessible title. When omitted, the graphic is hidden from assistive tech.

props.name: variant
props.description:
`glyph` the crescent bead and its thread alone in `currentColor`, ink on paper (default),
`tile` the bead in ink on a paper tile with a hairline edge,
`reversed` paper bead on an ink tile (for dark surfaces),
`solid` flat `--primary` tile with a `--primary-foreground` bead (follows the theme and the paper style),
`outline` thin frame in `currentColor` around the bead,
`badge` heavy frame in `currentColor` around a bold bead.

SutraMascot.description:
The Sutra mascot: a friendly bead on a thread, with a face that follows `state` (idle, listening, thinking, working, speaking,
happy, sleeping, error). Flat shapes, ink on paper; the motion is CSS keyframes that stand still under reduced motion while
the expression stays. Decorative unless `title` is set. The art is direction-agnostic: it is drawn the same in left-to-right and
right-to-left layouts (the characters face left and the listening arcs open to the right on purpose, like a logo), so it is never mirrored.

props.name: app
props.description: The Sutra app whose dye colours the bead when `tone` is `dyed` (see `sutraAppMeta`).

props.name: character
props.description:
Which Sutra: `bead` the bead buddy on its thread (the original), `pendant` a bead hanging on a thread with a knot under it,
`mala` a head bead leading three beads on a thread, `bindu` a drop of ink whose tip curls into a thread, `knot-pendant` the
bead hanging straight from a knot, `bow` the bead buddy with a bow tied from her thread, `bun` the pendant with a bun and a
pin, `sutradhar` a whole figure strung from beads and thread. Every character has all eight states, the three shapes and
the dyed tone. The bead moves with CSS keyframes; the others are drawn frame by frame while motion is allowed.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freeze the animation where it is (the expression stays). Use it for off-screen or background mascots.

props.name: replayKey
props.description: Change it to play a one-shot reaction (`happy`, `error`) again while the state stays the same.

props.name: shape
props.description:
`bare` the character alone in `currentColor` (follows the text colour), `circle` or `squircle` on a paper tile with a hairline,
the form for a chat or agent avatar next to `Avatar`.

props.name: size
props.description: Rendered width and height: a number of pixels or any CSS length.

props.name: state
props.description:
What the mascot is doing. The face and the extras around it change with the state (so it reads without motion), and the
animation swaps in place without remounting: the pose blends into the new state with a blink (instant under reduced
motion). `happy` and `error` are one-shot reactions that play again when the state is set again.

props.name: title
props.description:
Accessible name. A string names the graphic, `true` uses the label of the current state (`mascotStateLabels`), and leaving it out
makes the mascot decorative (hidden from assistive technology): pair it with live text that says what Sutra is doing.

props.name: tone
props.description: `mono` ink on paper, `dyed` puts the dye of `app` in the bead. Without an `app`, `dyed` stays ink.

SutraWordmark.description:
The lowercase "sutra" wordmark. Without `children` it is the drawn brand word (monoline, scales with the font size, real text for
screen readers); with `children` it sets your text in the brand sans.

props.name: gradient
props.description: Show the brand name in a gradient instead of `currentColor`.

props.name: size
props.description: Wordmark text size.

SvgEmbed.description: Safely renders user-supplied SVG through an image data URL (no innerHTML, no script execution).

props.name: svg
props.description: SVG markup (untrusted). Rendered via an data URL, never injected as HTML, so scripts and remote refs don't run.

props.name: title
props.description: Alt text.

props.name: caption
props.description: Optional caption.

props.name: imgClassName
props.description: Extra classes for the rendered image.

SwapButton.description: Swap source/target languages with a half-turn animation.

props.name: onSwap
props.description: Called when the user presses the button to swap source and target.

SwipeDeck.description:
Triage cards one at a time: drag the top card and it flies away (past 90 px or on a flick) or springs back, with a tilt of
0.05 degrees per px and the cards behind stepping up the stack as it goes. The same choices are Skip and Keep buttons, the
arrow keys and Enter on the focused deck, and Ctrl or Command + Z or the Undo button takes the last swipe back (the card
flies in again). `start` and `end` follow the reading direction, `onSwipe(side, item, index)` reports each choice, `onEmpty`
fires after the last card, `index` / `defaultIndex` / `onIndexChange` control the position. Screen readers get a labelled
group, the top card as "Card 2 of 8" and a polite announcement per swipe; the cards behind are `inert`. Built on `useDrag`,
so a drag writes CSS variables and never re-renders; reduced motion drops the flight (a swipe just changes the card).

props.name: getKey
props.description: A stable key per item (an id), so a card keeps its place and its flight when the list changes.

props.name: items
props.description: The cards in order; the top one is at `index`.

props.name: renderCard
props.description: The content of one card (the deck draws the card surface). Cards behind the top one render too: keep them cheap.

props.name: actions
props.description: Show the Skip, Undo and Keep buttons under the deck. Default true.

props.name: apiRef
props.description: Imperative handle (`swipe(side)`, `undo()`).

props.name: cardClassName
props.description: Classes of each card surface (give it a height).

props.name: defaultIndex
props.description: Initial top-card index when uncontrolled.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Ignore drags, keys and buttons.

props.name: distance
props.description: Distance (px) of a drag that commits. Default 90.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Content shown once every card has been swiped away.

props.name: endIcon
props.description: Icon of the end button. Default a check.

props.name: endLabel
props.description: Name of the end action (also Enter). Default "Keep".

props.name: getLabel
props.description: Names the item in the screen reader announcements ("Kept: Invoice 12"). Default: no name.

props.name: index
props.description: Index of the top card (`items.length` = none left).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the deck. Default "Card deck".

props.name: loading
props.description: Skeleton cards instead of items; the controls are hidden.

props.name: onEmpty
props.description: The last card was swiped away.

props.name: onIndexChange
props.description: Called with the new top-card index after a card is swiped away.

props.name: onSwipe
props.type: (side: SwipeDeckSide, item: T, index: number) => void
props.description: A card was dismissed to a side by a drag, a key or a button. `start` and `end` follow the reading direction.

props.name: onUndo
props.description: The last swipe was taken back.

props.name: stack
props.description: Cards that show in the stack (the top one included). Default 3.

props.name: startIcon
props.description: Icon of the start button. Default a cross.

props.name: startLabel
props.description: Name of the start action. Default "Skip".

SwipeRow.description:
A list row that follows the finger: drag it to reveal buttons at its start or end, or swipe all the way to run the outermost
one. It builds on `useDrag` (the offset lives in `--sutra-drag-x`, no render per move), rubber-bands past the end, releases
with a spring and opens at 40% of the actions' width. The actions are real buttons: Tab reaches them (a focused button opens
its side), Arrow keys on the row open and close it, Escape closes it, and `onAction` runs for buttons and swipes alike.
Use `Item` rows as the content; inside an `ItemGroup` the row itself is the list item.

props.name: actionsLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the action groups. Default "Actions".

props.name: actionWidth
props.description: Width of one action button in px, so the reveal distance is known without measuring. Default 72.

props.name: commit
props.description: A full swipe runs the outermost action. Default true; false stops at the revealed actions.

props.name: contentClassName
props.description: Classes of the sliding content layer (it must stay opaque to hide the actions). Default `bg-background`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially open side when uncontrolled; `null` is closed.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables swiping.

props.name: endActions
props.description: Actions revealed by dragging toward the inline start (left in left-to-right text).

props.name: onAction
props.description: Runs for a button press, a key press and a full swipe alike.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the open side (`null` when closed) after a swipe.

props.name: startActions
props.description: Actions revealed by dragging toward the inline end (right in left-to-right text).

props.name: value
props.description: Which side's actions are open (`null` closed).

SyncReceiptCard.description: Post-sync summary: updated, failed rebuilds, disabled by dependency conflict and available updates.

props.name: onValueChange

props.name: checked

props.name: size

sizes.sm: pill: h-6 px-2.5 text-xs solid: h-6 px-2.5 text-xs ghost: h-8 px-2.5 text-xs underline: h-9 px-1 text-xs

TabsList.description: Container for triggers; renders the sliding active indicator.

props.name: emptyState

props.name: onValueChange

props.description: Shows a busy state on the new-session button while a session is being created.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially active session id when `value` is not controlled.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when there are no sessions. Default "No sessions".

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the session list. Default "Terminal sessions".

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows placeholder rows while the sessions load.

props.name: onCreate
props.description: Shows a "New session" button.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the session id when the user picks a session.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected (active) session id.

TestimonialWall.description: Masonry wall of quotes with source badges and a category filter.

props.name: testimonials
props.description: Quotes to show; each has a `quote`, a `name`, a `source` and optional handle, avatar and categories.

props.name: defaultCategory
props.description: Initially selected category tab when uncontrolled.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting text under the heading.

props.name: title
props.description: Section heading.

Text.description:
Body text with `size`, `tone` and `weight`; renders a `

` unless `as` says otherwise. Extra props are spread to the element.

props.name: as
props.description: Element to render, independent of the visual styles.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as the child element instead of the text tag, keeping the text styles.

props.name: size
props.description: Type scale step: `xs`, `sm`, `md` (base), `lg` or `xl`.

props.name: tone
props.description: `default` is plain foreground text; the semantic tones follow `Tone` (`muted` is the legacy name of `neutral`).

props.name: weight
props.description: Font weight.

Textarea.description: Multi-line text input with optional auto-resize and character counter. Consumes `Field` context.

props.name: autoResize
props.description: Grow with the content between `minRows` and `maxRows`.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the textarea invalid: error border and `aria-invalid`. Inherited from a surrounding `Field` when omitted.

props.name: maxRows
props.description: Largest height in text rows when `autoResize` is on; taller content scrolls. Default: unlimited.

props.name: minRows
props.description: Minimum height in text rows (also the initial height).

props.name: showCount
props.description: Show a character counter (uses `maxLength` as the limit when set).

props.name: variant
props.description: `outline` (default) is the bordered box; `filled` is a tinted surface with a hidden border.

props.name: wrapperClassName
