props.description: Class for the wrapper rendered when `showCount` is on.

TextButton.description: An action that reads as part of a sentence: inline text, underlined on hover. A link with `href`, a button otherwise.
TextButton.deprecated:
Use `TextLink`: `<TextLink onClick={…} variant="subtle">` (or `as="button"`) for the button form,
`<TextLink href>` for the link form. `tone` maps to `variant`: default → subtle, muted → muted, destructive → destructive.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the button.

props.name: download
props.description: Makes the link a download; a string sets the file name.

props.name: href
props.description: Renders an `<a>` when set; otherwise a `<button type="button">`.

props.name: rel
props.description: Link `rel` when `href` is set.

props.name: target
props.description: Link `target` when `href` is set.

props.name: tone
props.description: Text colour: `default`, `muted` or `destructive` (`danger` is an alias).

props.name: type
props.description: Button `type` when there is no `href`.

TextLink.description:
Inline text link with underline styles and optional external indicator.
With `onClick` and no `href` (or `as="button"`) it renders a button that reads as part of the sentence.
For a standalone action use `Button variant="link"`.

props.name: as
props.description:
`button` renders a `<button type="button">` styled as a link, for an inline action inside a sentence.
Default: `button` when there is an `onClick` but no `href`, otherwise `a`.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as the child element (e.g. a router Link).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the button, or in link mode renders an `aria-disabled` link without `href` that ignores clicks.

props.name: external
props.description: Opens in a new tab with safe `rel` and shows an arrow-up-right icon.

props.name: size
props.description: Text size: `inherit` keeps the surrounding size, or `sm`, `md`, `lg`.

props.name: underline
props.description: When the underline shows: `always`, on `hover` or `none`.

props.name: variant
props.description: Colour: `default` (primary), `muted`, `subtle` (text colour) or `destructive`.

TextShimmer.description: Text with an animated light sweep, used for "Thinking…" style status lines.

props.name: as
props.description: Element to render. Defaults to `span`.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for one sweep of the highlight.

props.name: spread
props.description: Half-width of the bright band, as a percentage of the text width.

ThemeToggle.description: Light / dark / system switch: an animated icon button or a segmented control.

props.name: applyToDocument
props.description: Toggle the `dark` class / color-scheme on <html> (through the same store as `useTheme`). Default true.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial theme mode when uncontrolled.

props.name: modes
props.description: Modes offered, in cycle order. `["light", "dark"]` makes a two-state toggle.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new mode when the user toggles it.

props.name: showLabels
props.description: Show labels next to icons in the segmented variant. Default true.

props.name: size
props.description: Button size.

props.name: storageKey
props.description: localStorage key used when uncontrolled; `null` disables persistence.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled theme mode. Use with `onValueChange`.

props.name: variant
props.description: `icon` cycles through `modes` with a sun/moon morph; `segmented` shows all modes.

ThermalSensors.description: CPU / GPU / SSD / battery temperatures in a card, coloured by thresholds, with an optional °C / °F switch.

props.name: sensors
props.description: Sensors to list, each with a label, a reading in °C and optional history.

props.name: accent
props.description: Default "orange".

props.name: defaultUnit
props.description: Initial display unit when `unit` is not controlled.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when `sensors` is empty. Default "No temperature sensors".

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the list. Default "Temperature sensors".

props.name: loading
props.description: Data is on its way. With no sensors yet the card shows placeholder rows; with sensors the root is only marked busy.

props.name: loadingRows
props.description: Placeholder sensors while loading. Default 4.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale used to format numbers.

props.name: max
props.description: Scale top in °C. Default 110.

props.name: min
props.description: Scale bottom and top in °C. Default 20–110.

props.name: onUnitChange
props.description: Called with the unit when the user flips the °C / °F switch.

props.name: showUnitToggle
props.description: Show the °C / °F switch in the header. Default true when `onUnitChange` is set.

props.name: statusLabels
props.description: Words shown when a sensor is strained. Default "hot" / "critical".

props.name: thresholds
props.description: Default thresholds in °C for sensors without their own.

props.name: title
props.description: Header title. Default "Temperatures"; `null` hides the header (unless the unit switch is shown).

props.name: unit
props.description: Display unit (readings stay °C).

props.name: variant
props.description: `meter` rows (default) or a grid of `gauge`s.

ThinkingExpandAllProvider.description: Shares one "expand all thinking" switch with every ChainOfThought inside (e.g. a transcript).

props.name: children
props.description: Transcript subtree whose thinking blocks and `ThinkingToggle` share the state.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Initial state when `expanded` is not controlled.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Controlled "expand all thinking" state shared by every `ChainOfThought` below.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the user toggles it.

ThinkingToggle.description: Toggle button that expands / collapses every ChainOfThought under a ThinkingExpandAllProvider.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as the child element (e.g. a link) while keeping button styles.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretches the button to the width of its container.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Icon before the label.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner and disables the button.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Click handler, called before the toggle; call `preventDefault()` to keep the state unchanged.

props.name: size
props.description: Button height and padding; `icon-*` sizes are square.

props.name: spinnerProps
props.description: Overrides for the loading spinner (variant, size, `label`, colour via `className`); it inherits the button text colour by default.

props.name: trailingIcon
props.description: Icon after the label.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style: `primary` (filled), `secondary` (bordered), `tertiary` (muted fill), `soft`, `ghost`, `outline`, `destructive`, `destructive-soft`, `inverse` or `link`.

TilingLayout.description: IDE-style tiling workspace: nested resizable splits of tab groups with drag-and-drop, zoom and keep-alive panes.

props.name: renderPane
props.description: Renders the content of a pane from its pane id.

props.name: createPane
props.description:
Supply a new pane id for "Split right/down". Without it, splitting moves the tab into a
new group (or creates an empty group when it is the only tab).

props.name: defaultLayout
props.description: Initial layout tree when uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultMaximizedGroup
props.description: Initially maximized group id when uncontrolled.

props.name: floating
props.description: Floating windows rendered over the layout; enables "Pop out" and "Dock".

props.name: keepAlive
props.description: Keep inactive tabs mounted (hidden) so their state survives. Default true.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the workspace. Default "Workspace".

props.name: layout
props.description: Controlled layout tree: nested splits (with a direction and sizes) and tab groups holding pane ids. Use with `onLayoutChange`.

props.name: maximizedGroup
props.description: Maximized group id (controlled).

props.name: minSize
props.description: Minimum fraction per split child. Default 0.08.

props.name: onFloatingChange
props.description: Called with the new list of floating windows after one is moved, resized or closed; setting it also enables "Pop out" and "Dock".

props.name: onLayoutChange
props.description: Called with the new layout after a resize, split, move, close or drop.

props.name: onMaximizedGroupChange
props.description: Called with the maximized group id (or `null` when restored).

props.name: onPaneClose
props.description: Called after a pane was closed from the UI.

props.name: paneClosable
props.description: Whether a pane shows a close button. Default: all closable.

props.name: paneIcon
props.description: Icon shown before the pane's tab title.

props.name: paneLabel
props.description: Plain-text name used in aria labels when `paneTitle` returns a node.

props.name: paneTitle
props.description: Tab title (default: the pane id).

props.name: renderEmptyGroup
props.description: Content for empty groups (default: a drop hint).

props.name: shortcuts
props.description: Register keyboard shortcuts (mod+\, mod+shift+\, mod+w, ctrl+tab, mod+1…9).

props.name: step
props.description: Keyboard resize step (fraction). Default 0.02.

TiltCard.description:
A `Card` that tilts toward the mouse in 3D. The pointer is read on a still wrapper (`data-slot="tilt-card-field"`)
and the card inside tilts, so it never moves out from under the pointer. Props and the ref go to the card. Touch,
reduced motion and no hover leave it flat. Use it for hero, plan and entity cards, not for dense or live content.

props.name: as
props.description: Element to render, so a card can sit in the page outline as an `article`, `section` or list item.

props.name: max
props.description: Tilt at the edge, in degrees. Default 7 (the `--sutra-tilt-max` token; paper uses 3).

props.name: padded
props.description: Adds 24px (16px at `size="sm"`) of padding on the card itself; the parts carry their own padding instead.

props.name: size
props.description: `sm` tightens the padding of the card and its parts.

props.name: spotlight
props.description: Add the pointer glow too. Default false.

TimelineBar.description: Time-window bar with spans per lane (session uptime, GPU job occupancy), live spans and a tick axis.

props.name: from
props.description: Window start.

props.name: to
props.description: Window end.

props.name: formatDuration
props.description: Formats the duration shown in the span tooltip. Default is a short "1h 20m".

props.name: formatTime
props.description: Formats the time shown in the span tooltip.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name.

props.name: labelWidth
props.description: Width of the lane label column in px. Default 112.

props.name: laneHeight
props.description: Lane height in px. Default 24.

props.name: lanes
props.description: Multiple labelled lanes.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale for the default time formatting.

props.name: now
props.description: Reference "now" for live spans. Default Date.now().

props.name: onSpanClick
props.description: Called with the span (and its lane) when a span is clicked; spans then become buttons.

props.name: showAxis
props.description: Shows the time axis under the lanes.

props.name: showNow
props.description: Show the "now" marker when inside the window. Default true.

props.name: spans
props.description: Single unlabelled lane (shorthand).

props.name: tickFormatter
props.description: Formats the axis tick labels. Default depends on the window: time of day, or date and time across days.

props.name: ticks
props.description: Number of tick intervals. Default 6; fewer are drawn when the axis is too narrow for their labels.

TimePicker.description:
Time field with hour, minute (and optional second / AM-PM) segments. Each segment is a spinbutton:
arrows step it, digits type into it, Backspace clears it. Value is a 24-hour `"HH:mm"` string.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Show an inline button that clears the time.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial time (`"HH:mm"`) when uncontrolled.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every segment.

props.name: granularity
props.description: Show a seconds segment. Default `"minute"`.

props.name: hourCycle
props.description: Force a 12- or 24-hour clock. Defaults to the locale's convention.

props.name: icon
props.description: Show the leading clock icon. Default true. With `wheel` on it is the button that opens the wheels, so it stays.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the field invalid: error border and `aria-invalid`. Inherited from a surrounding `Field` when omitted.

props.name: labels
props.description: Override the segment names and the clear button label (i18n).

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale for the clock convention, segment order and AM/PM labels.

props.name: max
props.description: Latest allowed time (`"HH:mm"`).

props.name: min
props.description: Earliest allowed time (`"HH:mm"`). Values outside the range are clamped.

props.name: name
props.description: Submits the value under this name through a hidden input.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new time, or `undefined` when it is cleared or no longer complete.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Shows the time without letting the user change it.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field required. Inherited from a surrounding `Field` when omitted.

props.name: size
props.description: Field height and text size.

props.name: step
props.description: Minutes moved by the minute segment's arrow keys (snaps to multiples). Default 1.

props.name: value
props.description: Time as `"HH:mm"` (24-hour), or `"HH:mm:ss"` with `granularity="second"`. `undefined` means empty.

props.name: wheel
props.description:
Offer scrolling wheels (hours, minutes, optional seconds and AM/PM, in the locale's order) in a popover, for touch. `true`
adds a clock button that opens them on any device; `"touch"` does so only where the primary pointer is coarse, and there a tap
on the field opens them and the segments stop raising the on-screen keyboard. The wheels keep `step`, `min`, `max` and
`granularity`, change the value as they scroll, and Done closes them. The segments and their keys work as before.

TimeScrubber.description: Range slider over time with a histogram of counts per bucket and chronological play/pause playback (Space toggles).

props.name: nodes
props.description: Items to histogram (only `createdAt` is used).

props.name: buckets
props.description: Histogram bucket count. Default 32.

props.name: defaultPlaying
props.description: Initial playback state when `playing` is not controlled.

props.name: defaultSpeed
props.description: Initial speed when `speed` is not controlled.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial range when `value` is not controlled; defaults to the full axis.

props.name: duration
props.description: Full sweep duration at 1× in ms. Default 8000.

props.name: formatTime
props.description: Custom formatter for the axis and handle labels, given epoch ms.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale used to format the default labels.

props.name: max
props.description: End of the time axis in epoch ms; defaults to the latest `createdAt` in `nodes`.

props.name: min
props.description: Start of the time axis in epoch ms; defaults to the earliest `createdAt` in `nodes`.

props.name: onPlayingChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the user presses play or pause, or playback reaches the end.

props.name: onSpeedChange
props.description: Called with the multiplier when the user picks another speed.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new `[from, to]` range while the user drags a handle or playback advances.

props.name: playing
props.description: Controlled playback state: true sweeps the range forward on a timer.

props.name: speed
props.description: Controlled playback speed multiplier; one of `speeds`.

props.name: speeds
props.description: Speed multipliers the user can cycle through. Default `[0.5, 1, 2, 4]`.

props.name: tickMs
props.description: Playback tick in ms. Default 100.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected range as `[from, to]` in epoch ms.

TipBubble.description: Dismissible contextual tip anchored to an element, with a rotating "Next tip" list.

props.name: tips
props.description: One or more tips; "Next tip" cycles through them.

props.name: accent
props.description: Legacy name of `tone`.

props.name: align
props.description: Alignment of the bubble along that side.

props.name: children
props.description: Anchor element (wrapped with asChild). Use `target` instead to anchor to an existing element.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the bubble.

props.name: defaultIndex
props.description: Initial tip index when uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon shown beside the tip text.

props.name: index
props.description: Controlled index of the visible tip when there are several. Use with `onIndexChange`.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called when the bubble is closed.

props.name: onDontShowAgain
props.description: Shows a "Don't show again" action.

props.name: onIndexChange
props.description: Called with the new tip index when the user pages through the tips.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the bubble opens or closes.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Use with `onOpenChange`.

props.name: side
props.description: Side of the anchor the bubble opens on.

props.name: target
props.description: Existing element to anchor to: a CSS selector or a ref. Use it instead of wrapping an anchor in `children`.

props.name: tone
props.description: Accent colour of the bar and icon. Default `primary`.

Toaster.description: Sonner toaster styled with Sutra tokens. Follows the `.dark` class on <html> unless `theme` is set.

TodayTimeline.description: Merged chronological agenda across apps: untimed section, hourly rail, now line and overlap layout.

props.name: items
props.description: Events, tasks and habits for the day, each with a time, title and kind.

props.name: density
props.description:
Rail spacing. `compact` tightens the hour rail; `normal` (default) and `relaxed` use the
roomy rail. The legacy `"comfortable"` is accepted as an alias of `relaxed`.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when there are no items.

props.name: endHour
props.description: Last hour on the rail; defaults to fit the items within 8 to 20.

props.name: now
props.description: Fixed current time (otherwise the clock updates every minute).

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called with the item when the user opens it.

props.name: onToggle
props.description: Toggle a task or habit.

props.name: startHour
props.description: First / last hour on the rail. Defaults fit the items within 8–20.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading above the timeline.

ToggleButton.description: A button that stays pressed (`aria-pressed`): bold, mute, pin. Controlled with `pressed`, or uncontrolled with `defaultPressed`.

props.name: size
props.description: Item height and padding.

props.name: variant
props.description: Look of the items: `default` (ghost), `outline` or `soft` (tinted when on).

ToggleGroup.description:
Row of toggle buttons, `type="single"` or `"multiple"`, with roving focus (one tab stop, arrow keys move). Each item
is a button with `aria-pressed`; give the group an `aria-label`. For an exclusive choice that reads as a tab-like
switch, `SegmentedControl` is the better fit.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially pressed item value when uncontrolled.

props.name: dir
props.description: Reading direction for arrow-key navigation; inherits the surrounding direction by default.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every item.

props.name: loop
props.description: Wrap focus from the last item to the first (default true).

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the pressed item value, or an empty string when it is toggled off.

props.name: orientation
props.description:
Restricts the arrow keys to this axis. Unset (the default), all four arrow keys move focus, and the group
keeps its row layout either way.

props.name: size
props.description: Item height and padding.

props.name: type
props.description:
At most one item pressed; pressing it again clears the value to `""`.
Any number of items pressed.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled pressed item value (empty string for none). Use with `onValueChange`.

props.name: variant
props.description: Look of the items: `default` (ghost), `outline` or `soft` (tinted when on).

ToggleGroupItem.description: One toggle in a `ToggleGroup`; `value` identifies it.

props.name: size
props.description: Item height and padding.

props.name: variant
props.description: Look of the items: `default` (ghost), `outline` or `soft` (tinted when on).

ToolGroup.description: Folds consecutive low-signal calls into one row ("Explored 6 files"), expandable to list them.

props.name: autoCollapse
props.description: Collapse when the group finishes running (uncontrolled only). Default true.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial expanded state when `open` is not controlled.

props.name: icon
props.description: Replaces the default group icon.

props.name: label
props.description: Custom label, e.g. ({ count }) => `Searched ${count} patterns`.

props.name: noun
props.description: Singular noun. Default "file".

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the user expands or collapses the group.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled expanded state of the group.

props.name: pluralNoun
props.description: Plural noun. Default `${noun}s`.

props.name: runningVerb
props.description: Present participle while running. Default "Exploring".

props.name: status
props.description: Group status; derived from the children's `status` when omitted. Accepts `TaskStatus` values too.

props.name: verb
props.description: Past-tense verb. Default "Explored".

ToolHintTag.description: Small tag describing a tool's side effects.

props.name: hint
props.description: Tool hint to label: `read-only`, `destructive`, `network`, `filesystem` or `costly`; sets the tag text and tone.

ToolKeyValueBody.description: Generic label / value grid for tool inputs and results.

props.name: rows
props.description: Label and value pairs shown as a definition list.

props.name: valueHeight
props.description: Height cap for each value before "Show more". Default 72.

ToolsetCard.description: Toolset summary card: icon, description, tool count, enabled switch, health pill and Configure.

props.name: name
props.description: Toolset name, shown as the card title.

props.name: defaultEnabled
props.description: Initial on/off state when `enabled` is not controlled.

props.name: description
props.description: Short summary of what the toolset provides.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the switch and the Configure button.

props.name: enabled
props.description: Controlled on/off state of the toolset switch.

props.name: health
props.description:
Toolset health (`configured`, `needs-keys`, `error`); shows a health pill, and `error` colours `healthMessage`
red.

props.name: healthMessage
props.description: Error or hint shown under the description.

props.name: icon
props.description: Toolset icon, shown beside the name.

props.name: onConfigure
props.description: Called when the user presses Configure; the button is hidden when unset.

props.name: onEnabledChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the user flips the switch.

props.name: toolCount
props.description: Number of tools in the toolset, shown as a count.

props.name: health
props.description: Health to show: `configured`, `needs-keys` or `error`; sets the pill text, icon and tone.

ToolsetProviderDrawer.description: Side sheet to configure a toolset: on/off, backend provider, credentials and a post-setup install step.

props.name: providers
props.description: Backends that can power the toolset, each with its credential fields and setup state.

props.name: title
props.description: Drawer heading, usually the toolset name.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the drawer content.

props.name: defaultEnabled
props.description: Initial on/off state when `enabled` is not controlled.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when `open` is not controlled.

props.name: defaultProvider
props.description: Initially selected provider id when `provider` is not controlled.

props.name: description
props.description: Helper text under the heading.

props.name: enabled
props.description: Controlled on/off state of the toolset switch in the drawer header.

props.name: installLabel
props.description: Label of the install button. Default "Run setup".

props.name: installLog
props.description: Installer output lines shown while and after the install step runs.

props.name: installStatus
props.description: Progress of the install step: `idle`, `running`, `success` or `error`.

props.name: onClearCredential
props.description: Called with the provider id and credential key when the user clears a stored credential.

props.name: onEnabledChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the user flips the switch.

props.name: onInstall
props.description: Post-setup install step (e.g. pip install). Omit to hide.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the drawer opens or closes.

props.name: onProviderChange
props.description: Called with the provider id when the user selects another provider.

props.name: onSaveCredential
props.type: (providerId: string, key: string, value: string) => void | Promise<void>
props.description: Store a credential. May return a promise.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state of the drawer.

props.name: provider
props.description: Controlled id of the selected provider.

ToolTimeline.description: Vertical rail of agent steps. Children are ToolTimelineItem, ToolGroup or ToolTimelineText (other nodes are wrapped as text).

ToolTimelineDot.description: Status dot on the timeline rail (a `StatusDot` placed on the rail): success, failure, progress (pulsing), warning or pending (dashed ring).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label; defaults to the status name.

props.name: status
props.description: Omit for a neutral narration dot (hidden from assistive tech). Accepts `TaskStatus` values too.

ToolTimelineItem.description: One compact tool call row: icon, bold name, mono argument, meta and an expandable body (children).

props.name: name
props.description: Tool name, e.g. "Read", "Bash".

props.name: arg
props.description: Primary argument (path, command, pattern) in muted mono.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial expanded state when `open` is not controlled.

props.name: diffStat
props.description: Line counts shown as "+12 −3".

props.name: duration
props.description: Duration in milliseconds.

props.name: exitCode
props.description: Exit code of a command tool, shown as an "exit N" badge; non-zero turns it red.

props.name: icon
props.description: Replaces the default icon chosen from the tool name.

props.name: meta
props.description: Extra right-side meta.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the user expands or collapses the row.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled expanded state of the body (`children`).

props.name: runningLabel
props.description: Label while running (default "Running {name}…").

props.name: status
props.description: Default `success`. Accepts canonical `TaskStatus` values (`succeeded`, `failed`, `running`, `canceled`).

props.name: status
props.description: Optional status for the dot (narration usually has none).

Tooltip.description:
Tooltip root. Uses the nearest `TooltipProvider` (so skip-delay works across tooltips)
and falls back to its own provider when there is none.

TooltipContent.description: Floating tooltip bubble (dark inverse by default).

props.name: arrow
props.description: Show the pointing arrow. Default true.

props.name: side
props.description:
Side of the trigger the tooltip opens on. `start` and `end` follow the reading direction (left and right in LTR, swapped in
RTL, read from `DirectionProvider` or `<html dir>`); `left` and `right` stay physical. It flips when there is no room.

props.name: variant
props.description: Look of the bubble: `inverse` (dark, default) or `light` (bordered popover surface).

TooltipProvider.description: Shares hover delay between tooltips. Mount once near the app root.

TooltipTrigger.description: Element that opens the tooltip on hover/focus.

ToolToggleList.description: Tool list with per-tool switches, filters, bulk actions, policy locks and a sticky unsaved-changes footer.

props.name: tools
props.description: The tools to list, each with its saved enabled state.

props.name: defaultShowDeprecated
props.description: Initial "Show deprecated" state when `showDeprecated` is not controlled.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when no tool matches the search or filters. Default "No tools match".

props.name: hideToolbar
props.description: Hide the search + filter toolbar.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the list. Default "Tools".

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Max height of the scrolling list (keeps long lists cheap to lay out).

props.name: onDiscard
props.description: Called when the user discards the draft changes; the Discard button is hidden when unset.

props.name: onDraftChange
props.description: Fires on every draft change.

props.name: onSave
props.type: (enabled: Record<string, boolean>, changed: string[]) => void | Promise<void>
props.description: Called with the full enabled map and the ids that changed. May return a promise.

props.name: onShowDeprecatedChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the user flips the "Show deprecated" switch.

props.name: showDeprecated
props.description: Controlled "Show deprecated" state; deprecated tools are hidden when false.

ToolToggleRow.description: One tool row: name, hint tags, lock state, switch and an expandable detail.

props.name: tool
props.description: The tool to show (name, description, hints, enabled state).

props.name: checked
props.description: Controlled switch state.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Initial switch state when uncontrolled. Defaults to `tool.enabled`.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Initial expanded state when `expanded` is not controlled.

props.name: dirty
props.description: Marks the row as changed from the saved state with an "Unsaved" dot.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Controlled expanded state of the row's details.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the user flips the switch.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the user expands or collapses the row.

TopItemCard.description: StatCard preset for "the biggest item right now": label, item icon + name and its value, optionally linked.

props.name: item
props.description: The leading item's name ("Google Chrome").

props.name: accent
props.description: Categorical colour for the icon chip, label, trend and progress bar. `tone` stays for status.

props.name: animate
props.description: Roll the digits when a numeric `value` changes. Opt-in; strings and nodes render as given.

props.name: caption
props.description: Small text above the value ("Now", "In use of 64 GB").

props.name: chevron
props.description: Trailing chevron in the header. Default true when the card is a link or button.

props.name: children
props.description: Extra body content under the value and stats (a chart, a list).

props.name: href
props.description: Makes the label a link that covers the whole card.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon shown beside the label.

props.name: iconPlacement
props.description: Icon chip before the label or in the top-right corner. Default start with `accent`/`href`/`onClick`, else end.

props.name: itemIcon
props.description: The item's icon or logo.

props.name: label
props.description: Card label. Default "Top App".

props.name: labelTone
props.description: Label colour: the accent (default when `accent` is set) or muted.

props.name: loading
props.description:
Shows placeholders instead of the value, hint, delta and stat values (the label, caption and stat labels stay);
the progress bar, trend and `children` body get placeholders of the same size.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Makes the label a button that covers the whole card (when there is no `href`).

props.name: progress
props.description: A thin bar under the value (`progressMax` default 100).

props.name: progressMax
props.description: Value that counts as 100% for `progress`.

props.name: size
props.description: Card padding and value size.

props.name: status
props.description: Right-aligned next to the value, e.g. a `StatusBadge`.

props.name: tone
props.description: Semantic colour of the trend and accents.

props.name: trendColor
props.description: Colour of the trend line; defaults to follow `tone`.

props.name: trendMax
props.description: Fixed upper bound of the trend scale (e.g. 100).

props.name: trendMin
props.description: Fixed lower bound of the trend scale (e.g. 0).

props.name: trendPlacement
props.description: `footer` draws the trend full-width at the bottom on an accent-tinted strip. Default inline.

props.name: trendType
props.description: Sparkline style for `trend`.

props.name: value
props.description: The item's value ("37.0%").

props.name: valueFont
props.description: Number face for the value: monospaced (default) or the UI sans with tabular figures.

props.name: valueFormat
props.description: `Intl.NumberFormat` options for an animated `value`.

props.name: valueLocale
props.description: Locale for an animated `value`.

TOTPCard.description: Authenticator entry: issuer icon, account label, live code and a menu slot.

props.name: issuer
props.description: Service the code belongs to (for example "GitHub"), shown as the card title.

props.name: account
props.description: Account name or email, shown under the issuer.

props.name: algorithm
props.description: HMAC algorithm (`SHA1`, `SHA256` or `SHA512`). Default "SHA1".

props.name: code
props.description: Server-provided current code (overrides `secret`).

props.name: copyable
props.description: Show the copy button. Default true.

props.name: countdown
props.description: Style of the time-left indicator: `circular`, `linear` or `none`. Default "circular".

props.name: digits
props.description: Number of digits in a code. Default 6.

props.name: domain
props.description: Domain for the favicon (defaults to the issuer name, which renders a monogram).

props.name: getCode
props.description: Resolve a code for a timestamp (ms), e.g. from a server.

props.name: icon
props.description: Custom icon node; replaces the favicon.

props.name: iconSrc
props.description: Explicit icon URL for the issuer.

props.name: menu
props.description: Slot for an overflow menu (e.g. a DropdownMenu trigger).

props.name: nextCode
props.description: Server-provided next code, shown near the end of the period.

props.name: nextThreshold
props.description: Seconds left at which the countdown turns red and the next code appears. Default 5.

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Called with the code after it has been copied.

props.name: onRollover
props.description: Called when the period rolls over.

props.name: period
props.description: Seconds each code is valid. Default 30.

props.name: secret
props.description: Base32 secret; codes are generated in the browser.

props.name: showNext
props.description: Preview the next code when fewer than `nextThreshold` seconds remain. Default true.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the card. Default "md".

TOTPCode.description: Live one-time code with grouped digits, a countdown, copy and a next-code preview.

props.name: algorithm
props.description: HMAC algorithm (`SHA1`, `SHA256` or `SHA512`). Default "SHA1".

props.name: code
props.description: Server-provided current code (overrides `secret`).

props.name: copyable
props.description: Show the copy button. Default true.

props.name: countdown
props.description: Style of the time-left indicator: `circular`, `linear` or `none`. Default "circular".

props.name: digits
props.description: Number of digits in a code. Default 6.

props.name: getCode
props.description: Resolve a code for a timestamp (ms), e.g. from a server.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name prefix, e.g. "GitHub".

props.name: nextCode
props.description: Server-provided next code, shown near the end of the period.

props.name: nextThreshold
props.description: Seconds left at which the countdown turns red and the next code appears. Default 5.

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Called with the code after it has been copied.

props.name: onRollover
props.description: Called when the period rolls over.

props.name: period
props.description: Seconds each code is valid. Default 30.

props.name: secret
props.description: Base32 secret; codes are generated in the browser.

props.name: showNext
props.description: Preview the next code when fewer than `nextThreshold` seconds remain. Default true.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the code and countdown. Default "md".

TrackCycleChip.description: Chip showing the current subtitle/audio track; click cycles to the next one or opens a picker.

props.name: kind
props.description: Which track set this chip switches: `subtitles` or `audio`; sets the icon and labels.

props.name: tracks
props.description: Tracks to choose from, each with an id and label.

props.name: allowOff
props.description: Include an "Off" option. Default true for subtitles.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the chip.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial track id when uncontrolled. Default null (off).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the chip.

props.name: mode
props.description: Click cycles through the options, or opens a menu. Default: cycle up to 3 options, menu beyond.

props.name: offLabel
props.description: Label of the "off" option. Default "Off".

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the chosen track id, or `null` for off.

props.name: tone
props.description: `default` follows the theme; `overlay` is for a chip drawn over video.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected track id, or null for off (subtitles). Controlled.

TrackRow.description: Track list row: number/now-playing bars, hover play, artwork, title/artist, album, duration and menu slot.

props.name: track
props.description: The track to show (title, artist, album, artwork, duration).

props.name: actions
props.description: Extra inline actions shown on hover.

props.name: current
props.description: This row is the queue's current track.

props.name: favorite
props.description: Whether the track is a favourite; fills the heart button.

props.name: index
props.description: 1-based number shown in the lead column.

props.name: menu
props.description: Trailing menu (e.g. a DropdownMenu trigger).

props.name: onFavoriteChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the user toggles the heart; the button is hidden when unset.

props.name: onPause
props.description: Pause when this is the current playing row (falls back to `onPlay`).

props.name: onPlay
props.description: Called with the track when the user presses the row's play button.

props.name: playing
props.description: Whether this row's track is playing; shows the pause icon and the now-playing bars.

props.name: showAlbum
props.description: Shows the album column. Default true.

props.name: showArtwork
props.description: Shows the artwork thumbnail. Default true.

TranscriptSystemRow.description: System rows in a transcript: compaction, interruption, slash commands, errors, dividers and day changes.

props.name: kind
props.description: What the row announces: `compaction`, `compacting`, `interrupted`, `command`, `error`, `divider` or `date`.

props.name: action
props.description: divider: trailing action in the pill.

props.name: args
props.description: Command rows: arguments shown after the command name.

props.name: command
props.description: command: slash command name, e.g. "/review".

props.name: date
props.description: date: the day to show.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Compaction rows: whether the summary starts revealed.

props.name: error
props.description: error: details.

props.name: icon
props.description: Divider rows: icon before the text in the pill.

props.name: now
props.description: Date rows: reference time for "Today" and "Yesterday" labels; set it in tests and SSR.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Error rows: called when the user presses Retry; the button is hidden when unset.

props.name: result
props.description: command: output shown under the command.

props.name: retryLabel
props.description: Error rows: label of the retry button. Default "Retry".

props.name: summary
props.description: compaction: the summary revealed by "Show summary".

props.name: title
props.description: Overrides the default label for the kind.

TranscriptTimelineRail.description: Minimap rail beside a long transcript: one tick per user turn, hover previews, jump and in-view sync.

props.name: turns
props.description: Conversation turns to mark on the rail, each with an id and a label.

props.name: activeId
props.description: Controlled current turn; tracked via IntersectionObserver when omitted.

props.name: getTurnElement
props.description: Resolve a turn element. Default `document.getElementById(id)`.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the rail. Default "Transcript timeline".

props.name: onActiveChange
props.description: Called with the turn id (or `null`) when the active turn changes while scrolling.

props.name: onJump
props.description: Called on click / Enter; when omitted the turn element is scrolled into view.

props.name: scrollContainer
props.description: Scrollable transcript element (IntersectionObserver root and position source). Defaults to the viewport.

TranscriptTurn.description: A turn section whose sticky header stays pinned only while the turn is in view.

props.name: id
props.description: Unique id; the turn start anchor gets `${id}-start`.

props.name: prompt
props.description: The user's prompt, shown in the sticky turn header.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Level of the visually hidden heading. Default 2.

props.name: index
props.description: 1-based turn number for the screen-reader heading.

TransferItem.description: One upload/download/job row: icon, name, progress, bytes, speed, ETA, status and actions.

props.name: name
props.description: File or item name shown as the row title.

props.name: status
props.description: Transfer state; canonical `TaskStatus` values and "cancelled" are accepted too.

props.name: bytes
props.description: Bytes transferred so far.

props.name: compact
props.description: Legacy form of `density="compact"`.

props.name: density
props.description: Row spacing. `compact` is the denser tray row. Default `normal`.

props.name: detail
props.description: Secondary text, e.g. a destination path.

props.name: direction
props.description: Kind of transfer; picks the row icon and wording (`upload`, `download`, `move` or `process`).

props.name: error
props.description: Error shown for failed transfers (kept verbatim, e.g. upstream error text).

props.name: eta
props.description: Seconds remaining; computed from speed when omitted.

props.name: ext
props.description: Extension override for the file-format icon.

props.name: icon
props.description: Custom icon instead of the file-format icon.

props.name: id
props.description: Row id; the list sets it from the item data.

props.name: labels
props.description: Texts and accessible names (English by default); pass them to translate the row.

props.name: now
props.description: Override "now" (epoch ms) for speed computed from `startedAt`.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Called when the cancel button is clicked.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Called when a finished row is opened.

props.name: onPause
props.description: Called when the pause button is clicked.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Called when the remove button is clicked (finished transfers).

props.name: onResume
props.description: Called when the resume button is clicked.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Called when the retry button is clicked (failed transfers).

props.name: progress
props.description: 0–100. Derived from `bytes / total` when omitted.

props.name: samples
props.description: Recent `{ t, bytes }` samples for a smoothed speed.

props.name: speed
props.description: Bytes per second; computed from `samples` or `startedAt` when omitted.

props.name: startedAt
props.description: Epoch ms when the transfer started.

props.name: total
props.description: Total bytes.

TransferList.description: Queue of transfers with a summary header ("3 active · 1 failed · 12.4 MB/s") and "Clear completed".

props.name: items
props.description: Transfers to show, in order; each has an `id`, `name`, `status` and optional progress, size and speed data.

props.name: compact
props.description: Legacy form of `density="compact"`.

props.name: density
props.description: Row spacing. Default `normal`.

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Legacy name of `emptyState`.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when there are no items. Default "No transfers".

props.name: labels
props.description: Texts and accessible names (English by default); pass them to translate the list.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Max height of the scrolling list.

props.name: now
props.description: Override "now" (epoch ms) for computed speeds.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Called with the item id when its cancel button is clicked.

props.name: onClearCompleted
props.description: Shows "Clear completed" when there are finished rows.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Called with the item id when a finished row is opened.

props.name: onPause
props.description: Called with the item id when its pause button is clicked.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Called with the item id when its remove button is clicked (finished transfers).

props.name: onResume
props.description: Called with the item id when its resume button is clicked.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Called with the item id when its retry button is clicked (failed transfers).

props.name: title
props.description: Group header title. Pass `null` to hide the header. Default "Transfers".

TransferTray.description: Floating, collapsible uploads/downloads panel pinned to a corner (Google Drive style).

props.name: items
props.description: Transfers to show, in order; each has an `id`, `name`, `status` and optional progress, size and speed data.

props.name: defaultMinimized
props.description: Initial collapsed state when uncontrolled.

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Legacy name of `emptyState`.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when there are no items. Default "No transfers".

props.name: inline
props.description: Render in place instead of fixed to the viewport (for previews).

props.name: labels
props.description: Texts and accessible names (English by default); pass them to translate the list.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Max height of the scrolling list.

props.name: minimized
props.description: Controlled collapsed state of the tray. Use with `onMinimizedChange`.

props.name: now
props.description: Override "now" (epoch ms) for computed speeds.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Called with the item id when its cancel button is clicked.

props.name: onClearCompleted
props.description: Shows "Clear completed" when there are finished rows.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Shows a close button.

props.name: onMinimizedChange
props.description: Called when the user collapses or expands the tray.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Called with the item id when a finished row is opened.

props.name: onPause
props.description: Called with the item id when its pause button is clicked.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Called with the item id when its remove button is clicked (finished transfers).

props.name: onResume
props.description: Called with the item id when its resume button is clicked.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Called with the item id when its retry button is clicked (failed transfers).

props.name: position
props.description: Corner of the screen the tray sits in.

props.name: title
props.description: Header title; defaults to e.g. "Uploading 3 items" / "2 transfers complete".

TransliterationCandidates.description: IME-style candidate popup under the caret: pick by number, click, or arrows + Enter/Space; Esc keeps the raw text.

props.name: anchorRef
props.description: The textarea / input being typed in.

props.name: getCandidates
props.description: Return candidates for a romanized word. May be async.

props.name: lang
props.description: Language code passed to `getCandidates`.

props.name: enabled
props.description: IME on/off. Default true.

props.name: max
props.description: Max candidates shown (and number keys honored). Default 5.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called with the chosen candidate and the romanized word it replaces.

TransliterationToggle.description: IME on/off toggle for transliteration input.

props.name: defaultPressed
props.description: Initial state when uncontrolled. Default false.

props.name: glyph
props.description: Script sample shown on the button. Default "अ".

props.name: languageName
props.description: Language name for the label, e.g. "Hindi".

props.name: onPressedChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the user presses the toggle.

props.name: pressed
props.description: Controlled on/off state of transliteration.

Treemap.description:
Squarified treemap: tiles sized by value, coloured by category, with hover/focus tooltips, arrow-key navigation,
drill-down (Enter, click) and up (Backspace, Escape, breadcrumb), an optional legend and a screen-reader table.

props.name: data
props.description: The root node; its children fill the map.

props.name: breadcrumb
props.description: Show the drill breadcrumb. Defaults to true when some top-level node has children.

props.name: colorFor
props.description: Tile colour (an accent name or any CSS colour). Defaults to the node's `color`, then its category's colour.

props.name: defaultPath
props.description: Initial drill path when uncontrolled (child ids from the root).

props.name: defaultWidth
props.description: Width used before the container is measured (and in jsdom). Default 600.

props.name: depth
props.description: Levels drawn below the current view. Deeper levels appear inside framed parents with a header. Default 1.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when nothing has a size. Default "No data".

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between tiles in px. Default 2.

props.name: height
props.description: Map height in px. Default 320.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the map and caption of its screen-reader table. Default "Treemap".

props.name: legend
props.description: Show a category legend (`BreakdownList`) under the map. Default false.

props.name: loading
props.description: Data is on its way: with nothing to draw, placeholder tiles (and legend rows) fill the map; otherwise the root is marked busy.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale for the default number formatting. Pass one explicitly when the server and the browser must agree (SSR). Defaults to the runtime locale.

props.name: minLabelSize
props.description: Tiles narrower or shorter than this (px) hide their label. Default `{ width: 44, height: 22 }`.

props.name: onPathChange
props.description: Called with the new path when the user drills in or out.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called when a tile is clicked or activated with Enter/Space (before drilling into it).

props.name: palette
props.description: Category colours, cycled by the index of the top-level node. Defaults to a set of `ACCENT_COLORS`.

props.name: path
props.description: Drill path: child ids from the root down to the node shown.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Show a tooltip for the hovered or focused tile. Default true.

props.name: valueFormatter
props.description: Formats tile values in the labels and tooltip. Default is the localized number.

props.name: valueLabel
props.description: Column header for values in the screen-reader table. Default "Value".

TreeView.description: Data-driven tree with expand/collapse, selection, tri-state checkboxes and full keyboard support.

props.name: nodes
props.description: Top-level nodes; each has an `id`, a `label` and optional `children`, icon and disabled flag.

props.name: checkable
props.description: Show tri-state checkboxes. Checking a parent checks every descendant.

props.name: checked
props.description: Fully checked node ids (parents included).

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Initially checked node ids when uncontrolled (see `checkable`).

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Initially expanded node ids when uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: Initially selected node ids when uncontrolled.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Expanded node ids.

props.name: expandOnClick
props.description: Clicking a parent row toggles it. Default true.

props.name: indentGuides
props.description: Vertical indent guide lines. Default true.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Called with the fully checked node ids after a checkbox changes.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Called with the expanded node ids after a node is expanded or collapsed.

props.name: onNodeAction
props.description: Fired on click or Enter.

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.description: Called with the selected node ids after the selection changes.

props.name: selected
props.description: Controlled selected node ids. Use with `onSelectedChange`.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: Default "single".

props.name: showIcons
props.description: Default folder/file icons when a node has no `icon`. Default true.

props.name: size
props.description: Row height and text size.

props.name: typeahead
props.description: Jump to nodes by typing their first letters. Default true.

TrustBadge.description: Trust scale badge (verified → flagged) with a tooltip explaining what the level means.

props.name: level
props.description: Trust level (`verified`, `trusted`, `community`, `unverified` or `flagged`); sets the label, tone and scale fill.

props.name: explanation
props.description: Override the tooltip explanation.

props.name: showScale
props.description: Show a 5-step scale next to the label.

props.name: size
props.description: Badge size.

TurnStickyHeader.description: User prompt pinned at the top of the scroll area while its turn scrolls; click to jump to the turn start.

props.name: prompt
props.description: The user's prompt for this turn.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Level of the visually hidden heading. Default 2.

props.name: index
props.description: 1-based turn number for the screen-reader heading.

props.name: onJump
props.description: Called when the user presses the header, after it scrolls to `targetId`.

props.name: targetId
props.description: Id of the element marking the start of the turn; clicking scrolls it into view.

TwoFactorSetupCard.description: Authenticator app setup: scan a QR code or copy the secret, then confirm with a 6-digit code.

props.name: account
props.description: Account label shown under the QR code (an email address, say). Left out of the label and the provisioning URI when empty.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting text under the heading; each card has its own default.
props.default: "Protect your account with an authenticator app like 1Password, Authy or Google Authenticator."

props.name: error
props.description: Error message shown under the code input (e.g. a wrong code).

props.name: footer
props.description: Replace the default footer (e.g. "Don't have an account? Sign up"). Pass `null` to hide it.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Element of the card title (`1` is an `h1`). Use `2` or lower when the card sits inside a page that has its own `h1`.

props.name: issuer
props.description: Issuer (service name) shown in the authenticator app. Defaults to "Sutra".

props.name: loading
props.description: Disables the form and shows a spinner while the code is checked.

props.name: logo
props.description: Show the Sutra mark above the title, or pass a custom logo. Default: true for `card`.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Called when the user cancels the setup.

props.name: onDone
props.description: Called when the user finishes the setup (after the recovery codes are shown).

props.name: onVerify
props.description: Called with the code when the user submits it. A returned promise shows a spinner; throw to show the error message.

props.name: otpauthUri
props.description:
Full `otpauth://` provisioning URI encoded in the QR code. Defaults to one built from
`issuer`, `account` and `secret` (TOTP). Pass your server's URI to include digits/period/algorithm.

props.name: recoveryCodes
props.description: Recovery codes revealed after a successful verification.

props.name: renderLink
props.description: Router link renderer for the footer and inline links.

props.name: secret
props.description: Base32 secret shown for manual entry (spaces are ignored when copying).

props.name: title
props.description: Card heading; each card has its own default.

props.name: variant
props.description: `card` renders a bordered surface; `plain` renders only the content (for full-page layouts).

Typewriter.description:
Text that types itself (see `useTypewriter` for the timing options). Accessible: the current line is real text in a
visually hidden span and the typed part and the caret are `aria-hidden`, so a screen reader reads the whole line
once, never letter by letter, and the hidden text is there before the first character. Under
`prefers-reduced-motion` it prints the finished text straight away.

props.name: text
props.description: One line, or several typed in turn.

props.name: as
props.description: The element to render. Default `span`.

props.name: cursor
props.description:
The caret. "typing" (default): a solid caret while the text is being typed, gone when it is done, so nothing blinks
at rest. "always": a blinking caret that stays (it stops under reduced motion). "none".

props.name: delay
props.description: Milliseconds before the first character. Default 0.

props.name: deleteSpeed
props.description: Milliseconds per deleted character. Default 25.

props.name: hold
props.description: Milliseconds a finished line is held before it is deleted (several lines only). Default 1600.

props.name: loop
props.description: With several lines, start over after the last one (it is deleted first). Default false: the last line stays.

props.name: onDone
props.description: Called when the last line has been typed (never with `loop`).

props.name: reserve
props.description: Keep the space of the longest line from the start, so the text below does not jump while this one grows.

props.name: speed
props.description: Milliseconds per typed character. Default 45.

TypingIndicator.description: Polite live region announcing who is typing, with bouncing dots (`Spinner variant="dots"`).

props.name: users
props.description: People currently typing: names or presence users.

props.name: hideDots
props.description: Hide the animated dots.

props.name: maxNames
props.description: Names listed before "and N others". Default 2.

UndeliveredNotice.description: Inline notice when an answer or message couldn't be delivered, with Retry.

props.name: description
props.description: Explanation under the heading, for example why delivery failed.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called when the user dismisses the notice; the dismiss button is hidden when unset.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Called when the user presses Retry; the button is hidden when unset.

props.name: retrying
props.description: Shows a busy state on the retry button while a retry is in flight.

props.name: retryLabel
props.description: Label of the retry button. Default "Retry".

props.name: title
props.description: Heading of the notice. Default "Your answer couldn't be delivered".

UndoAction.description:
A destructive button that turns into a counted "Undo" for N seconds and only then commits (`onCommit`). The deadline is the
wall clock, so a throttled tab still commits on time; the ring and the number follow it. The focus stays on the same button, so
Enter or Space undoes. Pair it with a `Toast` through `onArm` and a controlled `armed`. The three labels sit in one grid cell,
so the width never jumps. A polite live region announces the countdown, the undo and the commit.

props.name: onCommit
props.description: Runs once the countdown ends (not before). A returned promise shows a spinner; a rejection brings the button back.

props.name: armed
props.description: The countdown is running. Set it from outside (a toast's Undo button sets it to false).

props.name: armedVariant
props.description: Variant while the countdown runs. Default "secondary".

props.name: committedLabel
props.description: Text shown once the action went through (after the window closes).

props.name: defaultArmed
props.description: Initial armed state when uncontrolled.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretches the button to the width of its container.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon before the idle label.

props.name: label
props.description: Label of the idle button. Default "Delete".

props.name: messages
props.type: { armed?: (seconds: number) => string; undone?: string; committed?: string }
props.description: Screen reader messages (a polite live region).

props.name: onArm
props.description: Runs when the user presses the button and the countdown starts (start a `Toast` here).

props.name: onArmedChange
props.description: Called when the countdown starts or stops (including when undone).

props.name: onUndo
props.description: Runs when the user presses "Undo". Setting a controlled `armed` to false from outside cancels silently.

props.name: pauseOnFocus
props.description: Hold the countdown while the button has keyboard focus (focus that came from a click does not count).

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.description: Hold the countdown while the pointer is over the button.

props.name: seconds
props.description: Seconds the user has to undo. Default 8.

props.name: size
props.description: Button height and padding; `icon-*` sizes are square.

props.name: spinnerProps
props.description: Overrides for the loading spinner (variant, size, `label`, colour via `className`); it inherits the button text colour by default.

props.name: undoLabel
props.description: Label of the button while the undo window is open.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style: `primary` (filled), `secondary` (bordered), `tertiary` (muted fill), `soft`, `ghost`, `outline`, `destructive`, `destructive-soft`, `inverse` or `link`.

UpgradeDialog.description: Plan comparison dialog with a monthly/yearly toggle and feature checklists.

props.name: billing
props.description: Controlled billing period. Use with `onBillingChange`.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the dialog panel.

props.name: currency
props.description: Currency symbol shown before prices.

props.name: currentPlan
props.description: Id of the plan the user is on; its button reads "Current plan".

props.name: defaultBilling
props.description: Initial billing period when uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onBillingChange
props.description: Called with the billing period the user picked.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the dialog opens or closes.

props.name: onSelectPlan
props.description: Called with the plan id and the billing period when a plan is chosen. A returned promise shows a spinner on that plan.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Use with `onOpenChange`.

props.name: plans
props.description: Plans to compare; each has an `id`, a `name`, monthly and yearly prices and a feature list. The default is demo data.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Element that opens the dialog (rendered with `asChild`).

UptimeBar.description: Status-page uptime strip: N buckets colored up / degraded / down / no-data, with uptime %.

props.name: buckets
props.description: Time slices from oldest to newest: each is a status (`up`, `degraded`, `down`, `no-data`) or a `{ status, label, detail }` object.

props.name: endLabel
props.description: Text under the right end of the bar (e.g. "Today").

props.name: formatPercent
props.description: Formats the uptime percentage. Default is e.g. "99.95%".

props.name: height
props.description: Bar height in px. Default 32.

props.name: label
props.description: Service name shown above the bar.

props.name: percent
props.description: Override the computed uptime.

props.name: showPercent
props.description: Shows the uptime percentage next to the label.

props.name: startLabel
props.description: Text under the left end of the bar (e.g. "90 days ago").

UsageInvoiceTable.description: Invoice history: date, description, amount, paid/due/failed status and download / pay actions.

props.name: invoices
props.description: Invoices to list, each with a number, date, amount and status.

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: Content shown when there is nothing to list.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when there are no invoices. Default "No invoices yet".

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale used to format amounts and dates. Default "en-US".

props.name: onDownload
props.description: Called with the invoice when the user presses Download; the action is hidden when unset.

props.name: onPay
props.description: Called with the invoice when the user presses Pay on an open one; the action is hidden when unset.

UsageLimitBars.description: Rolling usage-limit bars with threshold coloring, reset captions, a window toggle and per-model attribution.

props.name: windows
props.description:
Usage windows (session, weekly and so on), each with a label, percent used and reset time; a window with a `view`
shows only under that view.

props.name: defaultView
props.description: Initially active view when `view` is not controlled.

props.name: models
props.description: Per-model attribution ("Opus 62% of usage").

props.name: now
props.description: Reference time for reset countdowns; set it in tests and SSR for stable output.

props.name: onViewChange
props.description: Called with the view value when the user switches views.

props.name: thresholds
props.description: Used-percent levels at which a bar turns warning and danger.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading of the card.

props.name: view
props.description: Controlled value of the active view from `views`.

props.name: views
props.description: Toggle options for the window views, e.g. Session / Weekly.

UsageSummary.description: Usage dashboard: range switch, KPI tiles, daily bars, per-model bars, wait vs generate and finish reasons.

props.name: days
props.description: Daily records, oldest first.

props.name: defaultRange
props.description: Initial range when `range` is not controlled. Default "7".

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale used to format the counts. Default "en-US".

props.name: onRangeChange
props.description: Called with the range when the user picks another one.

props.name: range
props.description: Controlled range in days: `"7"`, `"30"` or `"90"`.

UserAccountMenu.description: Avatar-triggered account menu: profile header, settings, theme submenu and sign out.

props.name: align
props.description: Alignment of the menu against the trigger.

props.name: contentClassName
props.description: Classes for the menu panel.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultTheme
props.description: Initial theme preference when uncontrolled.

props.name: items
props.description: Menu rows above the sign-out row; each has a `key`, a `label` and optional icon and shortcut hint. Defaults to a standard account set.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the menu opens or closes.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called with the `key` of the chosen row.

props.name: onSignOut
props.description: Called when "Sign out" is chosen.

props.name: onThemeChange
props.description: Called with the preference the user picked in the theme submenu.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Use with `onOpenChange`.

props.name: showTheme
props.description: Show the theme submenu. Default true.

props.name: side
props.description: Side of the trigger the menu opens on.

props.name: theme
props.description: Controlled theme preference (`light`, `dark` or `system`). Use with `onThemeChange`.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Custom trigger element (e.g. a `SidebarUserCard`). Defaults to an avatar button.

props.name: user
props.description: The signed-in user: `name`, optional `email`, `avatarSrc` and `plan`. Shown in the menu header and used by the default trigger. The default is demo data.

VersionHistory.description:
Version history: timeline grouped by day with contributors and named versions; click to see what
changed in a version, Shift-click a second to compare the range, preview, rename and restore.

props.name: versions
props.description: Newest first.

props.name: defaultDiffMode
props.description: Initial diff layout when uncontrolled. Default "inline".

props.name: defaultSelection
props.description: Initial selection when `selection` is not controlled; defaults to the newest version.

props.name: defaultTab
props.description: Initial filter when `tab` is not controlled.

props.name: diffMode
props.description: Diff layout. Default "inline".

props.name: now
props.description: Reference time for day grouping.

props.name: onDiffModeChange
props.description: Called with the diff layout (`inline` or `split`) when the user changes it.

props.name: onRename
props.description: Enables "Name this version" (empty string clears the name).

props.name: onRestore
props.description: Enables Restore (after a confirmation).

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Called with the selected range when the user picks a version or extends the range.

props.name: onTabChange
props.description: Called with the filter when the user switches tab.

props.name: renderContent
props.description: Custom preview of a single version (default: plain text).

props.name: selection
props.description: Controlled selected range: `from` is the older version id, `to` the newer; equal for one version.

props.name: tab
props.description: Controlled list filter: `all` or `named` versions.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading of the panel. Default "Version history".

props.name: markOnly
props.description: Render only the geometric mark.

props.name: size
props.description: Height-driven size of the lockup.

VideoPlayer.description:
Custom `<video>` player: auto-hiding gradient chrome, seek bar with previews, volume, subtitle/audio chips,
speed, PiP/AirPlay/fullscreen, scoped keyboard shortcuts, autoplay-muted fallback, resume and up-next.

props.name: audioTrack
props.description: Controlled id of the selected audio track.

props.name: audioTracks
props.description: Server-side audio tracks (you reload the stream in `onAudioTrackChange`). Without this, native `audioTracks` are used.

props.name: autoHideMs
props.description: Hide the chrome after this much inactivity while playing. Default 3000ms.

props.name: autoPlay
props.description: Try to start playing; falls back to muted playback and shows a "tap to unmute" pill.

props.name: backLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the back button. Default "Back".

props.name: chapters
props.description: Chapter markers drawn on the seek bar, each with a start time and title.

props.name: crossOrigin
props.description: CORS mode of the video element; needed for side-loaded WebVTT tracks from another origin.

props.name: defaultAudioTrack
props.description: Initial audio track when `audioTrack` is not controlled.

props.name: defaultSubtitleTrack
props.description: Initial subtitle track when `subtitleTrack` is not controlled. Default none.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Text shown in the error overlay. Default "This video can't be played right now.".

props.name: fit
props.description: How the video fills the frame: `contain` (letterbox) or `cover` (crop). Default "contain".

props.name: loop
props.description: Restarts the video when it ends.

props.name: muted
props.description: Start muted.

props.name: nextLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the next button. Default "Next episode".

props.name: onAudioTrackChange
props.description: Called with the track id when the user picks another audio track.

props.name: onBack
props.description: Shows a back button in the top bar (also fired by Escape).

props.name: onEnded
props.description: Called when playback reaches the end.

props.name: onError
props.description: Called with the media error code and message when the video fails to load or play.

props.name: onNext
props.description: Shows a "next" button and enables the up-next countdown.

props.name: onResume
props.description: Called with the position in seconds when the user accepts the resume offer from `resumeAt`.

props.name: onSubtitleTrackChange
props.description: Called with the track id (or `null`) when the user changes subtitles.

props.name: poster
props.description: Image shown before playback starts.

props.name: rates
props.description: Speeds offered in the playback rate menu; defaults to the built-in set.

props.name: resumeAt
props.description: Offer to resume from this position (seconds). Ignored under 5s.

props.name: skipSeconds
props.description: Skip button distance. Default 10s.

props.name: src
props.description: Address of the video file or stream.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Line under the title, for example the episode name.

props.name: subtitleTrack
props.description: Controlled id of the shown subtitle track; `null` for off.

props.name: thumbnails
props.description: Returns a preview image URL for a time, shown in the seek bar's hover bubble.

props.name: title
props.description: Title shown in the top bar.

props.name: topActions
props.description: Extra controls in the top bar (e.g. a CastPicker).

props.name: tracks
props.description: Side-loaded WebVTT tracks. Without this, the element's own text tracks are offered.

props.name: upNext
props.description: When set (with `onNext`), ending playback shows an "Up next in 5…" card.

props.name: upNextCountdown
props.description: Countdown seconds for the up-next card. Default 5.

props.name: videoClassName
props.description: Extra classes for the `<video>` element.

props.name: videoRef
props.description: Ref to the underlying `<video>` element; `ref` stays on the root.

VoiceInput.description: Mic toggle with a live input-level ring, timer + max-duration countdown and interim transcript preview.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the microphone button.

props.name: fallback
props.description: Rendered instead of nothing when speech recognition is unavailable.

props.name: lang
props.description: BCP 47 language of the speech to recognise; defaults to the document language.

props.name: maxDuration
props.description: Auto-stop after this many seconds. Default 60.

props.name: meter
props.description: Capture the mic for the level meter. Default true.

props.name: onError
props.description: Called with the speech recognition error code (for example `not-allowed` when the microphone is blocked).

props.name: onTranscript
props.description: Called with each finalized phrase (`done: false`) and with the whole transcript when dictation stops (`done: true`).

props.name: showTranscript
props.description: Show the interim transcript preview. Default true.

props.name: size
props.description: Button size: `sm`, `md` or `lg`. Default "md".

VolumeControl.description:
Mute toggle plus a volume slider that expands on hover/focus (or pops up vertically).
A preset over `VolumeSlider`: media button style, 0–1 volume, arrow keys on the toggle, and the reveal / popover layout.

props.name: defaultMuted
props.description: Initial mute state when `muted` is not controlled.

props.name: defaultVolume
props.description: Initial volume (0 to 1) when `volume` is not controlled.

props.name: expand
props.description: Reveal the horizontal slider on hover/focus, or always show it. Default "hover".

props.name: muted
props.description: Controlled mute state.

props.name: onMutedChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the user presses the mute button.

props.name: onVolumeChange
props.description: Called with the volume (0 to 1) while the user moves the slider or presses an arrow key.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Horizontal slider beside the button, or a vertical slider in a popover above it.

props.name: size
props.description: Button size: `sm`, `md` or `lg`.

props.name: step
props.description: Volume change per arrow key. Default 0.05.

props.name: tone
props.description: `default` follows the theme; `overlay` is for controls drawn over video.

VolumeMixer.description:
Sound mixer: an output card (device picker, master volume) over a table of apps with their status,
a per-app `VolumeSlider` and level. Data in, events out.

props.name: apps
props.description: Apps using audio, each with a name, volume, muted state and playing flag.

props.name: accent
props.description: Categorical colour for the icon chip, sliders and playing indicator. Default "pink".

props.name: defaultDevice
props.description: Initially selected device id when `device` is not controlled.

props.name: defaultMuted
props.description: Initial master mute state when `muted` is not controlled.

props.name: defaultVolume
props.description: Initial master volume when `volume` is not controlled.

props.name: device
props.description: Selected device id.

props.name: devices
props.description: Output devices for the picker. With one device or none, the name is shown as plain text.

props.name: disabled
